translation.en: Good evening . Welcome to Cherry's . Do you have a reservation ?
translation.zh: 晚上好。欢迎来到Cherry's。有预约吗？

translation.en: How many of you , please ?
translation.zh: 请问你们一共有多少人？

translation.en: Six , including two kids .
translation.zh: 六个，包括两个孩子。

translation.en: I'm afraid all the big tables are taken .
translation.zh: 恐怕所有的大桌子都坐满了。

translation.en: I'm afraid there's been a mistake .
translation.zh: 恐怕弄错了。

translation.en: Farmer's Pet Store .
translation.zh: 这里农夫宠物店。

translation.en: Can you please tell me where you are located ?
translation.zh: 你能告诉我你们店在哪里吗？

translation.en: Sure , we are off Singing Road , close to the bank .
translation.zh: 好的，我们在唱道附近，离银行很近。

translation.en: Thank you , I know where that is .
translation.zh: 谢谢，我知道在哪儿了。

translation.en: Nani Book Store . How can I help you ?
translation.zh: 这里是纳尼书店。我能帮你什么？

translation.en: Do you have the ' The man and the Sea ' by Ernest Hemingway ?
translation.zh: 你们有海明威的《人与海》吗？

translation.en: Yes , we have one copy left .
translation.zh: 是的，我们还有一本。

translation.en: Can you hold it for me ?
translation.zh: 你能帮我拿一下吗？

translation.en: I'm a little rushed . Is there any quicker way to get there ?
translation.zh: 我有点赶时间。有没有更快的办法到达那里？

translation.en: Yeah , of course . You can take a taxi .
translation.zh: 是的，当然有。你可以坐出租车。

translation.en: How much will that run me ?
translation.zh: 我要花多少钱？

translation.en: It depends on traffic and distance , but it is reasonable .
translation.zh: 这取决于交通状况和距离，但这还是合理的。

translation.en: Do the drivers speak English ?
translation.zh: 司机会说英语吗？

translation.en: Some are better than others . But , you shouldn't have a problem .
translation.zh: 有些人比其他人说得好。但是，对你来说应该没问题。

translation.en: Are they safe ?
translation.zh: 他们安全吗？

translation.en: For the most part , yes . If you don't feel comfortable with it , then it is best not to take one at night .
translation.zh: 大多数情况下，是的。如果你觉得不舒服，那么最好不要在晚上坐出租。

translation.en: Hello , is Sue there ?
translation.zh: 喂，苏在吗？

translation.en: Sue John .
translation.zh: 苏·约翰。

translation.en: You must have the wrong number .
translation.zh: 你一定打错电话了。

translation.en: I hate doing the damn laundry .
translation.zh: 我太他妈讨厌洗衣服。

translation.en: Watch your language .
translation.zh: 注意用词。

translation.en: Have you got any better ?
translation.zh: 有更好的吗？

translation.en: That's the best there is .
translation.zh: 这是最好的了。

translation.en: Okay , I'll take one .
translation.zh: 好的，我要一个。

translation.en: That'll be $ 200 , sir .
translation.zh: 一共200美元，先生。

translation.en: What did you do today ?
translation.zh: 你今天做了什么？

translation.en: Played poker with my work friends .
translation.zh: 和我的工作朋友玩扑克。

translation.en: Did you win ?
translation.zh: 你赢了吗？

translation.en: Would you pour me some of that tea , please ?
translation.zh: 请给我倒点茶好吗？

translation.en: Okay . Say when .
translation.zh: 可以。什么时候要？

translation.en: I'm going to the hospital .
translation.zh: 我要去医院。

translation.en: Get in . I'll take you .
translation.zh: 上来吧，我带你去。

translation.en: About how much will it cost ?
translation.zh: 大约要多少钱？

translation.en: It will cost you $ 10 .
translation.zh: 10美元。

translation.en: By the way , what's the time ?
translation.zh: 顺便问一下，几点了？

translation.en: You can see the time on the meter . I have radio time , you know .
translation.zh: 你可以在计价器上看到时间。你知道，我有广播时间。

translation.en: It's a quarter to 12 . Could you please drive a little faster ?
translation.zh: 现在是十二点一刻。你能开快点吗？

translation.en: What a mess !
translation.zh: 真是一团糟！

translation.en: Sorry . I'll clean it up .
translation.zh: 对不起。我来收拾。

translation.en: Hi , who has the remote control ?
translation.zh: 嗨，遥控器在谁那儿？

translation.en: I do . Why , do you want me to change the channel ?
translation.zh: 在我这儿。怎么了，你想让我换频道吗？

translation.en: Yes , please . I can't stand watching the channel any more .
translation.zh: 是的，谢谢。我再也受不了看这个频道了。

translation.en: I think they have pretty good programmes . But I'll change it if you really want .
translation.zh: 我觉得他们的节目不错。但如果你真的想换，我会换的。

translation.en: Put it on Channel 5 , OK ?
translation.zh: 调到5频道，好吗？

translation.en: Oh , I hate Channel 5 . I'd rather just listen to the radio .
translation.zh: 哦，我讨厌5频道。我宁愿听收音机。

translation.en: Don't make such a fuss . I'm sure you will like today's programme .
translation.zh: 别吵了，你肯定会喜欢今天的节目。

translation.en: What's on today ?
translation.zh: 今天播什么？

translation.en: A basketball match between Chinese team and American team .
translation.zh: 中国队和美国队的篮球比赛。

translation.en: Really ? I'm interested in it .
translation.zh: 真的？我确实喜欢。

translation.en: It might begin now .
translation.zh: 可能现在已经开始了。

translation.en: Eat some more .
translation.zh: 多吃点。

translation.en: No , thanks . I'm on a diet .
translation.zh: 不用了，谢谢。我在节食。

translation.en: It's your turn now , Helen .
translation.zh: 现在轮到你了，海伦。

translation.en: OK . I'm coming .
translation.zh: 好的我来了。

translation.en: This is your song . I picked it for you .
translation.zh: 这是你的歌。我给你挑的。

translation.en: Thank you . You are so considerate .
translation.zh: 非常感谢。你真体贴。

translation.en: Push the red button on the mike to turn it on .
translation.zh: 按一下麦克风上的红色按钮把麦打开。

translation.en: OK . This key is too high for me .
translation.zh: 好的。这首歌的音调对我来说太高了。

translation.en: I think it's a piece of cake for you .
translation.zh: 这对你是小菜一碟。

translation.en: OK . Let me have a try ...
translation.zh: 好的让我试试...

translation.en: Well done ! I hope I can sing as well as you one day .
translation.zh: 唱得好！我希望有一天我能唱得和你一样好。

translation.en: Thank you . I'm sure you will .
translation.zh: 非常感谢。你肯定会的。

translation.en: I hope so . Thank you for saying so .
translation.zh: 希望如此。谢谢你这么说。

translation.en: Where's the toilet ?
translation.zh: 厕所在哪里？

translation.en: Honey , I need to have a talk with you .
translation.zh: 亲爱的，我需要和你谈谈。

translation.en: Dad , I have to do my homework .
translation.zh: 爸爸，我得做作业。

translation.en: No , honey , why didn't you go to cram school last night ?
translation.zh: 不，亲爱的，你昨晚为什么没去补习班？

translation.en: Dad , I don't want to talk about it now .
translation.zh: 爸爸，我现在不想谈这个。

translation.en: Honey , if you don't want to go to cram school , you should tell me the reason why .
translation.zh: 亲爱的，如果你不想去补习班，你应该告诉我原因。

translation.en: I'm sorry , dad . But I would rather stay at school than go to cram school .
translation.zh: 对不起，爸爸。但我宁愿留在学校也不愿去补习班。

translation.en: Let's go now .
translation.zh: 我们走吧。

translation.en: I'll be with you in a minute .
translation.zh: 我马上就来。

translation.en: I would like to buy a black suit .
translation.zh: 我想买一套黑色西装。

translation.en: Do you have any special brand in your mind ?
translation.zh: 你想要某个特定的牌子吗？

translation.en: No , I never wear suit in my everyday life . I just want one to take part in my sister ’ s wedding ceremony .
translation.zh: 不，我在日常生活中从不穿西装，我只想买一套去参加我姐姐的婚礼。

translation.en: I see . Have a look at this one . It ’ s very cheap because it ’ s not very durable .
translation.zh: 我明白了。看看这一套，很便宜，因为它不是很耐穿。

translation.en: but it looks good . Let me try it on .
translation.zh: 但看起来不错。让我试穿一下。

translation.en: Ok , the mirror is over there .
translation.zh: 好的，镜子在那边。

translation.en: Do you have something to read ?
translation.zh: 你有什么读物吗？

translation.en: Could you lend me one ?
translation.zh: 你能借我一份吗？

translation.en: Thanks . It's rather cold this morning , wouldn't you say ?
translation.zh: 谢谢。今天早上很冷，你说呢？

translation.en: Do you know the news ?
translation.zh: 你知道这个消息吗？

translation.en: Brazil wins the World Cup .
translation.zh: 巴西赢得了世界杯。

translation.en: Hi . I need to have my shoes repaired .
translation.zh: 你好。我需要把鞋修好。

translation.en: What ’ s the matter with them ?
translation.zh: 它们怎么了？

translation.en: Look at the heels . They are slanting .
translation.zh: 你看我的高跟鞋。是斜着的。

translation.en: Ah , I can do it perfectly .
translation.zh: 啊，我能修好。

translation.en: 6 yuan . And I can make them as new as before .
translation.zh: 6元。我可以让它们像以前一样新。

translation.en: I think it ’ s too expensive . I can just give you 4 yuan . Or I ’ ll go to another B .
translation.zh: 太贵了。我可以给你4元钱。否则我就去另一个店里。

translation.en: All right . I ’ ll repair them for you .
translation.zh: 好吧。我来帮你修理。

translation.en: How long will it take ? Could you repair them while I wait ?
translation.zh: 要多长时间？我能在这儿等着你修吗？

translation.en: Yes . They will be ready in a few minutes .
translation.zh: 可以。几分钟后就好了。

translation.en: Great ! I ’ ll just sit here and wait .
translation.zh: 太好了！我就坐在这儿等着。

translation.en: I'd like to buy some milk powder . What would you recommend ?
translation.zh: 我想买些奶粉。你有什么推荐吗？

translation.en: We have many kinds of different purpose . I wonder whom you are buying for ?
translation.zh: 我们有许多不同功效的奶粉。你是给谁买的？

translation.en: My son . He is two years old .
translation.zh: 我儿子。他两岁了。

translation.en: I see , sir . This one is very good .
translation.zh: 我明白了，先生。这一款很好。

translation.en: You may rest assured . It sells well .
translation.zh: 你可以放心。它卖得很好。

translation.en: May I have a look at the introduction ?
translation.zh: 我可以看一下介绍吗？

translation.en: I need something to wash this down . Is there any juice in the fridge ?
translation.zh: 我需要点东西把这个吞下去，你冰箱里有果汁吗？。

translation.en: What is that ? It looks like something from a swamp !
translation.zh: 那是什么？看起来好像是从沼泽来的东西！

translation.en: It's a green drink . It's supposed to be full of vitamins and minerals .
translation.zh: 这是绿色饮料，里头有丰富的维生素和矿物质。

translation.en: You know , healthy eating doesn't have to make you gag .
translation.zh: 你知道，健康饮食不应该让你想吐。

translation.en: The sales lady said that even if I eat right , I wouldn't get enough vitamins .
translation.zh: 卖饮料的小姐说，即使我饮食正常，还是没办法摄取足够的维生素。

translation.en: Have you ever tried it ? Or are you just going to believe the sales lady ?
translation.zh: 你试过吗？还是你就打算相信那位小姐的话？

translation.en: It's easier to drink this once a day than eat fruit and vegetables all day .
translation.zh: 每天喝一瓶这玩意，比整天吃蔬菜水果要容易多了。

translation.en: It may take less time , but I don't know about easier . Yuck .
translation.zh: 也许时间比较短，可是我不觉得有多容易，呕。

translation.en: I've studied home decoration as a hobby . Could I make some suggestions ?
translation.zh: 作为爱好，我学习过家居装饰。我能提些建议吗？

translation.en: Wow , you really do have a talent for this , Alice . Thanks for the suggestions .
translation.zh: 哇，你真有这方面的天赋，爱丽丝。谢谢你的建议。

translation.en: I only want a little off the top and the sides and back to have clean lines .
translation.zh: 我上面只要修剪一点点，两边和发尾要剪齐。

translation.en: Okay . Is your hair naturally curly or is it a perm ?
translation.zh: 好的，你的头发是自然卷，还是烫的？

translation.en: It's natural . My friend told me you know how to work with curls .
translation.zh: 自然卷。我朋友告诉我你对卷发很有办法。

translation.en: That's my specialty . Let me put this around your neck .
translation.zh: 那是我的专长。我把这个套在你脖子上。

translation.en: Do you have any product that controls frizz ?
translation.zh: 你们有什么产品可以整理卷发吗？

translation.en: With the cut I'll give you , we will minimize a lot of that .
translation.zh: 剪头发就可以了，我会尽量让它不要那么翘。

translation.en: And when we're done , I'll show you some great stuff to take care of the rest .
translation.zh: 剪完后，我再介绍一些整理卷发的产品。

translation.en: Good morning . I'm interested in antiques . Do you have any ?
translation.zh: 早上好。我想看看古董。有吗？

translation.en: Yes , we have a great variety of Chinese antiques .
translation.zh: 是的，我们有各种各样的中国古董。

translation.en: Well , we have some painting and some porcelain . Which do you like better ?
translation.zh: 嗯，我们有些画和瓷器。你更喜欢哪个？

translation.en: I'd like porcelain .
translation.zh: 我想要瓷器。

translation.en: Good . How about the table set ?
translation.zh: 很好。桌子上那套怎么样？

translation.en: Oh , it looks well . I like it very much .
translation.zh: 哦，看起来不错。我非常喜欢它。

translation.en: It's made in Jingdezhen .
translation.zh: 它是景德镇制造的。

translation.en: One thousand eight hundred yuan .
translation.zh: 一千八百元。

translation.en: It's not expensive . I'll take it .
translation.zh: 不算贵。我要了。

translation.en: Would you please show me that mural ?
translation.zh: 你能给我看看那幅壁画吗？

translation.en: Certainly . Here you are .
translation.zh: 当然。给你。

translation.en: It looks so beautiful . How much is it ?
translation.zh: 它看起来真漂亮。多少钱？

translation.en: Four hundred yuan .
translation.zh: 四百元。

translation.en: That's a bit more than I wanted to pay . Can you cut the price down a bit ?
translation.zh: 这比我预想的价格多。你能把价格降低一点吗？

translation.en: I'm sorry . Ours is a fixed price shop and I can assure you this is the best price you can get for a mural like this .
translation.zh: 对不起。我们是一家固定价格的商店，（但）我可以向你保证，这是你能买到这样一幅壁画的最好价格。

translation.en: Maybe you are right . OK , I'll take it .
translation.zh: 也许你是对的。好吧，我买了。

translation.en: Well , I'll have it wrapped for you .
translation.zh: 好的，我帮你包起来。

translation.en: Thank you . Here is four hundred yuan .
translation.zh: 谢谢你。这是四百元。

translation.en: Thank you . Please come again .
translation.zh: 非常感谢。欢迎下次再来。

translation.en: You are looking really healthy lately . What are you doing differently ?
translation.zh: 你最近看起来很健康，发生了什么事？

translation.en: Thank you for noticing ! I've been making a few lifestyle changes over the past year .
translation.zh: 你能注意到真好！过去这一年来，我改变了不少生活方式。

translation.en: Tell me about it . I'm interested .
translation.zh: 说来听听，我很感兴趣。

translation.en: Well , it all started when my brother challenged me to quit smoking .
translation.zh: 嗯，这要从我哥哥要我戒烟开始说起。

translation.en: Ha ! That's right . You used to smoke . I forgot !
translation.zh: 哈！没错，你以前抽烟的，我都忘了！

translation.en: When I kicked that habit , I found I had so much more energy . I started exercising .
translation.zh: 当我戒掉后，我觉得精力旺盛，因此就去做运动。

translation.en: At the gym ?
translation.zh: 在健身房？

translation.en: No . I like to be outside . I took up hiking and mountain biking .
translation.zh: 不，我喜欢在户外运动，如徒步旅行或是骑车越野。

translation.en: Ah , here we are .
translation.zh: 啊，我们到了。

translation.en: This is the place I was telling you about .
translation.zh: 这就是我告诉你的地方。

translation.en: Would you like to sit near the window ?
translation.zh: 你想坐在靠窗的地方吗？

translation.en: Let's have a look at the menu . Oh , there isn't a menu . Do you think you could ask the people at the next table if we could look at their menu ?
translation.zh: 让我们看看菜单。哦，没有菜单。你能问下一桌的人我们能不能看看他们的菜单吗？

translation.en: Yes , of course . Excuse me . Could you possibly let us see your menu ? Oh . They haven't got one either .
translation.zh: 是的，当然。请原谅我。您能让我们看看您的菜单吗？哦。他们也没有。

translation.en: Hello , Miao Li , Where are you going ?
translation.zh: 你好，苗莉，你要去哪里？

translation.en: Hello , I am going to the store to buy some fruit .
translation.zh: 你好，我要去商店买些水果。

translation.en: Oh , Would you do me a favor ?
translation.zh: 哦，你能帮我个忙吗？

translation.en: Please mail this letter for me on your way to the store .
translation.zh: 请在去商店的路上帮我寄这封信吧。

translation.en: Sure . Do you want it to be registered ?
translation.zh: 当然。你想挂号吗？

translation.en: Yes , I think so . There are some pictures in it . It would be a great pity if they were lost .
translation.zh: 嗯，我想是的。里面有一些照片。如果他们丢了，那就太可惜了。

translation.en: Yes , I will be glad to mail your letter .
translation.zh: 好的，我很乐意帮你寄信。

translation.en: you are welcome .
translation.zh: 不客气。

translation.en: Do you remember what the ratings of movies stand for ?
translation.zh: 你还记得电影分级代表的意思吗？

translation.en: Yes , G stands for General Audiences , PG means Parental Guidance suggested , R is restricted to audiences under 18 and X means explicit content .
translation.zh: 是的，G代表普遍级，PG代表保护级，R代表限制级，未满十八岁不得观看，X代表严加限制级。

translation.en: Does anyone pay any attention to those ratings anymore ?
translation.zh: 现在还有人会遵守分级吗？

translation.en: Remember when we were kids ? Theaters wouldn't let kids in to PG moves without a parent .
translation.zh: 还记得我们小时候吗？保护级的电影如果没有父母陪同，电影院就不会让孩子进去。

translation.en: I remember that I never saw an X moves even displayed .
translation.zh: 我记得那时根本没有X级电影。

translation.en: Now with video rentals it's all a personal matter .
translation.zh: 现在有了录像带出租店，分级就变成个人的选择了。

translation.en: Yea , I never see theaters turn people away for their age anymore either .
translation.zh: 是啊。我现在也没看过电影院会因为一个人的年龄而赶他走的情况。

translation.en: Now we have to make a choice about what we will see and what we won't .
translation.zh: 现在我们只能自己把关，决定哪些能看，哪些不能。

translation.en: ( A stranger stops to help ) Everything OK ?
translation.zh: （陌生人停下来帮忙）没事吧？

translation.en: No ! My tour bus got a speeding ticket not ten minutes ago . Now my engine is on fire !
translation.zh: 有事！不到十分钟前，我的旅游巴士收到了超速罚单。现在我的引擎着火了！

translation.en: I think that's just steam . Your engine's overheated .
translation.zh: 我想那只是蒸汽。你的引擎过热了。

translation.en: Do you know a lot about cars ?
translation.zh: 你对汽车很了解吗？

translation.en: A little bit . I'll take a look if you want me to .
translation.zh: 了解一点点。如果你有需要，我就帮忙看一下。

translation.en: Please . Thank you so much for stopping .
translation.zh: 拜托你了。非常感谢你停下来帮忙。

translation.en: Yeah , she's hot . Radiator's leaking . Looks like you were running her pretty hard .
translation.zh: 是的，引擎过热了。散热器漏水了。看来你开车太猛了。

translation.en: That must have been just before I got the speeding ticket .
translation.zh: 一定是在我拿到超速罚单之前。

translation.en: Did you have an accident recently ... Hey , wait a second ! I know this car !
translation.zh: 你最近有没有出车祸...嘿，等等！我知道这辆车！

translation.en: I ran into it a couple of weeks ago . What do you know ? Name's Hal .
translation.zh: 这是我几周前撞到的那辆车。真想不到！我叫哈尔。

translation.en: I'm Akimbo . Nice to meet you , I guess .
translation.zh: 我叫阿金博。很高兴见到你，大概。

translation.en: Boy , I'm sure sorry about your car . Hey , Akimbo , I wonder if you'd like to make a deal ?
translation.zh: 孩子，我真的很抱歉。嘿，阿金博，我想知道你是否愿意做个交易？

translation.en: What kind of deal ?
translation.zh: 什么交易？

translation.en: I'd like to give you cash for the damage to your car .
translation.zh: 我想给你现金，赔偿我对你汽车造成的损坏。

translation.en: You don't want your insurance company to pay for it ?
translation.zh: 你不想让你的保险公司付钱吗？

translation.en: I'd rather not . They'll raise my rates . It'll cost me more in the long run .
translation.zh: 还是不要了。他们会提高我的利率。从长远来看，我会花更多的钱。

translation.en: If you give me cash , do you care if I don't fix the car ?
translation.zh: 如果你给我现金，你介意我不用那钱去修车吗？

translation.en: Hell , I don't care . Just don'T submit a report to your insurancecompany .
translation.zh: 我才不管呢。只是不要向你的保险公司提交报告就行了。

translation.en: It's a deal , Hal . Thanks again for stopping to help . And thanks for smashing my car !
translation.zh: 成交，哈尔。再次感谢你停下来帮忙。也谢谢你撞了我的车！

translation.en: Who gave my dog this cooked chicken bone ?
translation.zh: 是谁给了我的狗这块煮过的鸡骨头？

translation.en: I did . Why ?
translation.zh: 是我。怎么了？

translation.en: Didn't you know dogs shouldn't eat cooked chicken bones because they're bad for their stomachs ?
translation.zh: 你不知道狗不能吃煮过的鸡骨头吗？这对它们的胃不好。

translation.en: No , I didn't . I'm sorry . It won't happen again .
translation.zh: 我不知道。对不起，我不会再这么做了。

translation.en: Excuse me , I have something to trouble you .
translation.zh: 打扰一下，我有事要麻烦你。

translation.en: Yes ? I'll be very glad if I could be of any help to you .
translation.zh: 什么？如果我能帮助你，我将非常高兴。

translation.en: An hour ago , I bought this vase with my tourist .
translation.zh: 一小时前，我和我的游客买了这个花瓶。

translation.en: Oh , yes . I remember it clearly . Is there anything wrong with it ?
translation.zh: 哦，是的。我记得很清楚。有什么问题吗？

translation.en: I'm afraid so . We found this crack on the bottom when I went back to my hotel .
translation.zh: 是的。我们回到旅馆后，在底部发现了这个裂缝。

translation.en: Oh , how awful ! Let me have a look , I'm terribly sorry . It was most thoughtless of me . Would you excuse me , please ?
translation.zh: 哦，太可怕了！让我看看，非常抱歉。我太粗心了。请原谅我，好吗？

translation.en: Oh , It's quite all right , I suppose . It can't be helped sometimes .
translation.zh: 哦，我想没关系。这种事情也时有发生。

translation.en: It's very kind of you to say so . How about changing another one for you ?
translation.zh: 你真是太好了。给你换一个怎么样？

translation.en: Just a minute , please . I won't be long . I'm sure this one is perfect . You may examine it carefully .
translation.zh: 请稍等。我一会儿就回来。我相信这个很完美。你可以仔细检查一下。

translation.en: Oh , yes , it is . I'll take this one .
translation.zh: 哦，是的，是的。就这个了。

translation.en: I'm very sorry for any inconvenience I've caused you .
translation.zh: 对给您带来的不便，我深表歉意。

translation.en: Well , there's no reason to apologize for such a trifle thing .
translation.zh: 嗯，没有理由为这么一件小事道歉。

translation.en: What's up ? You sound a little down in dumps .
translation.zh: 怎么了？你听起来好像情绪不太好啊。

translation.en: I quarreled with my roommate last night . He is really stubborn .
translation.zh: 我昨晚和室友吵架了，他太倔了。

translation.en: Calm down ! Shouting won ’ t help ?
translation.zh: 冷静点，吵架不能解决问题。

translation.en: He is really outrageous .
translation.zh: 他真是太离谱了。

translation.en: I went back home last night . You know tired as a dog , so I took a quick shower and went to bed . I couldn't fall asleep , because Brian was there in the living room , playing his stupid stereo so loud . I kindly told him to turn that down a little bit . He shouted at me .
translation.zh: 我昨天晚上回家，你知道累得像狗似的，我很快的洗了个澡然后就上床了，可是布莱恩在客厅把他那个破音响开得很大声，吵得我睡不着。我礼貌的告诉他把声音关小点时，他却对我大喊大叫。

translation.en: What ? He can't do this to you .
translation.zh: 什么？他不能这么做。

translation.en: Well , he did it anyway . Then he came into my room and shot all his shit blah blah blah ... you know .
translation.zh: 他就是这么做的，然后他到了我这屋里嘟嘟嚷嚷。

translation.en: I shouted it back of course .
translation.zh: 我当然也冲他喊。

translation.en: Hold it , Mike . You won't accomplish anything by hollering at him , right ? You worked it all up till now . Why not wait until you cool down a bit ?
translation.zh: 忍一忍，迈克。喊解决不了问题，你们直到现在还很激动，为什么不等你们冷静下来呢？

translation.en: What would you do if you were in my shoes ?
translation.zh: 如果你站在我的立场，你会怎么做？

translation.en: Just stay cool . You know . When you get back home tonight , tell him that you didn't mean to quarrel with him .
translation.zh: 保持冷静，今晚你回家的时候，告诉他你不是真想和他吵。

translation.en: No way , Kate . I mean it's just not my fault .
translation.zh: 没门儿，凯特。这又不是我的错。

translation.en: I know . It wouldn't hurt much to say sorry first . And after that , you can casually mention the problem . I am sure he will cooperate .
translation.zh: 我知道，可先说抱歉又不损失什么，之后你可以慢慢地和他提这件事，我相信他会合作的。

translation.en: I am too angry to do that .
translation.zh: 我实在是太生气了，我做不到。

translation.en: Hello , Is that Stefan ?
translation.zh: 喂，是斯特凡吗？

translation.en: I'm sorry , but I'm afraid you've dialed the wrong number.There is no Stefan here .
translation.zh: 对不起，恐怕你拨错号码了。这里没有斯特凡这个人。

translation.en: Really ? Are you sure ? I called before and he was there .
translation.zh: 真的吗？你确定？我以前打过电话，有这个人的。

translation.en: Yes . I'm sure . You have the wrong number . I have used this number for more than 20 years .
translation.zh: 对。我肯定。你打错电话了。我用这个号码已经20多年了。

translation.en: That can't be true . I remember the number clearly . Is your number 1199886 ?
translation.zh: 不可能。我清楚地记得这个电话号码。你的电话号码是1199886吗？

translation.en: No , it isn't . It's 1199866 . It seems that you have misdialed .
translation.zh: 不，不是。是1199866。看来你拨错电话了。

translation.en: Oh , I'm sorry I bothered you . I'm really sorry .
translation.zh: 哦，对不起，打扰你了。我真的很抱歉。

translation.en: It doesn't matter . It happens to everyone .
translation.zh: 没关系。每个人都会这样。

translation.en: Sorry again for bothering you .
translation.zh: 再次抱歉打扰你。

translation.en: Good evening . What'll you have ?
translation.zh: 晚上好。你要什么？

translation.en: I'd like a beer . What kind of beer do you have ?
translation.zh: 我想要杯啤酒。你们有什么啤酒？

translation.en: Draft beer and cans beer . Which do you prefer ?
translation.zh: 生啤酒和罐装啤酒。你喜欢哪一种？

translation.en: A draft beer please .
translation.zh: 请给我一杯生啤酒。

translation.en: Could I have some fruit ?
translation.zh: 我能吃点水果吗？

translation.en: Of course . Wait for a moment , please .
translation.zh: 当然。请稍等片刻。

translation.en: Give me a Big Mac , a small order of French fries and a medium Coke .
translation.zh: 请给我一个巨无霸，一份小薯和一杯中可。

translation.en: You'll need to wait a few minutes for the fries . They are still in the fryer .
translation.zh: 您需要等几分钟才能拿到薯条。我们还在炸。

translation.en: Here's a twenty . Could you give me some more napkins ?
translation.zh: 这是二十美元。你能再给我一些餐巾纸吗？

translation.en: Sure . Your cash back is $ 13 . And we'll bring out your fries in two minutes .
translation.zh: 当然。找你13美元。我们会在两分钟内给您上薯条。

translation.en: Hey Jimmy . Let's go workout later today .
translation.zh: 嘿，吉米。我们今天晚些时候去锻炼吧？

translation.en: Sure . What time do you want to go ?
translation.zh: 好啊。你想什么时候去？

translation.en: How about at 3:30 ?
translation.zh: 三点半怎么样？

translation.en: That sounds good . Today we work on Legs and forearm .
translation.zh: 听起来不错。今天我们运动是腿部和前臂吧。

translation.en: Hey . I just played basketball earlier , so my legs are a little sore . Let's work out on arms and stomach today .
translation.zh: 嘿。我刚刚才打完篮球，所以我的腿有点痛。我们今天锻炼手臂和腹部吧。

translation.en: I'm on a weekly schedule . You're messing everything up .
translation.zh: 我有每周的运动安排。你把一切都搞乱了。

translation.en: C'mon . We're only switching two days . You can do legs on Friday .
translation.zh: 拜托。我们只换着锻炼两天。星期五你可以做腿部运动。

translation.en: Aright . I'll meet you at the gym at 3:30 then .
translation.zh: 行吧。那我三点半在体育馆见你。

translation.en: Well , Mitzuko-san , I hope you like it here . This is my favourite restaurant in Taipei . It reminds me of my youth when I traveled around Europe .
translation.zh: 好吧，Mitzuko小姐，我希望你喜欢这里。这是我在台北最喜欢的餐厅。它使我想起了我在欧洲旅行时的青春岁月。

translation.en: It looks wonderful . Very authentic .
translation.zh: 看起来很棒，就像真的欧洲餐厅一样。

translation.en: The chef trained in Florence . The pasta is very good here .
translation.zh: 大厨是在佛罗伦萨学艺，这里的意大利面很好吃。

translation.en: OK . So , what can you recommend ?
translation.zh: 好。那你可以推荐一下吗？

translation.en: Hum ... You should try the mushroom fettucine . It's really good .
translation.zh: 嗯，你应该试试蘑菇面，味道很棒。

translation.en: Is it salty ?
translation.zh: 咸吗？

translation.en: Not at all . It has a very delicate flavor .
translation.zh: 一点儿都不。味道很清淡。。

translation.en: What does ' Duppa del Giono ' mean ? I'm sorry I don't know how to pronounce that .
translation.zh: “迪帕德吉奥诺”是什么意思？对不起，我不知道该怎么发音。

translation.en: Oh , that means soup of the day . I'll ask the waiter what they have today . Have you tried mussels cooked the Italian way ? They're really delicious .
translation.zh: 哦，那是“每日一汤”的意思。我去问服务员今天有什么汤。你吃过意式贻贝吗？它的味道很棒。

translation.en: No . I'll try them . Sounds good .
translation.zh: 没吃过，那就试试看吧，听起来不错。

translation.en: This looks wonderful , Madame Culot .
translation.zh: 这看起来很棒，卡洛夫人。

translation.en: Yes , it's very nice . All our foreign visitors enjoy it . The food is wonderfully well-prepared . Let me know if you need any help with the menu .
translation.zh: 是的，非常好。我们所有的外国游客都喜欢它。食物准备得非常好。假如你对菜单有什么不了解的地方，请告诉我。

translation.en: Thank you . Mmm . Can you tell me about the terrine ?
translation.zh: 谢谢你。嗯。你能跟我说说terrine吗？

translation.en: Yes . A terrine is a kind of meat pate . It's meat turned into a paste . It sounds horrible but it's actually really good .
translation.zh: 好的。是一种肉饼，也就是把肉变成饼。听起来很恐怖，但实际上很好吃。

translation.en: Mmm . Maybe another time .
translation.zh: 嗯。也许下次（可以试试）。

translation.en: You could try the ravioli . They are rather like your Chinese dumplings , and the sauce is delicious .
translation.zh: 你可以尝尝饺子。它们很像你们的中国饺子，而且酱汁很好吃。

translation.en: Sounds good . I think I'll have the lamb for my main course . What does it come with ?
translation.zh: 听起来不错。我想我的主菜就吃羊肉好了。副餐是什么？

translation.en: Well , you can have fries-French fries-or simple boiled potatoes .
translation.zh: 嗯，你可以吃fries，也就是薯条，或是简单的水煮马铃薯。

translation.en: I'll have the potatoes . What are you having ?
translation.zh: 那我吃马铃薯好了。你要吃什么呢？

translation.en: I'm having my usual . I like the fish here . Would you like some wine ?
translation.zh: 我还是老样子，我喜欢吃这里的鱼。你想要些葡萄酒吗？

translation.en: Oh , yes . That would be lovely .
translation.zh: 哦，是的。你真热心。

translation.en: There's plenty left . Would you like another helping ?
translation.zh: 还有很多。你还要一份吗？

translation.en: I'd like to have some more . It's really good .
translation.zh: 我想再吃点。真的很好吃。

translation.en: Would you check the engine , please ? It is knocking .
translation.zh: 请检查一下发动机好吗？声音有点不对。

translation.en: Sure . Do you want to have the car washed ?
translation.zh: 当然可以。你想洗车吗？

translation.en: Yes , please . When can you get it done ?
translation.zh: 好的，谢谢。你什么时候能完成？

translation.en: You can pick it up in half an hour . By the way , how are you going to pay , cash or credit ?
translation.zh: 半个小时后可以来取车。顺便问一下，你打算怎么结算，现金还是信用 卡？

translation.en: By credit .
translation.zh: 信用卡。

translation.en: Can you tell me where the pots and pans are ?
translation.zh: 你能告诉我锅碗瓢盆在哪里吗？

translation.en: Pots and pans are right over there .
translation.zh: 锅碗瓢盆就在那边

translation.en: Could I interest you in our store credit card ?
translation.zh: 你要看看我们商店的信用卡吗？

translation.en: No , thanks . I already have credit cards .
translation.zh: 不，谢谢。我已经有信用卡了。

translation.en: But our credit card saves you 10 percent .
translation.zh: 但我们的信用卡可以帮你节省10%。

translation.en: That's a nice discount .
translation.zh: 这是一个很好的折扣。

translation.en: Here . Let me give you an application form .
translation.zh: 给你。我给你一张申请表。

translation.en: Thank you , but I'm just browsing today .
translation.zh: 谢谢，不过我今天只是看看。

translation.en: Okay . Enjoy your browsing .
translation.zh: 可以。那就看看吧。

translation.en: Hey ! What are you doing here ?
translation.zh: 嘿，你在这里干什么？

translation.en: I found them at JC Pennies .
translation.zh: 我在JC便士店买的

translation.en: Gary . Could you type up this report for me ? I have to take off early this afternoon .
translation.zh: 加里。你能帮我把这份报告打出来吗？今天下午我得早点走。

translation.en: Sure . Just leave it to me . I'll finish it .
translation.zh: 当然。交给我吧。我会完成的。

translation.en: Over here is our gym . We have all the latest equipment .
translation.zh: 这里是我们的健身房。我们有最新的设备。

translation.en: But I haven't used exercising equipment before . Can you tell us some more details ?
translation.zh: 但我以前没用过健身器材。你能告诉我们更多的细节吗？

translation.en: Certainly . We have here the race apparatus , stationary bike , muscle builder set , chest expander , bar bell , dumb bell and so on .
translation.zh: 当然。我们这里有比赛器械，固定自行车，肌肉健身器，胸部扩张器，杠铃，哑铃等等。

translation.en: Working in the gym is a very good way for losing weight . What else do you have ?
translation.zh: 在健身房工作是一个很好的减肥方法。这里还有什么？

translation.en: Here's the swimming pool . It's open from 10 a . m . to 11 p . m . There are also massage rooms here .
translation.zh: 这是游泳池。从上午10点开门，到晚上11点关门。这里还有按摩室。

translation.en: That's wonderful ! I like swimming .
translation.zh: 太棒了！我喜欢游泳。

translation.en: Are you going to buy a bicycle ?
translation.zh: 你打算买一辆自行车吗？

translation.en: I ’ m thinking about it . How much is it ?
translation.zh: 我正在考虑。多少钱？

translation.en: Oh , dear . It ’ s too expensive . Can you give me a better price ?
translation.zh: 哦，亲爱的。太贵了。能便宜些吗？

translation.en: Your discount is already included . Normally we charge ¥ 400 , but now we can give you a special price . This is our sale period .
translation.zh: 已经给您打折了，平常我们要400元，现在正降价出售。现在是打折季。

translation.en: It ’ s still too much . Can ’ t you make it any cheaper than that ?
translation.zh: 价格还是太贵了，就不能多降点吗？

translation.en: Sorry , but this is the best price . You can ’ t get it any cheaper than here .
translation.zh: 对不起，这是最优惠的价格。你买不到比这里便宜的了。

translation.en: I see . Can I pay by traveler ’ s checks ?
translation.zh: 我懂了。我可以用旅行支票付款吗？

translation.en: I'm afraid you can ’ t . You ’ re welcome to pay in cash .
translation.zh: 恐怕不能。还是用现金吧。

translation.en: Look at the show on TV . I am watching a food show at a very famous seafood restaurant . I really want to eat at that restaurant . I am a seafood lover .
translation.zh: 看电视上的节目。我正在看一家非常有名的海鲜餐馆进行美食秀。我真想去那家餐馆吃饭。我是海鲜爱好者。

translation.en: Speaking of seafood , my mouth is watering . Let's go to the seafood restaurant in our neighborhood .
translation.zh: 说起海鲜，我垂涎欲滴。我们去附近的海鲜餐馆吧。

translation.en: Sound great . Let's go !
translation.zh: 听起来不错。走吧！

translation.en: Look at the crystal clear fridge . You can see so many kinds of seafood in it . They all look very fresh and delicious .
translation.zh: 快看那台晶莹剔透的冰柜。你可以看到里面有很多种海鲜。它们看起来都很新鲜可口。

translation.en: True . I would like to have some salmon sashimi and a roast salmon head .
translation.zh: 是的。我想要一些三文鱼刺身和烤三文鱼头。

translation.en: You sound like a seafood expert . I would like to have some stir-fried squids and steamed shrimps .
translation.zh: 你听起来像个海鲜专家。我想要些炒鱿鱼和蒸虾。

translation.en: You are not too bad as well . I also want to have a steamed lobster . It is really taste like heaven .
translation.zh: 你也不差啊。我还要一个蒸龙虾。简直太美味了。

translation.en: Let's go into the restaurant and find a table to order some food .
translation.zh: 我们去餐厅找张桌子点些食物吧。

translation.en: Wait . Let me tell the lady what we would like to order in front of the seafood fridge first .
translation.zh: 等等。让我先在海鲜柜前告诉那位女士我们要点什么。

translation.en: OK . I will wait for you inside the restaurant
translation.zh: 好的，我在餐厅等你

translation.en: Do you think we should try some deep fried oysters ?
translation.zh: 你觉得我们应该尝尝炸牡蛎吗？

translation.en: Here is the fish counter . Look at the lobsters and crabs . Shall we have some ?
translation.zh: 这是鱼类柜台，看这些龙虾、螃蟹，要买吗？

translation.en: I'm allergic to these things , you know .
translation.zh: 我吃这些东西过敏，你是知道的。

translation.en: Sorry , I forgot . I don ’ t like seafood , neither .
translation.zh: 对不起，我忘了。我也不喜欢海鲜。

translation.en: Let ’ s go over there and get some milk , a couple dozen eggs and some orange juice .
translation.zh: 我们去那边买牛奶、两打鸡蛋和一些橙汁吧。

translation.en: Let's get frozen juice . It is really good . We ’ Ve got enough food . Let ’ s go over to the check-out stand .
translation.zh: 买冰冻橘子汁吧，很好喝的。我们买的这些食品足够了，去出口付款吧。

translation.en: OK . But just let me pick up a bottle of cooking wine and oil as we go by .
translation.zh: 好的。顺路再让我拿一瓶料酒和食用油。

translation.en: Good evening , Saliva . What's that wonderful aroma from your kitchen ? What are you doing now ?
translation.zh: 晚上好，莎莉亚。从你厨房里传来的奇妙香味是什么？你在做什么呀？

translation.en: I am cooking now !
translation.zh: 我正在做饭！

translation.en: Are you good at cooking ?
translation.zh: 你擅长烹饪吗？

translation.en: I have studied its skills recently at a training school . I plan to run a restaurant , so I have to practise cooking !
translation.zh: 我最近在一家培训学校学习烹调技巧，打算开一家餐馆，因此我不得不练习练习。

translation.en: It is a good idea . What dish are you cooking now ? !
translation.zh: 这是个好主意。你现在在做什么菜！

translation.en: I am steaming fish in a pressure cooker . Have you ever tried steamed fish ?
translation.zh: 我用高压锅清蒸鱼。你吃过清蒸鱼吗？

translation.en: Yes , I have . But the taste of steamed fish at that restaurant is not delicious . The fish is not well-done and too salty .
translation.zh: 吃过。但是那家餐馆的清蒸鱼味道不是很可口。鱼肉不太熟且味道太咸。

translation.en: That's the case . I think there is not enough time to steam it and soy sauce is too much .
translation.zh: 原来这样。我认为，清蒸时间不够，且酱油放得太多。

translation.en: I have the same idea as yours .
translation.zh: 我也这么想。

translation.en: It's OK . Please have a taste of it .
translation.zh: 行了。请尝尝我清蒸的鱼。

translation.en: Thank you . Oh , it's very delicious .
translation.zh: 非常感谢。哦，真好吃。

translation.en: Thank you for your praise .
translation.zh: 谢谢你的夸奖。

translation.en: Besides steamed fish , what else are you good at cooking ?
translation.zh: 除了清蒸鱼外，你还有些什么拿手菜呢？

translation.en: I am good at stewing beef with potato , frying chicken , hot and sour soup etc .
translation.zh: 我擅长土豆炖牛肉、炸鸡、酸辣汤等。

translation.en: So many dishes . Next Friday week is my birthday . I would like to invite you to cook for my dinner party , OK ?
translation.zh: 这么多菜。下周五是我生日。我想邀请你为生日晚宴掌勺，行吗？

translation.en: Why not ? It is a good opportunity for me to practise cooking .
translation.zh: 为什么不呢？这是我练习烹饪的好机会。

translation.en: Can I borrow this magazine from you ? It's really interesting and I can't put it down .
translation.zh: 我能向你借这本杂志吗？它真的很有趣，我放不下手了。

translation.en: I am sorry , but I can't lend it to you now , for I haven't finished reading it . If you don't mind , I can lend you some back numbers to you .
translation.zh: 对不起。我现在不能借给你，因为我自己还没看完，你如果不介意，我可以把前几期的借给你看看。

translation.en: That would be very kind of you . By the way , is it a monthly magazine ?
translation.zh: 太谢谢你了。顺便问你一下，这本杂志是月刊吗？

translation.en: No , it is a fortnightly . So , you see , I can get the new one quite soon .
translation.zh: 不是。它是半月刊。所以我很快就能拿到新的一期了。

translation.en: Jim ? Jim ? ... What are you doing in the kitchen ?
translation.zh: 吉姆？吉姆？...你在厨房干什么？

translation.en: Nothing , Mummy . I was hungry so I came here for some milk .
translation.zh: 没什么，妈妈。我饿了，所以来喝点牛奶。

translation.en: Milk ? I thought you didn't like milk .
translation.zh: 牛奶？我以为你不喜欢牛奶。

translation.en: I don't , but I couldn't find anything to eat in the refrigerator .
translation.zh: 我是不喜欢，但是冰箱里没有吃的。

translation.en: Nonsense . There's lots of food in the refrigerator ... What's behind your back ?
translation.zh: 胡说。冰箱里有很多食物...你背后是什么？

translation.en: What are you hiding behind your back ? Let me see .
translation.zh: 你在背后藏什么？让我看看。

translation.en: Promise that you won't get angry .
translation.zh: 保证你不会生气。

translation.en: OK , I promise . What is it ?
translation.zh: 好吧，我保证。是什么？

translation.en: It's a kitty .
translation.zh: 是一只小猫。

translation.en: Oh , Jim . I told you . No pets . It'll make a mess of this house .
translation.zh: 哦，吉姆。我告诉过你。不准养宠物。房子会被弄得一团糟。

translation.en: Please , Mummy . Everybody else in my class keeps a pet . Please , I'll take care of it . It's a good kitty . It'll not bring you any trouble .
translation.zh: 求你了，妈妈。我们班其他人都养宠物了。求你了，我会处理好的。这只猫很乖。不会给你带来任何麻烦。

translation.en: No way . It might belong to somebody else . You can't keep it here .
translation.zh: 不行。它可能是别人养的。你不能把它养在家里。

translation.en: Please , Mummy . I found it this afternoon by the garbage bin . It was starving and looking for something to eat . Please ! You see , it's so cute and tame .
translation.zh: 求你了，妈妈。我今天下午在垃圾桶旁找到的。它很饿，在找东西吃。拜托了！你看，它这么可爱，又温顺。

translation.en: All right . But you have to clean up everything it messes up .
translation.zh: 好吧。但你得把一切都收拾干净。

translation.en: I will . Thank you , Mummy .
translation.zh: 我会的。谢谢你，妈妈。

translation.en: The rent is $ 1500 per month .
translation.zh: 租金是每月1500美元。

translation.en: And how much is the deposit ?
translation.zh: 押金是多少？

translation.en: The deposit is $ 500 .
translation.zh: 押金是500美元。

translation.en: Jeff , look at this listing ! It says there is a cozy studio apartment for rent , and it's only $ 700 per month . What do you think ?
translation.zh: 杰夫，看看这个单子！上面说有一套舒适的公寓出租，每月租金只有700美元。你觉得怎么样？

translation.en: Well I think I can afford that apartment . But are pets allowed ?
translation.zh: 我想我负担得起那套公寓。但是允许养宠物吗？

translation.en: Hmm ... let me look . Yes , it says it's a pet-friendly building .
translation.zh: 呃……让我看看。是的，这套房子接受养宠物。

translation.en: That's great . That means I can bring my cat , Mr . Twinkles . Where is the apartment located ?
translation.zh: 太好了。那意味着我可以带我的猫来，吐温肯先生。公寓在哪里？

translation.en: It says it's located in the suburbs .
translation.zh: 单子上说在郊区。

translation.en: It's located in the suburbs ? Well even though that sounds like a steal , I really want something downtown .
translation.zh: 它位于郊区？好吧，尽管这听起来很划算，但我真的很想住在市中心。

translation.en: OK . Well the problem is that the apartments in the heart of the city are usually more expensive .
translation.zh: 好吧，但是问题是市中心的公寓通常比较贵。

translation.en: I know , that's my problem . What do you think I should do ?
translation.zh: 我知道，那是我的问题。你觉得我该怎么办？

translation.en: Well , maybe you could get a two-bedroom apartment downtown and share the rent with a roommate .
translation.zh: 嗯，也许你可以在市区租一套两居室的公寓，和室友合租。

translation.en: Oh , great idea !
translation.zh: 哦，好主意！

translation.en: May I know where you are going ?
translation.zh: 我可以知道你要去哪里吗？

translation.en: Yes . I want to go to Beijing Hotel .
translation.zh: 嗯。我想去北京饭店。

translation.en: I'm sorry . You are going in the wrong direction .
translation.zh: 很抱歉告诉你。你走错了方向。

translation.en: Oh no ! What shall I do ?
translation.zh: 哦，不！我该怎么办？

translation.en: Don't worry . You can get off at the next stop and go across the street through the overpass . The bus stop is right there .
translation.zh: 别担心。你可以在下一站下车，从天桥过马路。公交站就在那儿。

translation.en: Would you please show me the necklace in the window ?
translation.zh: 请把橱窗里的项链给我看看好吗？

translation.en: Is this the one you want ?
translation.zh: 你想要这条吗？

translation.en: Thanks . What kind of stone is this ?
translation.zh: 谢谢。这是什么宝石？

translation.en: It's a ruby . It is from South Africa . Would you like to try it on ?
translation.zh: 红宝石。来自南非。你想试戴一下吗？

translation.en: Yes , please . How much is it ?
translation.zh: 好的，谢谢。这多少钱？

translation.en: It costs $ 200 .
It looks good . OK . I'll take it .
translation.zh: 看起来不错。好的，我买了。

translation.en: I'm looking for a string of pearls for my wife .
translation.zh: 我想为我妻子买一串珍珠。

translation.en: Yes , sir . What price range do you have in mind ?
translation.zh: 好的，先生。你想要什么样的价位的？

translation.en: I'm not sure . I don't know very much about the price of pearls .
translation.zh: 我不确定。我不太了解珍珠的价格。

translation.en: I see . Let me show you some samples of various qualities . This one is very nice . It's three hundred and fifty dollars .
translation.zh: 这样啊。那我给你看不同等级的样品。这串很好看，价格是350美元。

translation.en: We are having a sale now . The price has already gone down .
translation.zh: 我们正在打折，价钱已经降低了。

translation.en: How much is that one ?
translation.zh: 那个多少钱？

translation.en: It's two hundred and eighty dollars .
OK . I'll take it . Thank you .
translation.zh: 好的，我要了。非常感谢。

translation.en: Food is less expensive in a cafeteria , because you serve yourself .
translation.zh: 在自助餐厅里食物很便宜，因为您自己为自己服务。

translation.en: How to do it ?
translation.zh: 怎么做？

translation.en: Just pick up a tray , then put a knife , a fork , a spoon and a paper napkin on it and stand in the line .
translation.zh: 先拿着餐盘，放上刀叉、汤匙和餐巾纸，然后去排队。

translation.en: How long will it take to reach the buffet ?
translation.zh: 要花多长时间到达食品柜台呢？

translation.en: Not long , because people rush for lunch .
translation.zh: 不长，因为人们赶着吃午饭。

translation.en: The line sure does move fast .
translation.zh: 队伍的确移动得很快。

translation.en: Tell the man behind the counter what you want .
translation.zh: 您要什么就告诉柜台后边的男服务员。

translation.en: OK . I like that green vegetable but I don't know how to call it .
translation.zh: 好的。我喜欢那种绿色的蔬菜，但不知它叫什么。

translation.en: Just point to it if you don't know the name .
translation.zh: 如果您不知道菜名，就用手指一下。

translation.en: It's quit a big cafeteria , isn't it ?
translation.zh: 这是一家大自助餐厅，不是吗？

translation.en: Sure . I usually have my lunch here . The food is tasty and they offer a big variety .
translation.zh: 是的。我经常在这里吃午饭。食物很好吃，而且种类也多。

translation.en: Let's line up . The steak is very inviting . I'll have it .
translation.zh: 我们排队吧。这牛排很诱人。我想吃。

translation.en: I'll have ham and egg with French fries . What dessert do you want ?
translation.zh: 我要火腿蛋配薯条。你想要什么甜点？

translation.en: Banana pie .
translation.zh: 香蕉派。

translation.en: Where shall we sit ?
translation.zh: 我们坐在哪里？

translation.en: How about there ?
translation.zh: 那里怎么样？

translation.en: Hello . Could you have a taxi pick me up before 10:00 a . m . ?
translation.zh: 可以在下午1点之前派辆出租车送我去机场吗？

translation.en: What is your address ?
translation.zh: 你的地址是什么？

translation.en: I stay at No . 115 Fucking Road .
translation.zh: 我住在友谊宾馆1106房间。

translation.en: OK , a taxi will be there by 9:30 .
translation.zh: 好，九点半之前会有出租车到。

translation.en: It is RIB 10 yuan initially and 2 yuan for each kilometer .
translation.zh: 起价10元，每公里2元。

translation.en: I have a lot of luggage . Will those fit in the taxi ?
translation.zh: 我有很多行李。这些能装在出租车里吗？

translation.en: Take it easy . I'll send a larger to pick you up .
translation.zh: 别担心。我会派人来接你。

translation.en: I have learnt how to ride a bicycle . I plan to go to the Water Park by bike this weekend .
translation.zh: 我学会了骑自行车。我打算这个周末骑自行车去水上公园。

translation.en: Well , you know , the traffic in Beijing is sometimes dangerous . Therefore , I have to remind you of something . First , you should obey the traffic rules , don't break in the red light . Second , don't play a joke with your friends when riding on the bike . Third , do not hurry up when riding , or would make an accident . Finally , remember come on the left and go on the right !
translation.zh: 嗯，你知道，北京的交通有时很危险。因此，我不得不提醒你。首先，你要遵守交通规则，不要闯红灯。第二，骑车时不要和朋友玩耍。第三，骑车不要急，否则会出事故。最后，要记住来左去右！

translation.en: Oh , my dear sister , I am no longer a baby !
translation.zh: 哦，亲爱的姐姐，我已经不是小孩了！

translation.en: Good afternoon , sir . Have you made a reservation ?
translation.zh: 下午好，先生。你预订了吗？

translation.en: I am afraid not . Are there any vacant tables ?
translation.zh: 没有。有空桌子吗？

translation.en: I don't think so . You have to wait for about 10 minutes .
translation.zh: 现在没有。你得等大约10分钟。

translation.en: Hey , taxi .
translation.zh: 嘿，出租车。

translation.en: Beijing Library .
translation.zh: 北京图书馆。

translation.en: Hop in , please .
translation.zh: 请上车。

translation.en: Is it a long ride to Beijing Library ?
translation.zh: 去北京图书馆要很久吗？

translation.en: It will take about thirty minutes because it is the rush hour .
translation.zh: 因为现在是交通高峰期，大约需要三十分钟。

translation.en: Thirty minutes , that will be all right . There are still fifty minutes to go before the library is open . Look , what are they doing on the square ?
translation.zh: 三十分钟就可以了。离图书馆开门还有五十分钟。看，他们在广场上干什么？

translation.en: It is an exhibition of Chinese jades . It is held each year . A nice collection jades of are on display and sold .
translation.zh: 这是一个中国玉器展。每年举行一次，展销一些精美的玉器。

translation.en: Sounds great ! Can you stop somewhere here for a minute ? I will get some souvenirs for my friends .
translation.zh: 听起来很棒！您能在附近停下车么？我要给我的朋友买些纪念品。

translation.en: Can I have the window seat over there ?
translation.zh: 我能坐那边靠窗的座位吗？

translation.en: Sorry , sir . That table has been booked .
translation.zh: 对不起，先生。那张桌子已经被订了。

translation.en: Well , in that case , this table is the only choice .
translation.zh: 好吧，那样的话，这张桌子是唯一的选择。

translation.en: Actually you can have a window seat if you don't mind a ten-minute wait .
translation.zh: 实际上，如果你不介意等十分钟的话，你可以坐到靠窗的座位。

translation.en: There is no need . Thanks .
translation.zh: 没必要。谢谢。

translation.en: Hello . This is Mrs . Wilson . I'd like to buy a new car . Could you offer me a new type of the car , please ?
translation.zh: 你好。我是威尔逊太太。我想买一辆新车。能帮我找辆新车吗？

translation.en: Oh , Madam , buy what ?
translation.zh: 哦，夫人，您想买什么？

translation.en: A new car . And I've got a small family , two children , and I haven't got a lot of money and ...
translation.zh: 一辆新车。我有一个小家庭，两个孩子，我预算不是很多...

translation.en: Oh , oh , Madam , Madam , I'm afraid you have the wrong number .
translation.zh: 噢，噢，夫人，夫人，恐怕您打错电话了。

translation.en: Isn't this the car store ?
translation.zh: 这不是汽车店吗？

translation.en: No . It's Mike's Sporting Goods .
translation.zh: 不。是迈克运动用品店。

translation.en: Oh , sorry . Do you know the number for a car store , then ?
translation.zh: 哦，对不起。那你知道汽车店的电话号码吗？

translation.en: No . I don't . I suggest you look in the phone book .
translation.zh: 我不知道。我建议你查一下电话簿。

translation.en: Excuse me , waiter , I would like to have some wine before the main course .
translation.zh: 对不起，服务员，我想在上主菜前喝点酒。

translation.en: Have you decided what wine you would like ?
translation.zh: 你决定好要什么酒了吗？

translation.en: I have no idea . Maybe you can give me some advice .
translation.zh: 我不知道。也许你能给我一些建议。

translation.en: I recommend you the white wine . It will wake up your appetite .
translation.zh: 我向你推荐白葡萄酒。能引起你的食欲。

translation.en: That's great , bring me a bottle of that please .
translation.zh: 太好了，请给我拿瓶来。

translation.en: Excuse me , I ordered the well-done steak , but this one is so tough .
translation.zh: 打扰一下，我点的是全熟的牛排，但是这个太硬了。

translation.en: Well , sir , I think I have made a mistake . I will take it back to the kitchen right now .
translation.zh: 先生，我想我弄错了。我马上把它带回厨房。

translation.en: I think you should be more careful next time .
translation.zh: 我想你下次应该更加小心。

translation.en: Yes , sir . I'm really so sorry about that .
translation.zh: 好的，先生。我真的很抱歉。

translation.en: Good afternoon , how may I help you ?
translation.zh: 下午好，我能为您效劳吗

translation.en: Hi , I'd like to order some flowers .
translation.zh: 嗨，我想订一些花

translation.en: Who are they for ?
translation.zh: 它们是给谁的

translation.en: They're for my Wife . Her name is Samantha .
translation.zh: 是给我妻子的。她叫萨曼莎。

translation.en: What kind of flowers would you like ?
translation.zh: 你想要什么样的花？

translation.en: I don't know . I don't know too much about flowers . Can you recommend something ?
translation.zh: 我不知道。我对花知之甚少。你能推荐一些吗？

translation.en: OK . What's the reason you are sending her flowers ?
translation.zh: 好的。你为什么送她花？

translation.en: Today's her birthday and she told me she wants me to buy her flowers .
translation.zh: 今天是她的生日，她告诉我她要我给她买花。

translation.en: Do you know what kind of flowers she likes ?
translation.zh: 你知道她喜欢什么样的花吗？

translation.en: I'm not sure . I know I should know that , but I can't remember right now .
translation.zh: 我不确定。我想我本来知道的，但我现在不记得了。

translation.en: Well , they're for your wife , so I think you should give her roses .
translation.zh: 嗯，这是给你妻子的，所以我想你应该送她玫瑰。

translation.en: Roses will be fine .
translation.zh: 玫瑰就可以了。

translation.en: What color ?
translation.zh: 什么颜色（比较好呢？）

translation.en: I think red would be nice .
translation.zh: 我想红色会很好。

translation.en: Do you want to pick them up or should we deliver them ?
translation.zh: 你是想现在带走还是我们送过去呢？

translation.en: Can you deliver them , please ?
translation.zh: 你能（帮我）把它们送过去吗？

translation.en: What's the address ?
translation.zh: 地址是哪里？

translation.en: 241 Main street .
translation.zh: 主街241号。

translation.en: Professor Li , do you know where to buy art supplies ?
translation.zh: 李教授，你知道在哪里买艺术用品吗？

translation.en: For what ? Are you taking up painting ?
translation.zh: 用来干什么？你开始画画了吗？

translation.en: No . I can't paint . I'm asking for my niece . She is really into it .
translation.zh: 没有。我不会画画。我给我侄女找的。她真的很喜欢。

translation.en: Oh , good . How old is your niece ?
translation.zh: 哦，很好。你侄女多大了？

translation.en: She is eight . Actually , I'm buying a good set of art supplies for her as a birthday gift .
translation.zh: 她八岁了。实际上，我要给她买一套很好的艺术用品作为生日礼物。

translation.en: It's a wise thing to do . Art will do a child a world of good .
translation.zh: 这样做是明智的。艺术会给孩子带来一个美好的世界。

translation.en: No , thank you . Check , please .
translation.zh: 不用了，谢谢。请给我账单。

translation.en: Wait a moment . I will calculate it for you . Your bill comes to $ 36 .
translation.zh: 稍等片刻。我给你算一下。你的账单是36美元。

translation.en: Here are $ 40 . Keep the change . That's my tip for you .
translation.zh: 这是40美元。不用找了。这是我给你的小费。

translation.en: Do you want to help me make the cookies , Anna ?
translation.zh: 安娜，你想帮我做饼干吗？

translation.en: First , put away your toys .
translation.zh: 首先，把你的玩具收起来。

translation.en: I'll get the flour out .
translation.zh: 我去把面粉拿出来。

translation.en: You are an early bird , Tom . What do you do in the morning then ?
translation.zh: 汤姆，你通常起得很早。那么早起都做些什么呢？

translation.en: Exercise . The morning hours are the most precious period within a single day . We should not pass them up easily . Seize the time and do something useful .
translation.zh: 锻炼。早晨是一天当中最美好的时光.我们不该轻易放过。要充分利用时间，做点有用的事情。

translation.en: So , you choose to spend it on bodybuilding . Where do you exercise ?
translation.zh: 所以，你把时间花在晨练上了。那你都在哪儿锻炼呢？

translation.en: Usually , I run to the Black Bamboo Park as a warm-up . Admission is free . Then I start my activities .
translation.zh: 通常我跑步去紫竹院，正好热热身。那里不用买门票.然后才开始我的活动。

translation.en: Do you do the same exercises every day ?
translation.zh: 你每天做同样的运动吗？

translation.en: No , I've deliberately kept a balance between various exercises ; parallel bars , push-ups , sit-ups , bunny-hops , five-kilometer run , and so on . I alternate them over the weekdays . Sometimes , when I find myself in a bad state , I will simply idle about in the park .
translation.zh: 不是的。我有意在多项运动之间保持平衡。双杠、俯卧撑、仰卧起坐、兔子跳、五公里跑等等。我在工作日交替使用。有时，当我发现自己状态不好时，我会在公园里闲逛。

translation.en: Why don't you just stay in bed when you are feeling unfit for exercising ?
translation.zh: 当你觉得不适合锻炼时，为什么不躺在床上呢？

translation.en: It's not easy to keep a good habit , you know . I fear that if I fail to get up early one day , I may find it still more difficult to rise early the next . Besides , a mere walk in the early morning is much fun , too . Here and there in the park , you meet whole gangs of senior citizens who might be singing operas or old songs , playing er'hu , chess , or just chatting and gossiping . It's interesting to join them .
translation.zh: 你知道，保持一种习惯不容易。我担心的是，哪天我要没能早起，第二天早上恐怕就更难早起了。再说，清晨走一走也是乐趣多多。在公园里四处走走，总能碰上一群老年人，在唱戏或者其他老歌，拉二胡，下棋，或者只是闲聊.跟他们在一起也挺有意思。

translation.en: Oh , yes . Singing is also a good way of keeping fit , at least mentally .
translation.zh: 哦，是的。唱歌也是保持健康的好方法，至少在精神上是这样。

translation.en: I think Yoga might be suitable for me .
translation.zh: 我想瑜伽可能比较适合我。

translation.en: Because it doesn't require a lot of energy and thus easy to keep up .
translation.zh: 因为那不用花很大力气，所以很容易坚持。

translation.en: But I see people sweat a lot doing Yoga too .
translation.zh: 但我看到人们在做瑜伽时也会流汗。

translation.en: I don't know . I just need to try it once . I'm in urgent need of some exercise to lose some weight .
translation.zh: 我不知道。我就是需要试一次。我迫切地需要做些运动减减肥。

translation.en: You should try swimming then . It helps you to keep fit .
translation.zh: 那你应该试试游泳。游泳会帮助你保持身材。

translation.en: I'm interested in Chinese antiques .
translation.zh: 我对中国古董感兴趣。

translation.en: We have a great variety of Chinese antiques . Besides , we have landscape painting , figure painting and flower-and-bird painting .
translation.zh: 我们有各种各样的中国古董。此外，我们还有山水画、人物画和花鸟画。

translation.en: How about this picture of cranes with pine trees ? It was painted by a famous Chinese painter in King Dynasty .
translation.zh: 这张有松树的仙鹤图怎么样？它是中国一位著名画家在王朝时画的。

translation.en: Oh , they look just like live cranes .
translation.zh: 哦，它们看起来就像活的仙鹤。

translation.en: And what is more , in traditional Chinese thinking , cranes and pine trees symbolize longevity .
translation.zh: 更重要的是，在中国传统思想中，鹤和松树象征着长寿。

translation.en: What can I show you ?
translation.zh: 我能给你看什么吗？

translation.en: Do you have this shirt in a small ?
translation.zh: 这件衬衫有小号的吗？

translation.en: Let me check . Yes , we have .
translation.zh: 让我查一下。是的，我们有。

translation.en: Sure . Let me help you .
translation.zh: 当然。我来帮你。

translation.en: I'd like to speak to Michael Baker , please .
translation.zh: 我想和迈克尔·贝克通话。

translation.en: I'm sorry , Mr . Baker is not in . May I take a message ?
translation.zh: 对不起，先生。贝克现在不在。我可以帮你捎个口信吗？

translation.en: Yes.Tell him Mr.Cook called and ask him to return my call soon as he gets back .
translation.zh: 是的。告诉他库克先生来过电话，让他一回来就给我回电话。

translation.en: All right , Mr . Cook . I'll have Mr . Baker call you back as soon as he gets here .
translation.zh: 好的，库克先生。贝克先生一到这儿，我就让他就给你回电话。

translation.en: You're made a good choice . This china tea set is unusual .
translation.zh: 你眼光不错。这套瓷器茶很不一般。

translation.en: Where was it from ?
translation.zh: 来自哪里？

translation.en: It was made in Jingdezhen .
translation.zh: 是景德镇制造的。

translation.en: Jingdezhen ? Isn't it called ' the capital of porcelain ' ?
translation.zh: 景德镇？不是叫“瓷都”吗？

translation.en: This is the very thing I've been dreaming of .
translation.zh: 这正是我想要的。

translation.en: It is the best quality porcelain-the famous egg-shell China .
translation.zh: 它是质量最好的瓷器——著名的薄胎瓷。

translation.en: It must be most precious .
translation.zh: 它一定是最珍贵的。

translation.en: But it is really worth the price .
translation.zh: 但它真的值这个价。

translation.en: I find that you spend little on handset charge every month . Have you any trick ?
translation.zh: 我发现你每月花不了多少手机费，有什么窍门吗？

translation.en: It's simple . You can use call transfer .
translation.zh: 很简单，用呼叫转移就行了。

translation.en: Is it so simple ?
translation.zh: 这么简单吗？

translation.en: Sure . You know , we spend most of our time at home or in the office every day , so I receive handset calls with the hand-free telephone , so I need pay little for receiving calls .
translation.zh: 那当然了。想想看，我们每天大多数的时间都待在家中或办公室中，我通过固定电话来接手机电话，几乎所有的通话都不付费。

translation.en: It's true .
translation.zh: 确实如此。

translation.en: Call transfer has many other advantages . When I am in places where network can't cover , such as the high building , I also use call transfer function , which transfers my calls to the hand-free telephone and I will not miss any call .
translation.zh: 呼叫转移还有其他好处。有时候在高层建筑等网络覆盖不到的地方，我也使用呼叫转移功能，将来电转至固定电话上，这样来电就不会错过了。

translation.en: In hospitals or on planes , handsets will interfere with some equip-ment , so we must close our handsets . If you set call transfer , the problem will be solved .
translation.zh: 在医院里、飞机上使用手机可能干扰一些设备，我们必须将手机关闭。如果你设置了呼叫转移，问题就解决了。

translation.en: Can I have the roll of film developed here ?
translation.zh: 我能在这里冲洗胶卷吗？

translation.en: Here is the film . Can I get my pictures tomorrow ?
translation.zh: 这是交卷。我明天能拿到照片吗？

translation.en: Besides I want two copies of all the photos .
translation.zh: 另外，所有照片我都要两份。

translation.en: Would you please fill some gas for me ?
translation.zh: 请给我加点油好吗？

translation.en: Sure . Which kind of gas do you want ?
translation.zh: 当然。你要哪种汽油？

translation.en: Unleaded , please .
translation.zh: 请给我无铅的。

translation.en: Hello , this is Liu Juan speaking . Is that Mr . Brown ?
translation.zh: 你好，我是刘娟。请问是布朗先生吗？

translation.en: No , this isn't .
translation.zh: 不，我不是。

translation.en: Could you please get him on the phone ?
translation.zh: 请问你能将电话给他吗？

translation.en: Sure . Wait a minute .
translation.zh: 当然。稍等一下。

translation.en: Yes . I'll have the shrimp cocktail to start .
translation.zh: 对。我要一杯鸡尾酒。

translation.en: I'll have a steak , medium rare .
translation.zh: 我要一份牛排，五分熟。

translation.en: Yes . I'd like a cup of onion soup .
translation.zh: 对。我想要一杯洋葱汤。

translation.en: And what would you like after that ?
translation.zh: 然后您还想要什么？

translation.en: I'd like the roast chicken , please .
translation.zh: 我想要烤鸡。

translation.en: Can I get my dress today ?
translation.zh: 我今天能买衣服吗？

translation.en: You have ordered a red dress , is that right ?
translation.zh: 你订了一条红裙子，对吗？

translation.en: Yes . Is that available now ?
translation.zh: 对。现在有吗？

translation.en: Yes , here you are . Try it in front of the mirror .
translation.zh: 是的，给你。在镜子前试试吧。

translation.en: What can I do for you , miss ?
translation.zh: 小姐，有什么事吗？

translation.en: I am looking for a pair of shoes .
translation.zh: 我想挑一双鞋。

translation.en: Do you like high heels or flat shoes ?
translation.zh: 你喜欢高跟鞋还是平底鞋？

translation.en: High hells , please . I want to wear them in formal situations .
translation.zh: 高跟鞋。我想在正式场合穿。

translation.en: Yes . I want to buy a pair of shoes .
translation.zh: 对。我想买一双鞋。

translation.en: Have you a pattern in your mind ?
translation.zh: 你有什么想法吗？

translation.en: Well , maybe sneakers or rubber shoes .
translation.zh: 嗯，也许是运动鞋或胶鞋。

translation.en: Is there any special brand you would like ?
translation.zh: 您想要什么特别的牌子吗？

translation.en: Could I have look at that pair of canvas shoes ? They look nice .
translation.zh: 我能看看那双帆布鞋吗？它们看起来不错。

translation.en: I will take it . How much ?
translation.zh: 我要了。多少钱？

translation.en: I am sure you can do better than that .
translation.zh: 我相信价格能更低。

translation.en: Sorry , sir . It's the sale price .
translation.zh: 对不起，先生。这就是销售价格。

translation.en: Well , what about $ 70 with a scarf ?
translation.zh: 那么，70美元行吗，加送一条围巾？

translation.en: It's my rock bottom price . Take it or leave it .
translation.zh: 这已经是最低价了。你要么接受，要么不买。

translation.en: My dear , what's for supper ?
translation.zh: 亲爱的，晚饭吃什么？

translation.en: Red cooked carp and rape with fresh mushrooms .
translation.zh: 红烧鲤鱼和鲜蘑油菜。

translation.en: What about soup ?
translation.zh: 汤呢？

translation.en: Sour-peppery soup .
translation.zh: 酸辣汤。

translation.en: Which condiment do you use for ?
translation.zh: 你用什么调味品？

translation.en: I'll use ginger , garlic scallion , hot pepper and vinegar .
translation.zh: 我要姜、蒜、葱、辣椒和醋。

translation.en: Very good , need I help you ?
translation.zh: 很好，需要我帮忙吗？

translation.en: No , don't need , I can do myself .
translation.zh: 不，不需要，我自己可以。

translation.en: Thanks . I can watch TV now .
translation.zh: 谢谢。我现在可以看电视了。

translation.en: But you must cook that dinner next time .
translation.zh: 不过，下次你得做正餐。

translation.en: Okay , I'll do it next time .
translation.zh: 好的，我下次一定做。

translation.en: Let me see . The bell-bottom pants are $ 90 and the coat is $ 120 . It comes to $ 210 .
translation.zh: 我看一下，喇叭裤90美元，外套120美元。总共210美元。

translation.en: Is it possible for you to reduce the price ?
translation.zh: 你们能便宜点吗？

translation.en: I am sorry . It's a one-price shop .
translation.zh: 很抱歉。我们是一口价商店。

translation.en: I would like to buy a bottle of cleansing milk.Can you recommend me some kinds ?
translation.zh: 我想买一瓶洁面乳，你能给我推荐几种吗？

translation.en: Sure . What kind of skin do you have ?
translation.zh: 当然。你是什么样的肤质？

translation.en: My skin is oily .
translation.zh: 我的皮肤是油性的。

translation.en: Then I advise you to buy the LAY cleansing milk .
translation.zh: 那我建议你去买LAY洗面奶。

translation.en: Can you tell me more ?
translation.zh: 你能告诉我信息吗？

translation.en: It's the latest and quite popular among young people .
translation.zh: 这是最新款，在年轻人中很流行。

translation.en: Yes , I know and I like it very much . I will take it .
translation.zh: 是的，我知道，我非常喜欢。我要了。

translation.en: Sure . Here is your receipt .
translation.zh: 好的。这是您的收据。

translation.en: How long is this cell phone guaranteed ?
translation.zh: 这部手机保修期多久？

translation.en: You can refund it in 7 days and exchange it in one year .
translation.zh: 您可以在7天内退货，一年内换货。

translation.en: Excuse me . I bought this shirt yesterday , but I would like to refund it .
translation.zh: 打扰一下，我昨天买了这件衬衣，但我想退款。

translation.en: Gave me the receipt , please .
translation.zh: 请给我您的发票。

translation.en: Here is my receipt .
translation.zh: 这是我的发票。

translation.en: It's too small for me to wear .
translation.zh: 我穿上太小了。

translation.en: Would you like another bigger one ?
translation.zh: 要换件大点的吗？

translation.en: No thanks . I want to have a refund .
translation.zh: 不用了，谢谢。我想退货。

translation.en: OK , here is your money .
translation.zh: 好的，给您钱。

translation.en: Is this a duty-free shop ?
translation.zh: 这是免税店吗？

translation.en: I want to buy some specialties . Can you recommend me some ?
translation.zh: 我想买些特产。你能给我推荐一些吗？

translation.en: Sure . I strongly advise you to buy a bottle of perfume and a lighter .
translation.zh: 当然。我强烈建议你买瓶香水和打火机。

translation.en: Fine . They look nice . I will take both of them .
translation.zh: 好的。它们看起来不错。两个我都要了。

translation.en: May I have a look at your passport , please ?
translation.zh: 我可以看一下你的护照吗？

translation.en: Excuse me , could you give me change for a dollar ?
translation.zh: 打扰一下，你能给我换一美元的零钱吗？

translation.en: I'll see what I have . What do you need it for ?
translation.zh: 我看看我有没有。你要它干什么？

translation.en: I want to get cigarettes .
translation.zh: 我想买香烟。

translation.en: You can use quarters , dimes and nickels .
translation.zh: 你可以用25美分，10美分和5美分买。

translation.en: Yesterday I had a quarrel with my roommate . I'm really fed up with all this .
translation.zh: 昨天我和室友吵架了。我真的受够了。

translation.en: Tell me what seems to be the problem .
translation.zh: 怎么了。

translation.en: My roommate always brings a lot of friends from off-campus . They stay in the room until midnight , singing and talking , drinking and playing cards while I have no place for study . I even don't have the quietness to sleep .
translation.zh: 我的室友总是带很多校外朋友回来。他们一直呆到午夜，唱歌聊天，喝酒打牌。我没有地方学习，甚至无法安静地睡觉。

translation.en: Did you ever talk to him about it ?
translation.zh: 你跟他谈过吗？

translation.en: Excuse me . How much is the chocolate bar ?
translation.zh: 打扰一下。巧克力多少钱？

translation.en: So , I can have five for five dollars ?
translation.zh: 那么，五块钱我可以买五块？

translation.en: Actually , you can only have four .
translation.zh: 实际上，你只能买四块。

translation.en: Oh , yeah . I forgot tax . Give me four then , please .
translation.zh: 哦，是的。我忘记交税了。那么请给我四块。

translation.en: Have you any round-neck sweater ?
translation.zh: 你们有圆领毛衣吗？

translation.en: Yes . Actually our range of sweaters is the most comprehensive available .
translation.zh: 对。实际上我们的毛衣系列是最全面的。

translation.en: Can I try this one on ?
translation.zh: 我能试试这件吗？

translation.en: The color is too bright.For my age , I would prefer a lighter color .
translation.zh: 颜色太亮了。就我的年龄而言，我更喜欢浅一点的颜色。

translation.en: Have you declared your income and are you prepared to pay tax ?
translation.zh: 你已申报收入并准备好纳税了吗？

translation.en: Not yet . I don't know how to fill out the form . What is the tax-free allowance for supporting a dependent ?
translation.zh: 还没有。我不知道怎么填这个表格。另外，每个被抚养人的免税津贴额度是多少？

translation.en: I don't really know . Why not ask the accountant or the lawyer of the law firm ? They will tell you which is subject or not subject to taxation . He can even help you avoid paying tax legally .
translation.zh: 我还真不知道。为什么不问一问律师事务所的会计专家或律师呢？他们会告诉你哪些该交税，哪些不该。甚至还可以帮你合法避税。

translation.en: If I don't pay my taxes , would the tax officials discover it ?
translation.zh: 若我不交税，税务官会发现吗？

translation.en: Certainly . No one who evades tax can escape from their detection.They ' ll check your income through computers . You'd better make a declaration to the tax authorities as soon as possible . If you fail to meet the deadline , you will be fined .
translation.zh: 当然了。任何人逃税都逃不过他们的侦察。他们会通过计算机核查你的收入。你应该尽快向税务机关申报并缴税。如果你错过了截止日期，会遭到罚款处理的。

translation.en: Excuse me . Check please .
translation.zh: 打扰一下，请查收。

translation.en: OK , how was everything ?
translation.zh: 好了，一切都好吗？

translation.en: Very nice . Thank you .
translation.zh: 非常好。多谢各位。

translation.en: Would you like this to-go ?
translation.zh: 你想把这个拿走吗？

translation.en: Yes , can you put it in a plastic bag ?
translation.zh: 是的，你能把它放在塑料袋里吗？

translation.en: Sure , no problem . Here you are . That'll be 25 dollars .
translation.zh: 当然，没问题。给你。25美元。

translation.en: Yes , we accept Visa and MasterCard .
translation.zh: 是的，我们接受维萨卡和万事达卡。

translation.en: Thanks . I'll be right back .
translation.zh: 谢谢。我马上回来。

translation.en: You're welcome . Please come again .
translation.zh: 不客气。请再来。

translation.en: Do you have sport shirts for ladies ?
translation.zh: 有女士运动衫吗？

translation.en: There are different types . Which one do you like best ?
translation.zh: 有不同的类型。你最喜欢哪一件？

translation.en: I think the red one fits me well . Can I try it on ?
translation.zh: 我觉得这件红色的很适合我。我能试穿一下吗？

translation.en: It's there , near the mirror .
translation.zh: 就在那儿，镜子那儿。

translation.en: I want to buy a black suit .
translation.zh: 我想买一套黑色西装。

translation.en: Certainty.Do you want double breasted suit or single breasted suit ?
translation.zh: 当然可以。你要双排扣西装还是单排扣西装？

translation.en: I prefer single breasted suit .
translation.zh: 我喜欢单排扣西装。

translation.en: What about this one ? It's a very nice 3 - piece suit .
translation.zh: 这个怎么样？这是一套非常漂亮的三件套西装。

translation.en: That looks great . Do you have ties here ?
translation.zh: 看起来不错。这里有领带吗？

translation.en: How do you spend your day , Helen ?
translation.zh: 海伦，你这一天是怎么过？

translation.en: Well , on weekdays I get up around ten . Then I read the paper for an hour and have lunch at about noon .
translation.zh: 嗯，工作日我大约十点起床。然后我看了一个小时的报纸，中午吃午饭。

translation.en: Really ? What time do you go to work ?
translation.zh: 真的？你什么时候工作？

translation.en: I start work at three .
translation.zh: 我三点开始工作。

translation.en: And when do you get home at night ?
translation.zh: 你晚上什么时回家？

translation.en: I get home pretty late , around midnight .
translation.zh: 我回家很晚，大约午夜吧。

translation.en: So what do you do , exactly ?
translation.zh: 你到底是做什么工作的？

translation.en: I'm a TV announcer . Don't you recognize me ? I do the weather report on KNT !
translation.zh: 我是电视播音员。你不认识我吗？我在KNT播报天气预报！

translation.en: Gee , I'm sorry . I don't watch TV .
translation.zh: 哎呀，对不起。我不看电视。

translation.en: You're really fit , Paul . Do you exercise very much ?
translation.zh: 你真的很健康，保罗。你经常锻炼吗？

translation.en: Well , I almost always get up very early , and I lift weights for an hour .
translation.zh: 嗯，我总是起得很早，练习一个小时举重。

translation.en: No . And then I often go Rollerblading .
translation.zh: 不是。然后我经常去溜冰。

translation.en: Wow ! How often do you exercise like that ?
translation.zh: 哇！你多久做一次这样的运动？

translation.en: About five times a week . What about you ?
translation.zh: 大约一周五次。你呢？

translation.en: Oh , I hardly ever exercise . I usually just watch TV in my free time . I guess I'm a real couch potato !
translation.zh: 哦，我几乎从不锻炼。我通常只是在空闲时间看电视。我想我真是个电视迷！

translation.en: I called HP about my computer .
translation.zh: 我给惠普公司打电话询问我的电脑出了什么问题。

translation.en: They said I need a new hard drive .
translation.zh: 他们说我需要买一个新硬盘。

translation.en: That's too bad . How much is a new one ?
translation.zh: 那太糟了。一个新硬盘多少钱？

translation.en: It's not too much , only about $ 85 .
translation.zh: 不算太多，只要85美元左右。

translation.en: Plus installation ?
translation.zh: 加上了安装费吗？

translation.en: No , my hard drive is easy to remove and replace .
translation.zh: 没有安装费，我的硬盘很容易拆卸和更换。

translation.en: Yes , it's just a couple of screws .
translation.zh: 是的，只要卸几个螺丝而已。

translation.en: It's a lot better than paying someone $ 60 .
translation.zh: 比付给别人60美元要好得多。

translation.en: If my hard drive crashes , I'll just call you .
translation.zh: 如果我的硬盘坏了，我就打电话请你帮忙。

translation.en: Gosh , it's 7:30 , I'll miss the first class .
translation.zh: 天哪，七点半了，我要错过第一节课了。

translation.en: Don't get up so late next time . You should have gone to bed earlier last night .
translation.zh: 下次别起得这么晚。你昨晚应该早点睡觉的。

translation.en: Good evening , madam . Can I help you ?
translation.zh: 晚上好，夫人。需要帮忙吗？

translation.en: Yes . I bought this sheet here yesterday .
translation.zh: 是的。我昨天在这里买了这张床单。

translation.en: Yes . When I spread it out back home , I found this hole .
translation.zh: 是的。当我回家把它打开时，我发现了这个洞。

translation.en: Oh , how awful ! May I have a look at the invoice ?
translation.zh: 哦，真糟糕！我可以看一下发票吗？

translation.en: Well . please accept our sincere apologies , I'll be glad to change it for another one if you wish .
translation.zh: 嗯。请接受我们诚挚的歉意，如果您愿意，我们可以给您换一个。

translation.en: That's very kind of you . Thank you .
translation.zh: 你真是太好了。非常感谢。

translation.en: We're sorry that this has happened , and I guarantee that the same mistake won't happen again .
translation.zh: 我们很抱歉发生了这样的事情，我保证同样的错误不会再发生了。

translation.en: The last thing to be ignored at a Chinese dinner table is to keep modest .
translation.zh: 在中国人的餐桌上，最不可忽视的是保持谦虚。

translation.en: Does that suggest diners avoid speaking much ? The same is true in the West .
translation.zh: 这是否意味着吃饭时应避免多说话？西方也是这样。

translation.en: No , absolutely not ! On the contrary , you'll be considered a well-connected , sociable man , if you keep involved in the conversation all the time . But always pay attention to what you say . If the table has a senior guest , say something as upbeat and cheerful as possible . Or maybe , you may give the floor to him and keep listening as if very interested .
translation.zh: 不，不是！恰恰相反，如果你一直参与谈话，你就会被认为是一个人脉很好、善于交际的人。但要注意你说的话。如果桌上有一位长者，尽可能说些乐观愉快的话。或者，你可以请他发言，听他讲话，要表现的很感兴趣。

translation.en: You mean , keeping a low profile in the presence of the old ? That goes in like with Confucius ' preachings , right ?
translation.zh: 你是说，在长者面前保持谦虚？这和孔子的教诲是一样的，对吧？

translation.en: Correct . Show respect for the older people . Conventionally , before the meal starts , the younger members are supposed to address each one of the elderly members of the table one by one . Others are kept in waiting until the most venerable guest proclaim the beginning of the meal and takes the first bite . Toasts also go to these men first before people can toast to each other .
translation.zh: 对的，尊重长者。按照惯例，在用餐开始前，年轻人应该向桌上的每一个长者问好。最尊贵的客人宣布开始用餐并吃第一口前，其他人要一直等待。在人们互相敬酒之前，也要先向长者敬酒。

translation.en: Any other rules to observe in order to keep modest ?
translation.zh: 想要保持谦虚，还有其他规矩要遵守吗？

translation.en: Yes , plenty of them . Don't eat fast ! People usually keep their dining pace accorded with others . And all the dishes should not be eaten up completely .
translation.zh: 是的，还有很多。别吃得太快！人们通常保持与别人一致的用餐节奏。也不要把所有的菜都吃光。

translation.en: Is it because that would give the host the impression that the food was insufficient ?
translation.zh: 是不是因为这样会给主人留下食物不够的印象？

translation.en: Haha , I'm afraid it's simply because no one wishes to be too noticeable by finishing off the plate .
translation.zh: 哈哈，恐怕只是因为没人希望太引人注目。

translation.en: How do you get road news ?
translation.zh: 你怎么得到交通信息的呢？

translation.en: I've a driver mate in my car !
translation.zh: 我车里有司机伴侣！

translation.en: So you have all the news on broadcast ?
translation.zh: 你听广播了？

translation.en: Yes , it's so helpful .
translation.zh: 是的，很有帮助。

translation.en: Why ? anything special there ?
translation.zh: 为什么？有什么特别的吗？

translation.en: It's more than special . You can find as many kinds of animals as you can put a name to and more .
translation.zh: 不仅仅是特别，在那里有各种各样你叫得出名字的动物，还有一些（你不认识的）。

translation.en: Snakes ? there are even rodents and monkeys ! it's a world of exotic pets .
translation.zh: 蛇？甚至还有啮齿动物和猴子呢！那是一个充满奇异宠物的世界。

translation.en: That's terrific . I can't wait to check it out .
translation.zh: 真是太好了。我迫不及待想去看看了。

translation.en: Why not ? it's so cool .
translation.zh: 为什么不呢？这太酷了

translation.en: But it will pose a risk to your health .
translation.zh: 但这会对你的健康构成威胁。

translation.en: I mean , most reptiles carry some harmful bacteria , they are likely to cause immune system problems .
translation.zh: 我的意思是，大多数爬行动物都会携带一些有害细菌，它们很可能导致免疫系统的问题。

translation.en: Well , I didn't realize that .
translation.zh: 呃，我没想到这个问题

translation.en: Oh , I should have thought of my brother's baby girl . Maybe I'll just have a dog instead of an exotic pet .
translation.zh: 哦，我没考虑到我哥哥的宝宝。也许我应该养一只狗而不是一只奇异的宠物。

translation.en: Yes , good luck , Maria .
translation.zh: 是的，祝你好运，玛丽亚。

translation.en: Yes , I'm in a bit of a rush . Could I have a piece of apple pie please ?
translation.zh: 是的，我有点赶时间。请给我一块苹果派好吗？

translation.en: Certainly . Would you like it with ice cream ?
translation.zh: 当然。你要加冰淇淋吗？

translation.en: Hey , you look great ! how's everything ?
translation.zh: 嘿，你看起来很棒！一切都好吗？

translation.en: Yeah , you know what ? I've been going to the club regularly . The training really pays off . Now I am in a good shape and I know more about how to keep fit .
translation.zh: 是的，你知道吗？我经常去俱乐部，训练真的很有成效。现在我的体型很好，也知道如何保持健康了

translation.en: Really ? tell me about it . I haven't gone to the club for a long time . I am too busy with work .
translation.zh: 真的吗？告诉我吧，我好久没去俱乐部了。我工作太忙了

translation.en: It's important to do proper exercises .
translation.zh: 适当的锻炼很重要。

translation.en: You're right . Too much or too little won't do any good .
translation.zh: 你说得对。太多或太少都没有好处

translation.en: The trainer tells me , besides regular sports activities , I should also have a healthy and balanced diet .
translation.zh: 教练告诉我，除了有规律的体育活动外，我的饮食还应该健康均衡。

translation.en: Sounds reasonable .
translation.zh: 听起来很有道理。

translation.en: We should eat more vegetables instead of junk food to stay energetic .
translation.zh: 我们应该多吃蔬菜来保持活力，而不是垃圾食品。

translation.en: And fruits !
translation.zh: 还有水果

translation.en: Surely it is . Getting enough sleep is also crucial for fitness .
translation.zh: 当然了。充足的睡眠对健康也至关重要。

translation.en: Yeah , he advises me to stay in a good mood . That can also help one to keep sound physical health .
translation.zh: 有，他建议我保持好心情，这也有助于保持身体健康。

translation.en: Have you ever tried shopping online ?
translation.zh: 你曾经尝试过网上购物吗？

translation.en: No , never . I prefer to actually see and touch what I'm buying before I pay for it , especially for clothes and shoes .
translation.zh: 不，从来没有。我更喜欢在付钱之前看到和触摸到我要买的东西，尤其是衣服和鞋子。

translation.en: That's right . Seeing is believing .
translation.zh: 没错。眼见为实。

translation.en: I've heard some friends say when they get the article , it's quite different from what they see on the website advertisement .
translation.zh: 我听朋友说过，他们在网上买到的东西和网站广告上看到的很不一样。

translation.en: That happens . Without close quality examination , we may encounter fraud , and the e-shop may suddenly disappear .
translation.zh: 确实有这种事，不好好检查质量，可能会买到假货，网站也没准会突然消失。

translation.en: What's more , it's not always so safe for us to pay online as hackers might steal the user name and password .
translation.zh: 更重要的是，网上支付也并不总是那么安全，因为黑客可能会窃取用户名和密码。

translation.en: It's said that some measures have been taken to deal with this problem . Paying online is much safer than before , but I still have the feeling that it's not safe enough .
translation.zh: 据说已经出台了一些措施来解决这个问题。网上支付比以前安全多了，但我还是觉得不够安全。

translation.en: I can't agree more . that's why I only do street shopping .
translation.zh: 我完全同意。这就是为什么我只在实体店购物。

translation.en: Me too . Sometimes I surf online shops to check some related information , and then go to a physical store to do the actual shopping .
translation.zh: 我也是。有时我上网浏览一些产品的相关信息，然后去实体店里买。

translation.en: It ’ s so great to be here ! I ’ m so excited to help you and my daughter with your new home !
translation.zh: 来到这里真是太好了！我很高兴能帮你和我女儿搬新家。

translation.en: We ’ re glad that you ’ re here . Would you like a tour of the house ?
translation.zh: 我们很高兴你来了。你想参观一下房子吗？

translation.en: That ’ d be great , but could I have a cup of tea first ?
translation.zh: 那太好了，我能先喝杯茶吗？

translation.en: Sure , I ’ ll just go put the kettle on . Why don ’ t you have a seat on the sofa and I ’ ll go take care of things in the kitchen .
translation.zh: 当然，我去把水壶热上。你为什么不坐在沙发上呢？（现在）我得去厨房收拾东西。

translation.en: That would be lovely , thanks .
translation.zh: 好的，谢谢。

translation.en: Do you take milk or sugar with your tea ?
translation.zh: 你喝茶时要加牛奶还是糖？

translation.en: Ok . What do you think about our living room ?
translation.zh: 好的。你觉得我们的客厅怎么样？

translation.en: Well , I do like the mantelpiece and the coffee table , but I don ’ t really care for curtains . Did you get them at a yard sale ? They look ancient .
translation.zh: 嗯，我很喜欢壁炉架和咖啡桌，但我并不太喜欢窗帘。你是在庭院拍卖会上买的吗？它们看起来很古老。

translation.en: My parents gave them to us as a house warming gift .
translation.zh: 我父母把它们作为暖房礼物送给我们。

translation.en: Oh dear . Well , I suppose they will do for now . do you ever dust in here ? It seems a bit dusty in here .
translation.zh: 哦，亲爱的。好吧，我现在想到他们会这样做了。你打扫过这里吗？这里似乎有点灰尘。

translation.en: Your daughter usually does the dusting , and I do the vacuuming .
translation.zh: 你女儿常常除尘，我吸尘。

translation.en: That ’ s very nice of you to offer . Here ’ s your tea . Be careful , it ’ s still quite hot .
translation.zh: 你真是太好了。这是你的茶。小心点，还很烫。

translation.en: What do you think about this store ? I heard it ’ s a posh store that ’ s only got branches in big cities .
translation.zh: 你觉得这家店怎么样？我听说这是家一流的精品店，只在大城市开分店。

translation.en: Don ’ t worry . I ’ Ve decided that for your birthday I ’ m going to take you shopping for a new dress .
translation.zh: 别担心。我已经想好了，为了给你庆祝生日，我带你逛街给你买条新裙子。

translation.en: Really ? I thought you hated shopping ?
translation.zh: 真的吗？我以为你讨厌购物？

translation.en: Sure . That ’ s really nice of you . Let ’ s go in and try some things on .
translation.zh: 当然。你真是太好了。我们进去试穿一下吧。

translation.en: How about this red dress ? I think it would really suit you .
translation.zh: 这件红裙子怎么样？我想这真的很适合你。

translation.en: That ’ s gorgeous ! Do they have it in a size 8 ?
translation.zh: 太棒了！他们有8号的尺码吗？

translation.en: Here you go.On any other day , it would cost me a fortune , but it ’ s on special offer today .
translation.zh: 给你。要是别的日子，这件会花掉我不少钱，不过今天是特价。

translation.en: Let me look . Let ’ s see ... they ’ Ve got one in blue , green , pink , black ... and white . Here you are .
translation.zh: 我找找。咱们看看……有蓝色，绿色，粉色，黑色……还有白色……给你.

translation.en: This is perfect ! What do you think ?
translation.zh: 太完美了！你觉得呢？

translation.en: Steven , shall we go shopping tomorrow ?
translation.zh: 史蒂文，我们明天去购物好吗？
