translation.en: I ’ m going to visit my brother . he ’ s just had a baby . He lives in Minneapolis .
translation.zh: 我要去看我哥哥。他的孩子刚出生了。就住在明尼阿波利斯市。

translation.en: And how long do you you plan to remain in the United States ?
translation.zh: 你打算在美国呆多久？

translation.en: I ’ ll be here for approximately three weeks . See , here ’ s my return ticket for the twenty-sixth of March .
translation.zh: 大约待三周。你看，这是我3月26日的回程票。

translation.en: And , who is sponsoring your trip ?
translation.zh: 有谁资助你这一趟吗？

translation.en: My brother , here , this is an invitation letter from him . I will stay with him and his family in their home .
translation.zh: 我哥哥，这是他给我的邀请信。我将和他以及他的家人在一起，住在他家。

translation.en: Alright , tell me about the ties you have to your home country .
translation.zh: 好吧，那你说一下你在你的国家还有什么牵挂吗。

translation.en: Well , I own a house . actually , I ’ m leaving my dog there with my neighbors . I have a car at home , and oh , my job ! I ’ m employed by Tornal as an engineer . Actually , I only have three weeks ’ vacation , so I have to go back to work at the end of March .
translation.zh: 嗯，我有一所房子。我的狗也寄养在邻居那里。我还有一辆车，对了，还有我的工作！我在托纳尔公司工作，我是个工程师。我只有三个星期的假期，我必须在三月底回去。

translation.en: And what evidence do you have that you are financially independent ?
translation.zh: 有什么能能证明你经济独立吗？

translation.en: Well , I do have assets in my country . like I said , I own a house , and see , here ’ s a bank statement showing my investments , and my bank balance .
translation.zh: 嗯，我在自己国家有资产。我说了，我有房，看，这是我的银行帐单，上面写了我的投资额和银行余额。

translation.en: I ’ m sorry , sir , we cannot grant you a B2 visa at this time , instead , you are granted a resident visa ! Congratulations , you are the millionth person to apply for a visa ! You win ! Congratulations !
translation.zh: 对不起，先生，我们不能给你B2签证，但会你获得了居民签证！恭喜你，你是第一百万个获得签证的人！你通过了！祝贺你！

translation.en: This is such a beautiful day ! Great for sailing !
translation.zh: 今天天气真好！非常适合航海！

translation.en: It sure is ! The water looks so nice ! Anchor the boat for a little while . I ’ m going to take a dip .
translation.zh: 对啊！水看起来真漂亮！把船停一会儿。我要去游泳。

translation.en: Why are you doggy-paddling ? I taught you how to swim ! Do your breast stroke !
translation.zh: 你为什么在狗刨？我教过你游泳！快蛙泳！

translation.en: I get too tired ! I ’ ll just backstroke , it ’ s easier !
translation.zh: 我太累了！我来仰泳，这比较容易！

translation.en: Try kicking your legs more . That ’ s good . Don ’ t go out too far !
translation.zh: 试着多踢踢腿。很好。别游出去太远！

translation.en: It ’ s fine . Jump in !
translation.zh: 很好。你也来游泳！

translation.en: Kathy ! Get back here ! I see a shark !
translation.zh: 凯西！快回来！我看见了一条鲨鱼！

translation.en: Ahahah ! ! ! Help me ! Help ! Bring the boat closer ! The shark is coming straight towards me !
translation.zh: 啊啊啊！快帮我！救命啊！把船靠近点！鲨鱼正朝我冲过来！

translation.en: It ’ s right under you ! Kathy ! ! !
translation.zh: 它就在你下面！凯西！

translation.en: Say , what's your favorite sport ?
translation.zh: 你最喜欢什么运动？

translation.en: Mmmm ... it's hard to say . I like golf a lot-but I guess I like tennis better .
translation.zh: 嗯。。。很难说。我很喜欢高尔夫，但我想我更喜欢网球。

translation.en: Do you play much tennis ?
translation.zh: 你经常打网球吗？

translation.en: Yes , quite a bit . How about a game sometime ?
translation.zh: 是的。找个时间约一局怎么样？

translation.en: Sorry . I'm strictly a spectator-football , baseball , basketball , golf ... I watch them all .
translation.zh: 不好意思，我就是一个的旁观足球，棒球，篮球，高尔夫的人，我只看别人打。

translation.en: I had an accident .
translation.zh: 我出了事故。

translation.en: That's terrible !
translation.zh: 太可怕了！

translation.en: Have you eaten ?
translation.zh: 你吃了吗？

translation.en: What are you going to do next year ?
translation.zh: 明年你打算干什么？

translation.en: I want to go traveling .
translation.zh: 我想去旅游。

translation.en: Do you have any where in mind ?
translation.zh: 你有想去的地方吗？

translation.en: Yes , I've been thinking about Florida .
translation.zh: 有，我一直想去佛罗里达。

translation.en: I'm looking forward to summer vacation .
translation.zh: 我好期待暑假。

translation.en: Thanks for your hospitality .
translation.zh: 谢谢你的盛情款待。

translation.en: What would you like for Christmas ?
translation.zh: 圣诞节你想要什么？

translation.en: I would like to have that new style Gl Joe .
translation.zh: 我想要新式的特种部队。

translation.en: Have you asked Santa ?
translation.zh: 你问过圣诞老人吗？

translation.en: Yes and I've written him a letter .
translation.zh: 是的，我给他写了封信。

translation.en: I must be going .
translation.zh: 我得走了。

translation.en: Okay . Keep in touch .
translation.zh: 好的。保持联络。

translation.en: What does the paper say ?
translation.zh: 报纸说什么了吗？

translation.en: Nothing much — the same old stuff . A lot of bad news as usual .
translation.zh: 没什么-还是老样子。像往常一样有很多坏消息。

translation.en: Well , what ’ s the weather report ?
translation.zh: 那么，天气怎么样？

translation.en: Sunny and mild today , cloudy and rainy tomorrow .
translation.zh: 今天晴朗暖和，明天多云多雨。

translation.en: Did they find those bank robbers ?
translation.zh: 他们找到那些银行劫匪了吗？

translation.en: Not yet . They were holding two men in Ohio , but they let them go . They weren ’ t the criminals after all .
translation.zh: 还没有。他们在俄亥俄州关押了两个人，但最终还是放了。毕竟不是罪犯。

translation.en: What about the sports page ? What were the scores of last night ’ s games ?
translation.zh: 体育版呢？昨晚的比赛比分是多少？

translation.en: Here ’ s the paper ; you can read them yourself .
translation.zh: 这是报纸；你可以自己读。

translation.en: We're thinking about going to America .
translation.zh: 我们正在考虑去美国。

translation.en: Have you thought about the cost ?
translation.zh: 你们考虑过费用吗？

translation.en: There is that .
translation.zh: 这就是。

translation.en: I believe it'll be very expensive .
translation.zh: 我觉得会很贵。

translation.en: Excuse me . Do you have the time ?
translation.zh: 打扰一下，你知道现在的时间吗？

translation.en: My watch is a few minutes fast . It's about six forty , I think .
translation.zh: 我的表快了几分钟。我想大概是六点四十分。

translation.en: Is it ? Oh , no . The concert will begin in twenty minutes . Are we too late to get there ?
translation.zh: 是吗？哦，不要。音乐会二十分钟后开始。我们到那里会不会太迟了？

translation.en: If we start now , we can make it by taxi .
translation.zh: 如果我们现在出发，我们可以乘出租车去。

translation.en: Yes , thank you . I've already been helping myself .
translation.zh: 好的，谢谢。我已经在吃了

translation.en: This dish taste terrific . Would you like to try a little ? It is a little hot , but very good .
translation.zh: 这道菜味道好极了。你想试试吗？有点辣，但很好吃

translation.en: I'll have another cup of beer insist . I know I don't like to drink alone , especially there are someone sitting there next to me .
translation.zh: 我一定要再喝一杯。我不喜欢一个人喝酒，尤其是有人坐在我旁边的时候。

translation.en: Bottom's up , and you're right . This meal is incredible . I wish I had known this restaurant before . Thanks for bringing me here . I know I'll be back agile soon .
translation.zh: 干杯。这顿饭太棒了。要是我以前就知道这家餐馆就好了。谢谢你带我来。我会再来的。

translation.en: I can't go to your party .
translation.zh: 我不能去参加你的聚会了。

translation.en: Tim's always bothering me .
translation.zh: 蒂姆总是烦我。

translation.en: Just tell him off .
translation.zh: 把他赶走。

translation.en: Search me .
translation.zh: 我不知道。

translation.en: How's John doing ?
translation.zh: 约翰怎么样了？

translation.en: He can barely make ends meet .
translation.zh: 他几乎入不敷出。

translation.en: Honey , what's wrong with you ?
translation.zh: 亲爱的，你怎么了

translation.en: I'm not feeling well . I'm very nervous .
translation.zh: 我感觉不舒服。我很紧张

translation.en: Take it easy . We are going to have our own baby . You should be happy .
translation.zh: 放松点。我们要有自己的孩子了。你应该高兴

translation.en: The doctors and the nurses will help you . And I will be waiting for you right here , praying for you and our baby .
translation.zh: 医生和护士会帮你。我会在这里等你，为你和我们的孩子祈祷。

translation.en: Thank you , dear . I feel better now .
translation.zh: 谢谢你，亲爱的。我感觉好多了。

translation.en: Could you please wait for a minute ? I'll buy the tickets
translation.zh: 你能等一下吗？我去买票

translation.en: Here is your ticket .
translation.zh: 这是你的票。

translation.en: The park will close soon . We Should better go in right now .
translation.zh: 公园很快就要关门了。我们最好现在就进去。

translation.en: Yes , let's go in .
translation.zh: 是的，我们进去吧。

translation.en: It is a new park , isn't it ?
translation.zh: 这是一个新公园，不是吗？

translation.en: Yes , how do you know ?
translation.zh: 是的，你怎么知道的？

translation.en: I guessed it .
translation.zh: 我猜的。

translation.en: Well , generally speaking , the park is a window on the world history , a window on the world civilization and a window on the world's tourist attractions as well .
translation.zh: 总的来说，公园是世界历史的窗口，世界文明的窗口，也是世界旅游景点的窗口。

translation.en: Oh , how wonderful !
translation.zh: 哦，太棒了！

translation.en: I'm going to buy a CD .
translation.zh: 我要买一张CD。

translation.en: Why not listen to music online ?
translation.zh: 为什么不在线听音乐呢？

translation.en: Then I will have to pay quite a lot to listen to music on line , isn't it ?
translation.zh: 那我就得花很多钱线上听音乐了，不是吗？

translation.en: You can audition music on line , and you can audition it off line after downloading it , so you needn't pay for it .
translation.zh: 你可以在线试听音乐，下载后也可以离线试听，所以不用花钱。

translation.en: I have downloaded one , but it still can't be listened .
translation.zh: 我下载了一个，但是我听不到。

translation.en: In order to listen to music , you must have the necessary software .
translation.zh: 要想听音乐，你必须有相应的软件。

translation.en: Can you recommend some to me ?
translation.zh: 你能给我推荐一些吗？

translation.en: Certainly . Realplayer is a good .
translation.zh: 当然。Realplayer不错。

translation.en: Can I download it ?
translation.zh: 我可以下载吗？

translation.en: Yes , but you need install it after downloading so that you can use it .
translation.zh: 可以，但是你需要在下载后再安装，这样你才能用。

translation.en: I'll try it tonight .
translation.zh: 我今晚试试。

translation.en: Do you have a minute ?
translation.zh: 你有空吗？

translation.en: How was the party ?
translation.zh: 聚会怎么样？

translation.en: I had a fantastic time .
translation.zh: 我玩得很开心。

translation.en: I'm really mad at Bob .
translation.zh: 我真的很生鲍勃的气。

translation.en: What for ? ( Why ? )
translation.zh: 为什么（为什么？）

translation.en: Hey , Peter , have you had lunch yet ?
translation.zh: 嘿，彼得，你吃午饭了吗？

translation.en: No . How about you ?
translation.zh: 还没有。你呢？

translation.en: Not yet . Let's go to that restaurant on the corner .
translation.zh: 我也没有。我们去拐角的那家餐馆吧。

translation.en: You'll never guess what I won at work today ! - Tickets to tonight's final NBA game .
translation.zh: 你不会猜到我今天在工作中赢得了什么！今晚NBA决赛的门票。

translation.en: Two , I hope and I hope that by telling me about them you are planning on taking me !
translation.zh: 我希望有两张，我还希望你这么和我说，是打算带我去！

translation.en: Of course ! And here's the best part , they are court side seats !
translation.zh: 是的！最棒的是，它们是球场边的座位！

translation.en: How in the world ! Who came up with seats like that from your company ?
translation.zh: 真的吗！你们公司的什么人弄到这样的座位的？

translation.en: Some guy in the accounting department has a brother on the team !
translation.zh: 会计部有个人的兄弟在球队里！

translation.en: Can't beat that ! Thank you accounting guy !
translation.zh: 真是太棒了！感谢你们公司的这个会计！

translation.en: The game starts at seven so we'd better hustle , it's already five .
translation.zh: 比赛七点开始，我们最好抓紧，已经五点了。

translation.en: What are we waiting for ? Let's go !
translation.zh: 我们还在等什么？走吧！

translation.en: I'm too tired now . I've already worked for 12 hours overtime !
translation.zh: 我现在太累了。我已经加班12个小时了！

translation.en: God ! Don't you think they should get you an assistant ?
translation.zh: 天啊！你不觉得他们应该给你找个助手吗？

translation.en: Yes , they were supposed to , but so far nobody's turned up , and I have to do the work alone . This is the first break I've had all day .
translation.zh: 对，他们应该这么做，但到目前为止还没有人来，我只能一个人做这项工作。这是我今天一整天第一次休息。

translation.en: They're really running you into the ground . Why don't you ask for some time off ? You could take a long weekend and have a good rest .
translation.zh: 他们真的要把你逼疯了。你为什么不请假呢？你可以用一个周末好好休息。

translation.en: I'm afraid I can't before I finish this project .
translation.zh: 恐怕在我完成这个项目之前都不能休息。

translation.en: You'd better pay more attention to your health .
translation.zh: 你最好多注意你的身体。

translation.en: I will , thanks for your concern .
translation.zh: 我会的，谢谢你的关心。

translation.en: What's wrong with Debbie today ? She seems upset about something .
translation.zh: 黛比今天怎么了？她似乎有点沮丧。

translation.en: I have no idea . Maybe she had a fight with her husband .
translation.zh: 我不知道。也许她和她丈夫吵架了。

translation.en: For the 100th anniversary of the opening of the library we are going to have a party .
translation.zh: 为了庆祝图书馆开馆100周年，我们将举办一个派对。

translation.en: That's a wonderful way to celebrate this grand old library !
translation.zh: 这是一个很好的方式来庆祝这个宏伟且历史悠久的图书馆！

translation.en: I hoped you would be willing to brainstorm with me for party ideas .
translation.zh: 希望我们集思广益，交流筹办派对的点子。

translation.en: That is right up my alley . You say party and I'm there .
translation.zh: 那正合我的意。你提起派对，而我也正好想到办派对。

translation.en: Perfect . It will be open to the public and we anticipate roughly about five to seven hundred people .
translation.zh: 太棒了，派对将向公众开放，我们预计大约有500到700人。

translation.en: Will it be an all day event ?
translation.zh: 会是全天活动吗？

translation.en: Yes . And we checked with the city and we have permission to use the park adjacent to the library .
translation.zh: 对。我们向市里核实了一下，我们有权使用图书馆旁边的公园。

translation.en: That was quick thinking .
translation.zh: 很容易就能想到这么做。

translation.en: What a beautiful watch . It goes very well with your ring .
translation.zh: 多漂亮的表啊。很配你的戒指。

translation.en: Is that your wedding ring ?
translation.zh: 那是你的结婚戒指吗？

translation.en: I'm not married yet . It's my engagement ring .
translation.zh: 我还没结婚呢。这是我的订婚戒指。

translation.en: Well , congratulations . When is the big date ?
translation.zh: 恭喜你。重什么时候办婚礼？

translation.en: In June .
translation.zh: 六月。

translation.en: Did you have the watch before getting the ring ?
translation.zh: 拿到戒指之前你有手表吗？

translation.en: Actually , we bought the ring together after I got the watch .
translation.zh: 实际上，我拿到手表后我们才一起买了戒指。

translation.en: You did a fabulous job with the selection . It's gorgeous .
translation.zh: 你好会选。太漂亮了。

translation.en: It's a Tag Heer .
translation.zh: 泰格豪雅。

translation.en: If you don't mind me asking , how much do they cost ?
translation.zh: 如果你不介意的话，我想问问这个多少钱啊？

translation.en: This one is $ 1500 . But they range from $ 600 to $ 3000 .
translation.zh: 这个是1500美元。但这个牌子的手表价格从600美元到3000美元不等。

translation.en: That's why it looks so nice . I should have figured . You always get what you pay for .
translation.zh: 怪不得这么漂亮。我早该想到的。你买的东西总是物有所值。

translation.en: Yeah . I would rather get one nice watch instead of 20 mediocre ones .
translation.zh: 是啊。我宁愿买一块漂亮的手表，也不想花20块买个普通的。

translation.en: Hey Suzie . Guess what ? I'm having a baby !
translation.zh: 嘿，苏西。你猜怎么着？我要生孩子了！

translation.en: Really ? That's so great . Congratulations .
translation.zh: 真的？太棒了。祝贺你。

translation.en: Thanks . I'm so excited . We've been trying for 8 months now .
translation.zh: 谢谢。我太兴奋了。我们已经努力8个月了。

translation.en: That's really exciting . How many months are you pregnant ?
translation.zh: 那真是太好了。你怀孕几个月了？

translation.en: Three months .
translation.zh: 三个月。

translation.en: Are you going to find out if it is a boy or a girl ?
translation.zh: 你想知道是男孩还是女孩吗？

translation.en: I want to , but Bob doesn't . He wants to be surprised like the old fashioned way .
translation.zh: 我想，但鲍勃不想。他喜欢传统的方式，到最后才知道结果。

translation.en: Maybe it's more exciting not knowing .
translation.zh: 也许那样才更让人兴奋。

translation.en: I'd rather know and buy all the baby things ahead of time .
translation.zh: 我宁愿提前知道，那样我就能购买所有的婴儿用品。

translation.en: There are so many things you have to prepare for .
translation.zh: 你有很多事情要准备。

translation.en: I know I am going to be busy , but I know I can handle it . I have been looking forward to this day for a long long time .
translation.zh: 我知道我会很忙，但我能应付。我期待这一天已经很久了。

translation.en: It really must be an exciting time for you guys .
translation.zh: 对你们来说这一定是一段激动人心的时光。

translation.en: The weather has been terrible this week .
translation.zh: 这周天气很糟糕。

translation.en: Yeah , I'm worried . If it's like this tomorrow , our big outdoor party will have to be canceled .
translation.zh: 是的，我很担心。如果明天也是这样，我们的大型户外聚会就得取消了。

translation.en: Let's hope it clears up .
translation.zh: 希望天气转晴吧。

translation.en: Sybil . Is that spelt with an I or a Y ?
translation.zh: 西比尔，你的名字里有一个I还是一个Y？

translation.en: Both actually . S , Y , B , I , L .
translation.zh: 两个都有一个。S，Y，B，I，L。

translation.en: Why are you so quiet ?
translation.zh: 你为什么这么沉默？

translation.en: My girlfriend just broke up with me .
translation.zh: 我女朋友刚和我分手。

translation.en: You must feel terrible now .
translation.zh: 你现在一定很难受。

translation.en: I remember my first break up . It was the worst feeling in the world . I was crying everyday for three months . And slowly , it got better . I know you'll feel better too .
translation.zh: 我还记得我第一次分手。那是世界上最糟糕的感觉。三个月来我每天都在哭。慢慢地，情况好转了。我知道你也会渐渐好起来的。

translation.en: You've been through this too ?
translation.zh: 你也经历过吗？

translation.en: Yeah . I remember it very clearly . The pain makes it easy to remember . I know you're really hurting right now , but you know many people experience break ups .
translation.zh: 是啊。我记得很清楚。疼痛总是容易让人记住。我知道你现在很伤心，但你也知道，很多人都经历过分手。

translation.en: But it hurts too much .
translation.zh: 但是这太痛苦了。

translation.en: I know it's painful , but it's only temporary . After the pain goes away , you'll find other girls .
translation.zh: 我知道这很痛苦，但这只是暂时的。痛苦消失后，你会遇到其他女孩。

translation.en: What if I don't want to find another girl ?
translation.zh: 如果我不想再找别的女孩呢？

translation.en: You'll change your mind . Look at everyone in the world . They all break up and move on . The faster you understand this , the quicker you will recover .
translation.zh: 你会改变主意的。看看世界上的每一个人。他们分手后都会继续生活。你越快理解这一点，你就会越快恢复如初。

translation.en: I also know you must still have strong feelings for her , but try to think of all the bad things . You know she didn't treat you that well . Is that the person you want to spend the rest of your life with ?
translation.zh: 我也知道你一定对她还有很深的感情，但是试着想想所有的坏事。你知道她对你没那么好。你想和她共度余生吗？

translation.en: Yeah . Thanks for the talk .
translation.zh: 是啊。谢谢你同我讲这些。

translation.en: I'll give you a call later . We should hang out . It's good to be around people .
translation.zh: 我一会儿给你打电话。我们应该出去玩。有人陪伴也是好的。

translation.en: Ok . I'll talk to you later .
translation.zh: 好的，我待会儿再跟你聊。

translation.en: How about you and Tom ? What time is your wedding ?
translation.zh: 你和汤姆现在怎么样？你们的婚礼什么时候举行？

translation.en: Don ’ t be kidding , OK ?
translation.zh: 别开玩笑了，好吗？

translation.en: What ’ s the matter ? So angry . I ’ m just playing a joke with you .
translation.zh: 怎么了？怎么这么生气。我只是和你开个玩笑。

translation.en: Because I have given him up as a bad job . Our relation has been over .
translation.zh: 我放弃他了。我和他已经结束了。

translation.en: Do you like ethnic food ?
translation.zh: 你喜欢民族食品吗？

translation.en: I do ! My favorites are Mexican , Thai , and Indian .
translation.zh: 我喜欢！我最喜欢墨西哥菜、泰国菜和印度菜。

translation.en: Really ? Have you ever tried Moroccan ?
translation.zh: 真的？你试过摩洛哥菜吗？

translation.en: I can't say that I have . What are the basic ingredients ?
translation.zh: 我不确定。基本原料是什么？

translation.en: I don't know . A friend of mine said I should try it .
translation.zh: 我不知道。我的一个朋友说我应该试试。

translation.en: Do you know where a Moroccan restaurant is ?
translation.zh: 你知道摩洛哥餐馆在哪里吗？

translation.en: As a matter of fact , he gave me this address .
translation.zh: 事实上，他给了我这个地址。

translation.en: Let's go there for lunch ! I'm up for an adventure !
translation.zh: 我们去那里吃午饭吧！我准备好去冒险了！

translation.en: Are you sure you can't lend me five thousand dollars ?
translation.zh: 你确定不能借给我五千美元吗？

translation.en: Hmm ... I'll tell you what . I'll lend you four thousand dollars , but you have to pay me back next week .
translation.zh: 嗯。我告诉你吧。我可以借给你四千美元，但你下周得还我。

translation.en: Look , that bamboo groves are flourishing . Let's go and play there .
translation.zh: 看，那片竹林很茂盛。我们去那里玩吧。

translation.en: Wait ! Look at that board , what's on it ?
translation.zh: 等等！看那块木板，上面写着什么？

translation.en: ' Please don't enter the bamboo groves . ' We're not allowed to go in .
translation.zh: “请不要进入竹林。”我们不能进去。

translation.en: Then we'd better not go .
translation.zh: 那我们最好不要进去。

translation.en: Hi , Jack , how have you been ?
translation.zh: 嗨，杰克，最近怎么样？

translation.en: Why ? Looks like you're feeling very down ! What happened ?
translation.zh: 为什么？看来你情绪很低落！发生什么事了？

translation.en: Come on . For a man who's feeling so , down , there're usually two reasons . Either his career is going downhill , or he has a broken heart . Since you're so successful , it must be the latter .
translation.zh: 来吧。对于一个情绪低落的男人来说，通常有两个原因。不是他的事业在走下坡路，就是他心碎了。既然你这么成功，那一定是后者。

translation.en: Well , you're right . I just broke up with Jane .
translation.zh: 嗯，你说得对。我刚和简分手。

translation.en: Oh , I'm sorry . I thought you two were made for each ocher .
translation.zh: 哦，对不起。我以为你们俩很般配。

translation.en: Well , you never know . I'm ready for a commitment and want to settle down , but she says she wants to pursue her career while she's still young .
translation.zh: 你永远不会知道。我已经准备好与她定下终身，安定下来，但她说她想趁年轻继续自己的事业。

translation.en: Well , she is not to blame . It's always difficult to choose between career and family .
translation.zh: 好吧，这不怪她。事业和家庭总是很难抉择的。

translation.en: Jack , I don't know what to say to comfort you , but cheer up ! There are plenty of fish in the sea and you'll find your soul mate , your perfect match !
translation.zh: 杰克，我不知道该说什么来安慰你，但是振作起来！海里有很多鱼，你会找到你的灵魂伴侣，你的完美伴侣！

translation.en: Yeah , but it's hard to forget her at moment . You know , we were together for almost five years . It's really hard ...
translation.zh: 是啊，但现在很难忘记她。你知道，我们在一起快五年了。真的很难……

translation.en: It's quiet everywhere in winter .
translation.zh: 冬天到处都很安静。

translation.en: Yes . I like winter .
translation.zh: 对。我喜欢冬天。

translation.en: What a heavy snow ! Look ! The water is frozen .
translation.zh: 多大的雪啊！你看！水结冰了。

translation.en: Take care ! Don't slip on the ground .
translation.zh: 当心！别在地上滑倒。

translation.en: I've got it . I like the feeling of stepping on the ice .
translation.zh: 我知道了。我喜欢踩在冰上的感觉。

translation.en: There is a snowman over there .
translation.zh: 那边有一个雪人。

translation.en: How lovely it is !
translation.zh: 多可爱啊！

translation.en: Ann , do you have time next Monday ?
translation.zh: 安，下周一你有时间吗？

translation.en: Next Monday is my birthday , and I would like you to attend my party .
translation.zh: 下星期一是我的生日，我想邀请你参加我的排队。

translation.en: Wow . I'd love to .
translation.zh: 哇！我很乐意。

translation.en: When and where ?
translation.zh: 什么时候，在哪里举行？

translation.en: Five o ’ clock that afternoon , and in my place , you know ?
translation.zh: 下周一下午五点，在我家，知道了吗？

translation.en: Yes , I know . I appreciate your invitation .
translation.zh: 和的，我知道了。谢谢你的邀请。

translation.en: I am going to invite other guys . See you that day .
translation.zh: 我还要邀请其他人。那天见。

translation.en: Would you care for something to drink , Mr . Stone ?
translation.zh: 斯通先生，您要喝点什么吗？

translation.en: No , thank you , Mrs . Carter . I'm fine for now .
translation.zh: 不用了，谢谢你，卡特女士。我现在不用。

translation.en: Just make yourself at home . The other guests should be arriving shortly .
translation.zh: 别拘束。其他客人很快就会到。

translation.en: I can ’ t stand being with you anymore . I'm sick of your drinking .
translation.zh: 我不能再忍受和你在一起了。我讨厌你喝酒。

translation.en: I swear never to drink again . Just give me another chance , please !
translation.zh: 我发誓再也不喝酒了。请再给我一次机会！

translation.en: How many chances have I given you ? I don ’ t trust you any more .
translation.zh: 我给了你多少机会？我不再相信你了。

translation.en: You know how hard I've tried to give up drinking ? I ’ d be lost without you . I won ’ t let you go anyway .
translation.zh: 你知道我有多努力戒酒吗？没有你我会茫然若失。反正我不会让你走的。

translation.en: Uh-oh . We don't have a flashlight .
translation.zh: 哦哦。我们没有手电筒。

translation.en: Don't worry . We'll make it back to the camp site before dark .
translation.zh: 别担心。我们会在天黑前赶回营地。

translation.en: Um , what will you do this weekend ?
translation.zh: 嗯，这个周末你打算做什么？

translation.en: How about a movie ? We haven't done that for a while .
translation.zh: 去看电影怎么样？我们已经有一段时间没看电影了。

translation.en: A movie ? Sure . Do you know what's on right now ?
translation.zh: 电影？好啊。你知道现在有什么电影吗？

translation.en: No . Why don't you check out the newspaper ?
translation.zh: 不知道。你为什么不看看报纸？

translation.en: Ok . Maybe you should invite your sister along , too .
translation.zh: 好的，也许你也应该邀请你妹妹一起去。

translation.en: Lily , can you take part in our picnic this weekend ?
translation.zh: 莉莉，你想这个周末参加我们的野餐吗？

translation.en: That sounds great . Where are you going ?
translation.zh: 听起来不错。你们要去哪里？

translation.en: I think we can go to the river , go around and have supper .
translation.zh: 我想我们可以去河边，四处转转，然后吃晚饭。

translation.en: What should I bring ?
translation.zh: 我应该带些什么？

translation.en: Nothing . Just wear comfortable clothes and good shoes for walking . We'll bring everything .
translation.zh: 什么都不用带。穿上舒适的衣服和轻便的鞋。我们会带所有的东西。

translation.en: Did you watch the final last night ? My favorite singer won !
translation.zh: 你昨晚看决赛了吗？我最喜欢的歌手赢了！

translation.en: Oh , I love him too . He not only sings well but also shows perseverance when he encounters difficulties in the contest .
translation.zh: 哦，我也喜欢他。他不仅歌唱得好，而且在比赛中遇到困难时总是不放弃。

translation.en: Absolutely . That's why when he entered the final , I was so excited .
translation.zh: 没错。所以当他进入决赛时，我非常激动。

translation.en: Have you seen the new James Bond movie ?
translation.zh: 你看过新的007电影吗？

translation.en: I thought it was better than the others-I really liked it . What did you think of it ?
translation.zh: 我觉得比其他几部好看——我很喜欢它。你觉得怎么样？

translation.en: Yes , I liked it , too . It was exciting , but not over the top . Do you know what I mean ?
translation.zh: 我也喜欢。它虽然称不上精彩绝伦，但却不失刺激。你知道我的意思吗？

translation.en: Mmm . That's what I thought too . I really liked the car chase , and the opening credit sequence was very exciting . And I always enjoy watching Pierce Brosnan .
translation.zh: 嗯。我也这么觉得。我喜欢它的飞车追逐，而且开头的演员阵容表也很棒。我一直很欣赏皮尔斯·布鲁斯南。

translation.en: Oh , yes . He's brilliant . Did you like the title song ?
translation.zh: 哦，是的。他很厉害。你喜欢它的主题曲吗？

translation.en: Not as much as last time , actually . What's the name of the American actor who was in the supporting role ?
translation.zh: 其实我比较喜欢上一部片的主题曲。那个演配角的美国演员叫什么名字？

translation.en: Hum , Edward Norton , or something like that . Did you like him ?
translation.zh: 嗯，好像是爱德华·诺顿之类的。你喜欢他吗？

translation.en: Yes . He was excellent . They worked well together , don't you think ?
translation.zh: 对。他演得很好。你不觉得他们配合得天衣无缝吗？

translation.en: I don't know . I think the woman was better . She provided a good love interest . Lucky James Bond !
translation.zh: 我不知道。可是我觉得那个女的更好。她带来了不少爱情趣味。詹姆斯·邦德真幸运！

translation.en: I hear you are expecting your family .
translation.zh: 我听说你的家人要来。

translation.en: Yes , my parents , and soon my brother as well .
translation.zh: 是的，我的父母，很快我的哥哥也要来。

translation.en: I didn't know you had a brother .
translation.zh: 我不知道你有个哥哥。

translation.en: Oh , yes , he is two years older than me . He lives in New Zealand so I don't see him that often .
translation.zh: 哦，是的，他比我大两岁。他住在新西兰，所以我很少见到他。

translation.en: Oh , nice . Is he coming on his own or with the family ?
translation.zh: 哦，不错。他是自己来还是和家人一起来？

translation.en: His son is coming as well . He wants to go to university here in England so they will visit a few universities while they are here .
translation.zh: 他的儿子也来了。他想在英国上大学，所以他们会去参观几所大学。

translation.en: Does your brother have just one son ?
translation.zh: 你哥哥只有一个儿子吗？

translation.en: No , he has two daughters as well . His wife and daughters are visiting her parents . So I won't see them .
translation.zh: 不，他还有两个女儿。他的妻子和女儿正在看望外祖父母。所以她们不会来。

translation.en: I'm sure your parents are looking forward to seeing their grandson .
translation.zh: 我肯定你父母很期待见到他们的孙子。

translation.en: Oh yes , they are really looking forward to it . They went to New Zealand last year and loved it .
translation.zh: 哦，是的，他们真的很期待。他们去年去了新西兰，很喜欢那里。

translation.en: So when are they all coming ?
translation.zh: 他们什么时候来？

translation.en: My parents are already here . My brother and nephew are arriving on Monday .
translation.zh: 已经到了。我弟弟和侄子星期一到。

translation.en: I ’ m temping at a pharmaceutic company .
translation.zh: 我在一家制药公司做临时工。

translation.en: Kobe Bryant and Shaquille O ’ Neal , they are the Los Angeles Lakers ’ star players .
translation.zh: 科比和奥尼尔，他们是洛杉矶湖人队的明星球员。

translation.en: Yeah . He ’ s older , so he doesn ’ t slam as much as he did when he was younger , but when he does , it ’ s still amazing .
translation.zh: 是 啊。他年纪大了，所以他不会像年轻时那样经常大满贯，但是当他确实实现大满贯的时候，还是很令人震惊的。

translation.en: How about eating out for a drink with me tonight .
translation.zh: 今晚和我一起出去吃饭喝一杯怎么样？

translation.en: Tonight ? I'm afraid I can't . I've promised Mark to go to the gym . Can we make it tomorrow ?
translation.zh: 今晚？恐怕不行。我答应马克一起去健身房。明天可以吗？

translation.en: No problem . Let's say 6:30 p . m . at the Royal Restaurant , OK ?
translation.zh: 没问题。下午6:30在皇家饭店，可以吗？

translation.en: All right . See you tomorrow night .
translation.zh: 好的。明晚见。

translation.en: Yeah . It's been raining a lot these days .
translation.zh: 是的。这几天一直在下雨

translation.en: I have been watching a lot of videos at home because of the constant rain .
translation.zh: 因为经常下雨，我已经在家里看了很多视频了

translation.en: Have you heard when it's supposed to get better ?
translation.zh: 你知道什么时候天气会好转吗？

translation.en: I saw the weather report , and it's going to rain for the next eight days .
translation.zh: 我看了天气预报，接下来八天都会下雨

translation.en: That sucks so much . What are we going to do ?
translation.zh: 真糟。我们该怎么办？

translation.en: I'm getting pretty bored . We should do something despite the rain .
translation.zh: 我觉得很无聊。尽管下雨，我们也还是应该找点事情做

translation.en: I'm with you . What do you have in mind ?
translation.zh: 我同意。你有什么想法吗？

translation.en: I haven't been to the Mall in a long time . Let's go there .
translation.zh: 我好久没去购物中心了。我们去那里吧

translation.en: That sounds good . They have a movie theatre there , so if we get bored , we can watch a movie .
translation.zh: 听起来不错。那里有一家电影院，如果我们觉得无聊，我们可以去看电影。

translation.en: Great . I'll stop by your place now .
translation.zh: 太棒了。我现在去你家。

translation.en: Ok . Don't forget to bring your umbrella . The rain can start up again anytime .
translation.zh: 好的别忘了带雨伞。随时可能再下雨。

translation.en: It's a good day for a picnic .
translation.zh: 今天是野餐的好日子。

translation.en: Well , I'm afraid I must be going now . I have no idea it was so late .
translation.zh: 嗯，恐怕我现在必须走了。我都不知道已经这么晚了

translation.en: Stay for dinner with us .
translation.zh: 留下来和我们一起吃晚饭吧

translation.en: I'm afraid I can't . I have a dinner party at seven tonight . You see , I am going to England the day after tomorrow .
translation.zh: 恐怕不行。今晚七点我有个晚宴。你知道，我后天要去英国

translation.en: Well , I won't keep you then . It was very nice of you to come to see me .
translation.zh: 好吧，那我就不留你了。你来看我真是太好了。

translation.en: It has been a pleasure . Goodbye .
translation.zh: 很高兴见到你。再见。

translation.en: Goodbye . Thank you again for coming .
translation.zh: 再见。再次感谢你来看我。

translation.en: We have another traditional holiday-the Dragon Boat Festival .
translation.zh: 我们还有另一个传统节日——端午节。

translation.en: It falls on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month .
translation.zh: 农历五月初五。

translation.en: Could you tell me the origin of the two festivals ?
translation.zh: 你能告诉我这两个节日的起源吗？

translation.en: OK . The Dragon Boat Festival is a way to commemorate a great ancient poet named Quyuan . On that day , people will hold a boat race as a symbol of the attempt to save him who threw himself into the river .
translation.zh: 好的。端午节是为了纪念古代伟大的诗人屈原。在那一天，人们将举行一场划船比赛，象征着试图拯救他。

translation.en: Why do people eat rice cakes on that day ?
translation.zh: 为什么人们在那一天吃粽子？

translation.en: In order to prevent the fish from eating the poet's body .
translation.zh: 为了防止鱼吃掉他的身体。

translation.en: It sounds so moving .
translation.zh: 听起来很感人。

translation.en: We are going to have a picnic tomorrow at the picnic center .
translation.zh: 我们明天要在野餐中心野餐。

translation.en: Now let's get things ready .
translation.zh: 现在让我们把事情准备好。

translation.en: Don't worry . There are all kinds of things in the center .
translation.zh: 别担心。中心有各种各样的东西。

translation.en: That's much more convenient . We don't even have to bring the flavorings .
translation.zh: 那就方便多了。我们甚至不用带调味品。

translation.en: Do you have anything to do after this ?
translation.zh: 这之后你有什么事要做吗？

translation.en: Shall we drop in somewhere for a couple of drinks ?
translation.zh: 我们去什么地方喝几杯好吗？

translation.en: I know a very interesting place .
translation.zh: 我知道一个很有趣的地方。

translation.en: Oh , do you ? Good .
translation.zh: 哦，是吗？太棒了。

translation.en: Oh , hi , Jessica , are you going to see this movie too ?
translation.zh: 哦，嗨，杰西卡，你也去看这部电影吗

translation.en: I'd love to , the movies are smash hit .
translation.zh: 我很想去，这部电影非常受欢迎

translation.en: Then let's go in .
translation.zh: 那我们进去吧

translation.en: I can't . I'm waiting for Paul , but he's late .
translation.zh: 不行。我在等保罗，但他迟到了。

translation.en: I'll say the movie's starting in the minute .
translation.zh: 但是电影马上就要开始了

translation.en: I know . I wonder what's keeping him .
translation.zh: 我知道。我不知道他为什么迟到了。

translation.en: Looks like he won't show up . He's done this before , hasn't he ?
translation.zh: 看起来他不会出现了。他以前也做过这种事，不是吗

translation.en: Yeah , a number of times .
translation.zh: 是的，很多次了。

translation.en: What's he trying to pull anyway .
translation.zh: 他到底想干什么

translation.en: I don't know . But this is definitely the last straw .
translation.zh: 我不知道。但这绝对是最后一根稻草。

translation.en: Maybe you should start seeing someone else .
translation.zh: 也许你应该开始和别人约会。

translation.en: You said it . Ok , let's go in , Sandy .
translation.zh: 你说的对。好的，我们进去吧，桑迪。

translation.en: I am Chinese by birth .
translation.zh: 我是中国人。

translation.en: Where is your domicile place ?
translation.zh: 你的住所在哪里？

translation.en: My domicile place is Hebes Province .
translation.zh: 我住在赫布斯省。

translation.en: Do you know that the dolphin is the most intelligent animal in the world ?
translation.zh: 你知道海豚是世界上最聪明的动物吗？

translation.en: Yes . Dolphins have a big brain and they are very smart . They are also the fastest swimmers in the world .
translation.zh: 我知道。海豚有一个很大的大脑，它们非常聪明。它们也是世界上游泳最快的动物。

translation.en: They must be amazing animals .
translation.zh: 它们一定很神奇。

translation.en: They are . I read a story about a dolphin saving a A from drowning in the sea .
translation.zh: 对的。我读了一个关于海豚救溺水者的故事。

translation.en: I read that story too . They seem to be able to understand men .
translation.zh: 我也读过那个故事。他们似乎能理解人。

translation.en: They sure can . Maybe they can interact with men better than monkeys and apes .
translation.zh: 是的。也许它们能比猴子和猿更好地与人类交流。

translation.en: I hate computer games .
translation.zh: 我讨厌电脑游戏。

translation.en: Why ? They are fine .
translation.zh: 为什么？它们很好啊。

translation.en: Because they are too violent . Some of them are even disgusting .
translation.zh: 因为他们太暴力了。有些甚至很恶心。

translation.en: Indeed there are bad games . But many of them are good .
translation.zh: 确实有一些游戏很糟糕。但许多都很好。

translation.en: If boys grow up with computer games , they will surely become bad .
translation.zh: 如果男孩玩电脑游戏长大，他们肯定会变坏。

translation.en: Come on . Things are not so bad . Boys can learn to use the computer through games .
translation.zh: 得了吧。事情没那么糟。男孩可以通过游戏学习如何使用电脑。

translation.en: Scientists have found a second solar system in the universe .
translation.zh: 科学家在宇宙中发现了第二个太阳系。

translation.en: What's the second solar system ?
translation.zh: 第二个太阳系是什么？

translation.en: It's just a system like ours , with a star and a number of planets going around it .
translation.zh: 类似于太阳系的星系，有一颗恒星和许多围绕着它运转的行星。

translation.en: Is this good news or bad news ?
translation.zh: 这是好消息还是坏消息？

translation.en: It's exciting news ! If we find a second solar system , we might find a second earth !
translation.zh: 这是个令人兴奋的好消息！如果找到了第二个太阳系，我们可能会找到第二个地球！

translation.en: You mean with people on it ?
translation.zh: 你是说上面会有人？

translation.en: Yes ! Isn't that exciting ?
translation.zh: 对！这不是很刺激吗？

translation.en: Do you consider yourself a good mother ?
translation.zh: 你认为自己是个好母亲吗？

translation.en: Yes , I'm a very good mother and successful career woman .
translation.zh: 是的，我是一个非常好的母亲，同时也是一个成功的职业女性。

translation.en: How can you manage to do both ? I mean , it is so hard to be a working mother .
translation.zh: 你怎么做到同时兼顾的呢？我是想说，做一个有工作的母亲太难了。

translation.en: I think the most important thing is that you should be nice to yourself , like keeping housework simple , spending money on things that make life easier , buying yourself things you like , and so on . You can only be nice to others when you can be nice to yourself .
translation.zh: 我认为最重要的是你应该善待自己，比如尽量简化家务劳动，花钱让生活更轻松，给自己买喜欢的东西，等等。只有对自己好的时候才能对别人好。

translation.en: Does your husband feel the same ?
translation.zh: 你丈夫也有同感吗？

translation.en: Yes . He is very understanding and supportive .
translation.zh: 对。他非常理解，并且支持。

translation.en: Do you like being a doctor ?
translation.zh: 你喜欢当医生吗？

translation.en: Yes , most of the time . But , sometimes things can get difficult .
translation.zh: 是的，大多数时候都很喜欢。但是，有时候事情会变得难。

translation.en: Can you tell me about it ?
translation.zh: 你能和我说说吗？

translation.en: You know , sometimes patients can get very unreasonable . They may insist they are sick when they are not .
translation.zh: 你知道，有时候病人会变得很不讲理。他们可能会坚持说自己生病了，其实并没有。

translation.en: What can you do when this happens ?
translation.zh: 这种情况下，你能做些什么？

translation.en: Not much , usually I'll just keep silent .
translation.zh: 能做的不多，通常我会保持沉默。

translation.en: Sure . It's probably a skiing show . Adam told me there are many skiing clubs whose members put on shows to attract more visitors .
translation.zh: 好的。可能是滑雪表演。亚当告诉我，有许多滑雪俱乐部会举行表演来吸引更多的游客。

translation.en: Look at that . It's so dangerous . My mom would never allow me to do that .
translation.zh: 看那个。太危险了。我妈妈不会允许我那样做的。

translation.en: Stop all this fuss and enjoy the show .
translation.zh: 别大惊小怪了，好好享受这场演出吧。

translation.en: You are right . But what if an avalanche happened ?
translation.zh: 你是对的。但如果发生雪崩了呢？

translation.en: They are all great skiers and very experienced . So I suppose the chance for them to be buried by an avalanche is slim .
translation.zh: 他们都是滑雪高手，经验丰富。所以我想他们被埋在雪里的可能性很小。

translation.en: Anyway , the show is breathtaking . By the way , where did they get so much snow here ?
translation.zh: 不管怎么说，这场演出真是令人叹为观止。顺便问一下，这里怎么会有这么多雪？

translation.en: Well , they have the most advanced snowmaking machine .
translation.zh: 嗯，他们有最先进的造雪机。

translation.en: It's possible .
translation.zh: 有可能。

translation.en: The restaurant across the street hired a new Chinese chef , so I ordered some Chinese food there for this evening .
translation.zh: 街对面的餐馆雇了一位新来的中国厨师，所以我在那里订了一些中餐当晚饭。

translation.en: Good . I love Chinese food . What did you order ?
translation.zh: 很好。我喜欢中国菜。你点了什么？

translation.en: Something hot and spicy . They look very inviting on the menu . You are going to love them .
translation.zh: 辣的食物。菜单上的菜看起来很诱人。你会爱上它们的。

translation.en: Maybe we can find a place to learn some Chinese cooking . I hear there's a place in Chinatown where you can take some courses . Are you interested ?
translation.zh: 也许我们可以找个地方学做中国菜。我听说唐人街有个地方，你可以在那里上课学习。你有兴趣吗？

translation.en: I'm not sure . I don't enjoy cooking that much . As long as we can order it from a restaurant , we don't have to learn to do it by ourselves .
translation.zh: 我不确定。我不太喜欢做饭。只要我们能从餐厅点餐，就不用自己学了。

translation.en: You are right . But I just want to know how they prepare food and make it taste so different .
translation.zh: 是的。但我想知道他们是怎么准备食材的，又是怎么让食物变得与众不同的。

translation.en: Hello , Tom . Where are you heading for ?
translation.zh: 你好，汤姆。你要去哪里？

translation.en: I am going to a movie theater . You know there is a new action film produced by Hollywood . A thriller , really .
translation.zh: 我要去电影院。你知道好莱坞出了一部新的动作片。一部惊悚片，真的。

translation.en: Another terror film ? There is too much terror and violence in the films . Do you like seeing such a picture ?
translation.zh: 又一部恐怖片？电影里有太多的恐怖和暴力。你喜欢看这样的画面吗？

translation.en: I don't really like seeing bloody frames , but I appreciate the lifelike frames simulated with the highly skillful special effects .
translation.zh: 我真的不喜欢看到血腥的画面，但我欣赏逼真的画面和高水平的特效。

translation.en: Are you free tomorrow night ?
translation.zh: 你明晚有空吗？

translation.en: Shall we have dinner together ?
translation.zh: 我们一起吃晚饭好吗？

translation.en: Do you have a special restaurant in mind ?
translation.zh: 你有想去的餐馆吗？

translation.en: Yes , I do . I know a place that has excellent food .
translation.zh: 是的。我知道一个地方食物很好吃。

translation.en: OK . I'll be happy to join you .
translation.zh: 好的，我很愿意和你一起去吃饭。

translation.en: Mary and Tom are breaking up .
translation.zh: 玛丽和汤姆要分手了。

translation.en: It's unbelievable ! They are only married for one month . Then who is at fault ?
translation.zh: 太不可思议了！他们才结婚一个月。谁是过错一方？

translation.en: Mary said she couldn't put up with Tom , for he fell in love with another woman .
translation.zh: 玛丽说她受不了汤姆了，因为他爱上了另一个女人。

translation.en: Do you think they'll become reconciled ?
translation.zh: 你认为他们会和解吗？

translation.en: No , I don't think so . She said she would rather be single than cope with an unhappy marriage .
translation.zh: 不，我不认为。她说她宁愿单身也不愿在婚姻里不开心。

translation.en: What a shame ! Their marriage is really a mistake .
translation.zh: 真遗憾！他们的婚姻真是个错误。

translation.en: Excuse me Miao Li . Could you tell me who Jackie Chan is ?
translation.zh: 对不起，李淼。你能告诉我杰克陈是谁吗？

translation.en: Certainly . Jackie Chan is a very famous movie star in Hong Kong . His Chinese name is Cheng Long .
translation.zh: 当然。杰克陈是香港非常有名的电影明星。他的中文名字叫成龙。

translation.en: Ha , I know Cheng Long a lot , he has made 40 films since 1976 . And at that time he was promoted as the new Bruce Lee . But I'm not familiar with his English name .
translation.zh: 哈，我很了解成龙，他从1976年开始拍了40部电影。那时他被誉为李小龙第二。但我不知道他的英文名字。

translation.en: OK . Then tell me what else you know .
translation.zh: 好的，那告诉我你还知道些什么。

translation.en: Some movie stars measure their worth by how many millions of dollars they make . Do you know how Jackie Chan measures his worth ?
translation.zh: 一些电影明星用赚了几百万美元来衡量他们自己的价值。你知道成龙如何衡量他自己的价值吗？

translation.en: He measures his worth by how many of his bones he has fractured while executing his film , incredible stunts . By the way , can you count the breaks ?
translation.zh: 他衡量自己价值的标准是他在完成电影特技时断了多少根骨头。顺便问一下，你知道他断了多少根骨头吗？

translation.en: Sure . His skull , his eyes , his nose , three times , his jaw , his shoul-der , is chest , two fingers , a knee . As he said ' Everything from the top of my head to the bottom of my feet ! '
translation.zh: 当然。他的头骨，眼睛，鼻子，这已经三次了，还有他的下巴，他的肩膀，胸部，两个手指，膝盖。就像他说的“从头顶到脚底的一切！”

translation.en: Indeed you know much about him .
translation.zh: 你确实对他很了解。

translation.en: This is because he is the action-movie incarnate or action-star extraordinaire around the world .
translation.zh: 这是因为他就是动作片的化身，或者说他是非凡的动作明星。

translation.en: You are an outgoing person , quite easy to talk with .
translation.zh: 你很外向，很容易交谈。

translation.en: Yes , my friends like to get along with me well .
translation.zh: 是的，我的朋友喜欢和我在一起。

translation.en: Do you have many friends ?
translation.zh: 你有很多朋友吗？

translation.en: Yes , I like to make new friends .
translation.zh: 是的，我喜欢交新朋友。

translation.en: What do you usually do with them ?
translation.zh: 你通常和他们做什么？

translation.en: We like to get together , chat and enjoy beautiful music .
translation.zh: 我们喜欢聚在一起，聊天，欣赏优美的音乐。

translation.en: Hi . Have you got a personal computer ?
translation.zh: 你好。你有个人电脑吗？

translation.en: Certainly . What's the matter ?
translation.zh: 当然。怎么了？

translation.en: I wonder if you often trade with others on the internet .
translation.zh: 我想知道你是否经常在网上和别人交易。

translation.en: Sure . I often buy things or do business through it without going out to the physical stores .
translation.zh: 当然。我经常通过它买东西或做生意，反而不怎么去实体店。

translation.en: Great ! It's just like viewless stores . But how can you shop or order on line or trade on line ?
translation.zh: 太棒了！它们就像看不见的商店。但你是怎么在网上购物、订购或交易的呢？

translation.en: That's simple . Just click the hyperlink , www.taobao.com or www . ebay.com , and you can see the specimen of the goods shown on the screen , and then you can place an order online with the sales company . And the goods will be delivered to your place .
translation.zh: 这很简单。只需点击超链接，www.taobao.com 或www.ebay.com，您可以看到屏幕上显示的商品样品，然后您可以向销售公司在线下订单。货物会送到你所在的地方。

translation.en: Is the service charged ?
translation.zh: 服务收费吗？

translation.en: No . it's free .
translation.zh: 不。它是免费的。

translation.en: Really . I'll get a computer at once .
translation.zh: 真的吗。我马上去买台电脑。

translation.en: Hi ! I'm happy you could make it .
translation.zh: 你好！很高兴见到你。

translation.en: Well , I've been looking forward to seeing you .
translation.zh: 嗯，我一直希望见到你。

translation.en: I'd love a gin and tonic .
translation.zh: 我想要一杯金汤力。

translation.en: What happened ? Why didn't he win ?
translation.zh: 发生什么事了？他为什么没赢？

translation.en: Didn't you hear ? He was disqualified .
translation.zh: 你没听见吗？他被取消了资格。

translation.en: How did that happen ? He's so talented ! I thought he had a great chance of winning a gold medal !
translation.zh: 怎么会这样？他很有才华！我认为他很有可能赢得金牌！

translation.en: If he didn't have any drug problems , he would have won .
translation.zh: 如果没有出现药物问题，他应该会赢的。

translation.en: What ? What kind of drugs was he using ?
translation.zh: 什么？他服用了哪种类型的药物?

translation.en: He was taking steroids to make him stronger and faster .
translation.zh: 他服用了类固醇类的药物，为了让自己跑得更快,更有力。

translation.en: They are . The only reason they didn't disqualify him until after the race is because the results from the text only came back afterwards .
translation.zh: 是的。这次之所以在比赛之后才取消他的资格，是因为药检的结果出来的晚了。

translation.en: That's so disappointing . I don't know why top athletes would feel the need to take drugs .
translation.zh: 太令人失望了。我不明白为什么顶尖选手还觉得自己需要服用药物。

translation.en: Regardless of how much pressure you're under , there's never a good reason to take drugs .
translation.zh: 无论他们承受了多大压力，都没有理由吸毒。

translation.en: Let's hope so .
translation.zh: 但愿如此。

translation.en: Did you watch the volleyball match last night ?
translation.zh: 你昨晚看排球赛了吗？

translation.en: China beat Brazil 3 to 0 .
translation.zh: 中国队以3比0击败巴西队。

translation.en: Wonderful !
translation.zh: 太棒了！

translation.en: I just sense . But I cannot grow anymore . My boss is not really supporting me . I am interested in some positions in other JV companies , but I need to do some more in-depth research before I send my application letters out .
translation.zh: 我只是意识到，我在这个公司不能再成长了。我的老板不是真的支持我。我对其他合资公司的一些职位很感兴趣，但在发简历之前，我需要做一些更深入的调查。

translation.en: Are you free this weekend , Miss Rose ?
translation.zh: 你这个周末有空吗，罗斯小姐？

translation.en: Yes , I am . What's up ?
translation.zh: 是的，我有空。怎么了？

translation.en: Then would you please go to a dance party with me ?
translation.zh: 那你能和我一起去参加舞会吗？

translation.en: With pleasure . I suppose you dance often .
translation.zh: 我很乐意。我猜你经常跳舞。

translation.en: Oh , no . As a matter of fact , I haven't danced for a long time .
translation.zh: 哦，不。事实上，我很久没跳舞了。

translation.en: But I am told that you dance wonderfully well .
translation.zh: 但我听说你跳舞跳得很好。

translation.en: What's your favorite dance ?
translation.zh: 你最喜欢的舞蹈是什么？

translation.en: It's hard to say , but I do love the foxtrot and waltz .
translation.zh: 很难说，但我喜欢狐步舞和华尔兹。

translation.en: How about rock'n'roll ?
translation.zh: 摇滚呢？

translation.en: To tell you the truth , I don't like it . It's too noisy .
translation.zh: 说实话，我不喜欢。太吵了。

translation.en: And the tango ?
translation.zh: 探戈呢？

translation.en: Oh , it's really beautiful , but I just can't do it well .
translation.zh: 哦，探戈很好看，但我就是跳不好。

translation.en: Don't be so modest . I'm sure you can do it very well . Then I'll meet you at six . Is that at all right ?
translation.zh: 别那么谦虚。我相信你能做得很好。那我们六点见，行吗？

translation.en: Great ! I'm your lucky fellow then .
translation.zh: 太好了！那我就是你的舞伴了，真幸运。

translation.en: I know you have a son . How old is he ?
translation.zh: 我知道你有个儿子。他多大了？

translation.en: He's going to turn six next month .
translation.zh: 他下个月就满六岁了。

translation.en: Who is looking after him ?
translation.zh: 谁在照顾他？

translation.en: My mother-in - law . She retired last year .
translation.zh: 我岳母。她去年退休了。

translation.en: You really are lucky !
translation.zh: 你真幸运！

translation.en: Would you care to join for the picnic tomorrow ?
translation.zh: 你愿意参加明天的野餐吗？

translation.en: Much to my regret , I'll have to meet my girlfriend at the airport then .
translation.zh: 很遗憾，我得去机场接我女朋友。

translation.en: We'd like to invite you for our dress party tomorrow evening , are you free ?
translation.zh: 我们想邀请你参加明晚的服装晚会，你有空吗？

translation.en: Much as we'd like to , but we've booked up already for that time .
translation.zh: 尽管我们很想去，但那时候我们都有事。

translation.en: What a pity ! You can't join us .
translation.zh: 真可惜！你们不能加入我们。

translation.en: So sorry . Next time we'll go , thanks anyway .
translation.zh: 非常抱歉。下次我们会去的，谢谢了。

translation.en: Bill , do you know if the cafeteria around the corner's open today ?
translation.zh: 比尔，你知道街角的自助餐厅今天营业吗？

translation.en: Yes . They were open this morning when I came to work . They must've finished remodeling . Why do you want to know ?
translation.zh: 对。今天早上我来上班的时候他们正在开门。他们一定已经完成了改造。你为什么这么问？

translation.en: Well , I thought that maybe we could go there for lunch today . That is , if you haven't promised to go with someone else .
translation.zh: 嗯，我想我们今天可以去那里吃午饭。如果你没有答应和别人一起去的话。

translation.en: That'd be wonderful , Peter . But I hope you're in a better mood than you were this morning .
translation.zh: 那太好了，彼得。但我希望你现在的心情比今天早上要好。

translation.en: I'm sorry I was such a grouch . It must've been the weather . When it rains I get depressed .
translation.zh: 对不起，我太不高兴了。一定是因为天气。下雨的时候我总是很沮丧。

translation.en: Forget it . I'll see you at 11:30 am .
translation.zh: 不必在意。11:30见。

translation.en: Have you enjoyed your weekend ?
translation.zh: 你周末过得愉快吗？

translation.en: Yes , it's been marvelous . It really was very kind of you to invite me . I hope it hasn't been too much trouble .
translation.zh: 是的，太棒了。你邀请了我真是太好了。我希望没给你带来麻烦。

translation.en: Not at all . We've really enjoyed having you . I hope you'll come and stay again next time you're in Changsha .
translation.zh: 一点也不。我们真的很高兴你来了。我希望你下次来长沙时再来住。

translation.en: Has Robert ever missed coming to one of our parties ?
translation.zh: 罗伯特有没有缺席过我们的聚会？

translation.en: Only once or twice at the most .
translation.zh: 最多只有一两次。

translation.en: Do you know why ?
translation.zh: 你知道为什么吗？

translation.en: Hey , Blake ! Are you still listening to Mozart ?
translation.zh: 嘿，布莱克！你还在听莫扎特的音乐吗？

translation.en: Yes.Do you like it ?
translation.zh: 是的。你喜欢吗？

translation.en: It's great . and I ' Ve heard that listening to Mozart can make you more intelligent .
translation.zh: 他的音乐太棒了。我听说听莫扎特的音乐能让人更聪明。

translation.en: Really ? I've never heard that before . I just like it .
translation.zh: 真的？我以前从没听说过。我就是喜欢。

translation.en: Is classical music your favorite ?
translation.zh: 你最喜欢古典音乐吗？

translation.en: I Like pop music best . Classical music is a bit too heavy for me . I can't get fully relaxed in it .
translation.zh: 我最喜欢流行音乐。古典音乐对我来说有点太沉重了。我不能完全放松。

translation.en: Pop music doesn't have any depth for me .
translation.zh: 流行音乐对我来说没有任何深度。

translation.en: Yeah , that's why I can enjoy myself in it .
translation.zh: 是啊，这就是为什么我喜欢流行音乐。

translation.en: Did you always like pop music .
translation.zh: 你一直都喜欢流行音乐吗？

translation.en: I think so , since I was in primary school . How long have you been interested in classical music .
translation.zh: 是的，从我上小学就喜欢了。你喜欢古典音乐多久了？

translation.en: I didn't like it at all until I started to learn violin when I was eight . From then on . classical music has been an important part of my life .
translation.zh: 我之前一点也不喜欢，直到我八岁开始学小提琴。从那时起。古典音乐一直是我生活中重要的一部分。

translation.en: oh , I didn't know you can play the violin . Do you still play .
translation.zh: 哦，我都不知道你会拉小提琴。你现在还拉吗？

translation.en: Sometimes , but these days I'm often too busy .
translation.zh: 有时候会，但这些天我太忙了。

translation.en: We are just going round the corner for a drink . Won't you join us ?
translation.zh: 我们正要去街角喝一杯。你和我们一起吗？

translation.en: Well , I'd like to , but I am not sure I have time .
translation.zh: 嗯，我很想去，但我不确定我有时间。

translation.en: Oh , come on ! Just a quick one !
translation.zh: 哦，来吧！一会儿就结束了！

translation.en: All right , just a quick one .
translation.zh: 好吧，我就待一会儿。

translation.en: Brian , do you know how to speak English ?
translation.zh: 布莱恩，你会说英语吗？

translation.en: Where did you learn ?
translation.zh: 你在哪里学的？

translation.en: I learned in college .
translation.zh: 在大学。

translation.en: You speak really well .
translation.zh: 你英语说得很好。

translation.en: How long have you been in the U . S . ?
translation.zh: 你来美国多久了？

translation.en: 3 weeks .
Is your wife with you ?
translation.zh: 你妻子和你在一起吗？

translation.en: Yes , she just got here yesterday .
translation.zh: 是的，她昨天刚到这儿。

translation.en: Have you been to California before ?
translation.zh: 你以前去过加利福尼亚吗？

translation.en: No . I've never been there .
translation.zh: 没有。我从没去过那里。

translation.en: Have you ever been to Las Vegas ?
translation.zh: 你去过拉斯维加斯吗？

translation.en: Yes . I went there once on a business trip .
translation.zh: 去过。我有一次出差去过那里。

translation.en: Jeff , I'm going to the supermarket . Do you want to come with me ?
translation.zh: 杰夫，我要去超市。你想和我一起去吗？

translation.en: I think the supermarket is closed now .
translation.zh: 我想超市现在关门了。

translation.en: Oh , When does it close ?
translation.zh: 哦，什么时候关门？

translation.en: It closes at 7:00 on Sundays .
translation.zh: 星期天七点关门。

translation.en: Don't worry , we can go tomorrow morning . It opens at 8: 00 .
translation.zh: 别担心，我们可以明天早上去。8点开门。

translation.en: Alright . What do you want to do now ?
translation.zh: 好吧。你现在想做什么？

translation.en: Let's take a walk for a half an hour . My sister will get here at about 8: 30PM and then we can all go out to dinner .
translation.zh: 我们散半个小时步吧。我妹妹晚上八点半左右到，然后我们就可以出去吃饭了。

translation.en: Where does she live ?
translation.zh: 她住在哪里？

translation.en: She lives in San Francisco .
translation.zh: 旧金山。

translation.en: How long has she lived there ?
translation.zh: 她住在那里多久了？

translation.en: I think she's lived there for about 10 years .
translation.zh: 我想她已经在那里住了10年了。

translation.en: That's a long time . Where did she live before that ?
translation.zh: 那是很长的一段时间啊。在那之前她住在哪里？

translation.en: San Diego .
translation.zh: 圣地亚哥。

translation.en: Sarah , what did you do today ?
translation.zh: 莎拉，你今天做了什么？

translation.en: I went shopping .
translation.zh: 我去购物了。

translation.en: Did you buy anything ?
translation.zh: 你买了什么吗？

translation.en: Yes , I bought a few things .
translation.zh: 是的，我买了一些东西。

translation.en: I bought this coat . Do you like it ?
translation.zh: 这件外套。你喜欢吗？

translation.en: Yeah , I like it a lot . It's very pretty . Where did you buy it ?
translation.zh: 我很喜欢，非常漂亮。你在哪里买的？

translation.en: At the mall on 5th street .
translation.zh: 在第五大街的购物中心。

translation.en: No , it wasn't expensive . It was on sale for 20 dollars .
translation.zh: 不，不贵。它在促销，只要20美元。

translation.en: That's cheap .
translation.zh: 那很便宜。

translation.en: I know . It was a really good deal .
translation.zh: 我知道。这真的很划算。

translation.en: I don't think you'll need to wear it for a while . It's been really hot lately .
translation.zh: 我想你这一段时间还不能穿。最近真的很热。

translation.en: Hi Melissa , are you going home this weekend ?
translation.zh: 嗨，梅丽莎，这个周末你要回家吗？

translation.en: No , not this weekend . I have too much work to do .
translation.zh: 不，这个周末不行。我有太多的工作要做。

translation.en: My father lives in Washington DC .
translation.zh: 我父亲住在华盛顿特区。

translation.en: How about your mother ?
translation.zh: 你妈妈呢？

translation.en: My mother died two years ago .
translation.zh: 我母亲两年前去世了。

translation.en: Oh , I am sorry to hear that . Is your father still working ?
translation.zh: 哦，听到这个我很难过。你父亲还在工作吗？

translation.en: No , he's retired .
translation.zh: 不，他退休了。

translation.en: Do you have any family here ?
translation.zh: 你在这里有家人吗？

translation.en: Yes , two of my cousins live here and my aunt and uncle live about 30 miles from here .
translation.zh: 有，我的两个堂兄弟住在这里，我的姑姑和叔叔住在离这里大约30英里的地方。

translation.en: Do you have any brothers or sisters ?
translation.zh: 你有兄弟姐妹吗？

translation.en: Yes , I have two brothers who live in New York and a sister who lives in Boston .
translation.zh: 是的，我有两个兄弟，住在纽约，和一个妹妹，住在波士顿。

translation.en: Do you see them a lot ?
translation.zh: 你经常和他们见面吗？

translation.en: Not as much as I'd like to . Usually just on holidays like Thanksgiving and Christmas .
translation.zh: 没有我想的那么多。通常只在感恩节和圣诞节这样的节日才见面。

translation.en: Lee , I'm going to get married next month .
translation.zh: 李，我下个月就要结婚了。

translation.en: Good news ! And congratulations !
translation.zh: 好消息！恭喜你！

translation.en: You are invited to my wedding .
translation.zh: 我想邀请你参加我的婚礼。

translation.en: Thank you . I'll certainly be there .
translation.zh: 非常感谢。我一定会去的。

translation.en: What is life ?
translation.zh: 什么是生命？

translation.en: Don't ask such a question . You know it has no certain answer . Everyone knows it is in his heart .
translation.zh: 别问这样的问题。你知道，这没有固定的答案。每个人的心里都有自己的答案。

translation.en: Then do you think that life is arranged by something above us .
translation.zh: 那么你认为人生是由高于我们的东西安排的吗。

translation.en: Maybe , the whirligig of time , who knows ?
translation.zh: 也许，命运的变迁，谁知道呢？

translation.en: Hello , Daisy , how are you doing ?
translation.zh: 你好，黛西，你好吗？

translation.en: Fine , thank you . I haven ’ t seen you for quite some time . What have you been up to recently ?
translation.zh: 很好，谢谢。我好久没见到你了。你最近在忙什么？

translation.en: I have been spending a lot of time watching movies at home , so you wouldn't have seen me . Recently , I've been obsessed with horror films .
translation.zh: 我花了很多时间在家看电影，所以我不怎么露面。最近，我迷上了恐怖片。

translation.en: Oh , how can you be infatuated with horror films ? They're so scary .
translation.zh: 天哪，你怎么迷上恐怖片的？它们太吓人了。

translation.en: Yeah , you are right I used to not watch horror films , but after seeing Silence of the Lamb with Mike last month , I fell in love with them .
translation.zh: 是的，你说得对，我以前不看恐怖片，但上个月和迈克一起看了《沉默的羔羊》后，我就爱上了。

translation.en: It's amazing . But if I were you , I wouldn't have the courage to watch the first one .
translation.zh: 太神奇了。但如果我是你，我连看第一部的勇气都没有。

translation.en: But it's really exciting .
translation.zh: 但真的很刺激。

translation.en: Maybe , but I would rather watch romance , science fiction , crime or even disaster movie instead of a horror picture . I wouldn't dare sleep at night after watching one .
translation.zh: 也许吧，但我宁愿看爱情片、科幻片、犯罪片甚至灾难片，也不愿看恐怖片。我晚上看了一部就不敢睡觉了。

translation.en: Basically . you'll watch any type of movie except horror .
translation.zh: 基本上，除了恐怖片，你啥电影都能看。

translation.en: Yep .
translation.zh: 确实。

translation.en: I think you should have a try someday . Maybe you'll change your mind .
translation.zh: 我想哪天你应该试一试。也许你就不这么想了。

translation.en: Maybe . After all , I am grown up now .
translation.zh: 也许吧。毕竟我都长大了。

translation.en: You don't look too well . Maybe you should take the day off from work .
translation.zh: 你看起来不太好。也许你应该休息一天。

translation.en: Do you feel ok ?
translation.zh: 你觉得还好吗？

translation.en: Not really . After a 12 - hour flight , I've got jetlag , and on top of that , I think I've also got the flu .
translation.zh: 不怎么好。12个小时的飞行后，我要倒时差，除此之外，我想我还得了流感。

translation.en: Why don't you call your secretary and tell her to reschedule the meeting ? You should really get some rest or you'll end up feeling even worse than you do now .
translation.zh: 你为什么不打电话给你的秘书，让她重新安排会议呢？你应该好好休息，否则你会感觉更糟。

translation.en: Could you feel my forehead and check to see if I have a fever ?
translation.zh: 你能摸摸我的额头看看我有没有发烧吗？

translation.en: You're really hot . Let me get you some Tylenol to bring the fever down .
translation.zh: 你头好烫。我给你拿点泰诺退烧。

translation.en: Ok . I'll stay home this morning and rest , but if I feel better in the afternoon , I'm going to the meeting .
translation.zh: 好的，今天上午我要呆在家里休息，但如果下午感觉好些，我就去开会。

translation.en: It looks like you have a red rash all over you ! Are you allergic to anything ?
translation.zh: 看起来你全身都起了红疹！你对什么过敏吗？

translation.en: Just cats , but I don't think I was near any cats in the last couple of weeks .
translation.zh: 我只对猫过敏，但我在过去的几周里都没有接近猫。

translation.en: I completely forgot about your cat allergy . I took care of a cat for my friend here a few days ago . Oh no . we'd better go to the doctor and get some medicine . Let's go .
translation.zh: 我完全忘了你对猫过敏。几天前我在这里替我的朋友照看猫了。哦，不。我们最好去看医生，买些药。走吧。

translation.en: Shouldn't we make an appointment first ?
translation.zh: 我们不应该先预约吗？

translation.en: We would , but let's just go and see if there's an opening now before it gets worse .
translation.zh: 本来的确是需要的,但是在情况恶化之前,咱们还是赶紧去看看是不是有空缺吧。

translation.en: Whatever you say . I just want to get to my meeting !
translation.zh: 随你说什么。我只想回去开会！

translation.en: Wow ! What a beautiful scenic spot ! It's so open . And just breathe that fresh air , you can almost taste its freshness .
translation.zh: 哇！多美的风景啊！这个地方真开阔。呼吸一口新鲜空气，你几乎可以品尝到它的新鲜。

translation.en: You can have a bird view of Guiling City from the top of the mountain .
translation.zh: 你可以从山顶鸟瞰桂林市。

translation.en: You should . Many Guiliners , especially the old and the young , will climb mountains here in the morning .
translation.zh: 你确实应该这么做。许多桂林人，特别是老人和年轻人，早上都会在这里爬山。

translation.en: No wonder people say
translation.zh: 难怪人们说

translation.en: Quick ! Pass me your binoculars . Look at that bird ... I've never seen one of those before . It's indigenous to Guiling , and an endangered species too . This is lucky !
translation.zh: 快点！把你的望远镜递给我。看那只鸟...我以前从没见过这样的。它是桂林的本土物种，是濒危物种。真幸运！

translation.en: I didn't know you liked bird-watching .
translation.zh: 我都不知道你喜欢观鸟。

translation.en: How do you arrange this summer vacation ?
translation.zh: 你如何安排这个暑假？

translation.en: I want to travel .
translation.zh: 我想去旅行。

translation.en: The seaside .
translation.zh: 海边。

translation.en: That's really a good idea . Taking a walk on the beach and lying in the sun are pretty good . I recommend you Qingdao or Dalian .
translation.zh: 真是个好主意。在沙滩上散步，或者躺在阳光下都很不错。我推荐你去青岛或大连。

translation.en: I ’ Ve been to Qingdao before , so I ’ ll choose Dalian . I've heard that the environment there is very good .
translation.zh: 我以前去过青岛，所以我会选择大连。我听说那里的环境很好。

translation.en: Yes , that's a good place to spend a holiday . Last year I went there . It's really .
translation.zh: 是的，那是个度假的好地方。去年我去了那里。真的很好。

translation.en: His grandfather is the richest person in the area .
translation.zh: 他的祖父是这个地区最富有的人。

translation.en: What a miser ! He cycles to school every day .
translation.zh: 真是个吝啬鬼！他每天都骑自行车上学。

translation.en: His grandfather's money is not his .
translation.zh: 他祖父的钱不是他的。

translation.en: I can't understand him anyway .
translation.zh: 那我也不能理解他。

translation.en: I'm dreadfully sorry for you .
translation.zh: 我真为你难过。

translation.en: Is there any clue ?
translation.zh: 有什么线索吗？

translation.en: No , he left nothing .
translation.zh: 不，他什么也没留下。

translation.en: How upsetting ! He has been away for a week !
translation.zh: 真让人难过！他已经消失一个星期了！

translation.en: I don't know if anything terrible has happened .
translation.zh: 我不知道是否发生了什么可怕的事情。

translation.en: I have reported it to the police .
translation.zh: 我已经报警了。

translation.en: We'd better prepare for the worst .
translation.zh: 我们最好做最坏的打算。

translation.en: Yes . I did . I enjoyed it a lot.There was a folk singer , a violinist and a pianist .
translation.zh: 是的，我去了。我很喜欢。有一个民谣歌手，一个小提琴手和一个钢琴家。

translation.en: The acting of this film is marvelous in spite of the thin plot .
translation.zh: 这部电影尽管情节空泛，但演员们演技都很出色。

translation.en: I'm sorry for hero .
translation.zh: 我对男主角有点遗憾。

translation.en: I don't think there's any excuse for his acting in some parts .
translation.zh: 不知道怎么搞的，有的地方演得不好。

translation.en: Don't be too critical . We can't expect it to be perfect .
translation.zh: 别太挑剔了，我们不能期望它完美无缺。

translation.en: I hate to go outside .
translation.zh: 我讨厌出去。

translation.en: Why do you hate to go outside ?
translation.zh: 你为什么不喜欢出去？

translation.en: I meet too many jerks .
translation.zh: 我遇到太多混蛋了。

translation.en: This city is full of jerks .
translation.zh: 这个城市到处都是混蛋。

translation.en: Rude people are everywhere .
translation.zh: 到处都是粗鲁的人。

translation.en: But what can you do ?
translation.zh: 但是你能做什么呢？

translation.en: You can yell at them .
translation.zh: 你可以对他们大喊大叫。

translation.en: And they will yell back at you .
translation.zh: 他们也会对你大喊大叫。

translation.en: Yelling doesn't do any good .
translation.zh: 大喊大叫没有任何好处。

translation.en: No . The best thing to do is just stay home .
translation.zh: 不。最好还是呆在家里。

translation.en: Hi , Victor . How are you ?
translation.zh: 嗨，维克多。你好吗？

translation.en: Oh , I'm fine .
translation.zh: 哦，我很好。

translation.en: So , are you going to go to class tonight ?
translation.zh: 那么，你今晚要去上课吗？

translation.en: Maybe ... but I don't think so .
translation.zh: 也许吧。。。但我可能不去。

translation.en: Really ? What's the matter ?
translation.zh: 真的吗？怎么了？

translation.en: I don't know . I'm just feeling a little sad .
translation.zh: 我不知道。我只是觉得有点难过。

translation.en: Listen . Come with me to class , and after class we can go out for dinner .
translation.zh: 听着。跟我一起去上课，下课后我们可以出去吃晚饭。

translation.en: Now that's a good idea . Thanks a lot , Brian . I'm feeling better already .
translation.zh: 这是个好主意。非常感谢，布莱恩。我现在感觉好多了。

translation.en: I can't believe how hot it is .
translation.zh: 我真不敢相信竟然这么热。

translation.en: It's not even noon yet .
translation.zh: 现在还不到中午。

translation.en: That means it will get hotter .
translation.zh: 这意味着之后会更热

translation.en: I am dying from the heat .
translation.zh: 我快热死了。

translation.en: Turn on the air conditioner .
translation.zh: 打开空调吧

translation.en: It doesn't work .
translation.zh: 它坏了。

translation.en: Did you call the repairman ?
translation.zh: 你打电话给修理工了吗？

translation.en: When is he coming ?
translation.zh: 他什么时候来？

translation.en: He's busy . He said next week .
translation.zh: 他很忙。下周才来。

translation.en: Diane Grant ? I haven't seen you for ages !
translation.zh: 黛安·格兰特？我好久没见到你了！

translation.en: Brian ! How have you been ?
translation.zh: 布莱恩！你最近怎么样？

translation.en: Pretty good . Say , you've really changed !
translation.zh: 不错。话说，你真的变化很大！

translation.en: Oh , well , I've lost some weight . And my hair is longer than before .
translation.zh: 哦，好吧，我瘦了一些。头发也比以前长了。

translation.en: Well , you look great ! How are you ?
translation.zh: 嗯，你看起来棒极了！你过得怎样？

translation.en: I'm doing really well . I got married about three years ago . I have two kids now .
translation.zh: 我过得很好。我大概在三年前结婚了，现在有两个孩子。

translation.en: Mary , it's good to see you !
translation.zh: 玛丽，很高兴见到你。

translation.en: Josh and I were just on our way back home from the beach and thought we'd drop by .
translation.zh: 我和约什刚从海滩回家，想顺便过来看看。

translation.en: I am so glad that you decided to stop by !
translation.zh: 很高兴见到你们。

translation.en: Yes , it has been a long time since we have seen you .
translation.zh: 对，我们很久都没见到你。

translation.en: Mary , can I get Josh or you something to drink ?
translation.zh: 玛丽，我给乔希或你拿点喝的吧。

translation.en: Oh no , thank you . We aren't all that thirsty .
translation.zh: 哦，不，谢谢。我们并不渴。

translation.en: How about a little snack then ?
translation.zh: 那么来点吃的怎么样。

translation.en: No , thank you , we just ate lunch a little while ago .
translation.zh: 不，谢谢，我们刚吃过午饭。

translation.en: Well then , how is your family ?
translation.zh: 那么，你的家人好吗？

translation.en: Everyone is doing great . My sister finally had her baby .
translation.zh: 每个人都很好。我妹妹终于有自己的孩子了。

translation.en: Excuse me , I'd like to ask you a few questions about the city .
translation.zh: 打扰一下，我想问你几个关于这个城市的问题。

translation.en: My wife wants to take the children to go shopping , where is the best place to go ?
translation.zh: 我妻子想带孩子们去购物，去哪里最好？

translation.en: I would recommend the mall , it's about 20 minutes , drive to the south in a taxi . It has a wide range of shops and restaurants .
translation.zh: 我推荐购物中心，坐出租车大约20分钟，在南边。它有各种各样的商店和餐馆。

translation.en: Thank you . Also , we'd like to do some sightseeing while we're in town . Can you recommend some local attractions ?
translation.zh: 非常感谢。另外，我们想在城里观光一下。你能推荐一些当地的景点吗？

translation.en: How old are your children ?
translation.zh: 你的孩子多大了？

translation.en: I have a 10 - year-old boy and a 6 - year-old girl .
translation.zh: 我有一个10岁的男孩和一个6岁的女孩。

translation.en: I would recommend a day at the zoo . It's fun for all the family . There is also a water park just outside the city if you would like a day trip .
translation.zh: 我建议你去动物园玩一天。对全家人来说这都很有趣。如果你想要一日游，城外还有一个水上公园。

translation.en: It sounds marvelous . Thank you for your help .
translation.zh: 听起来太棒了。谢谢你的帮助。

translation.en: It's said that John's broken up .
translation.zh: 听说约翰离婚了。

translation.en: Really ? But his wife has always waited on him hand and foot .
translation.zh: 真的吗？但是他的妻子对他总是照顾得体贴入微。

translation.en: I hear that John's leading a double wife .
translation.zh: 我听说约翰有了婚外情。

translation.en: It's very bad of him to cheat on a lady like his wife .
translation.zh: 他这样对待他的妻子简直太过分了。

translation.en: Cool , fellow , what's the date today , buddy ?
translation.zh: 冷静下来，朋友，今天几号？

translation.en: It was funny .
translation.zh: 很有趣。

translation.en: Well , we drove through the valley on our way there in the morning . It was a magnificent sight .
translation.zh: 嗯，我们早上开车穿过山谷到达那里。景象很壮丽。

translation.en: Did you stop at the big waterfall for pictures ?
translation.zh: 你在大瀑布那里停下来拍照了吗？

translation.en: Sure , we wouldn't miss it for anything . After that , we took a short cut to the park . There was very little traffic , so we got there in less than an hour .
translation.zh: 当然，我们不会错过的。之后，我们抄近路去公园。路上没什么车，所以我们不到一个小时就到了。

translation.en: You were lucky then . What did you do after that ?
translation.zh: 你很幸运。那之后你做了什么？

translation.en: We went for a swim in the sea . That was the best part of the day . Just look at my nice tan .
translation.zh: 我们去海里游泳了。那是一天中最美好的时光。看看我漂亮的棕褐色皮肤。

translation.en: Yes , you're right . And I was so tired that I fell asleep on the way back . My arms are still stiff from the swim yesterday .
translation.zh: 是的，你说得对。我太累了，在回来的路上睡着了。昨天游了泳，我现在胳膊还很僵硬。

translation.en: Don ’ t you agree that all the thieves should be punished by cutting off their fingers ?
translation.zh: 你不同意所有的小偷都应该被砍掉手指吗？

translation.en: I ’ m afraid many people would turn thumbs down on it .
translation.zh: 恐怕很多人都不会赞成。

translation.en: Don ’ t you think in that case , there wouldn ’ t be so much stealing ?
translation.zh: 你不觉得那样的话，就不会有那么多偷窃了吗？

translation.en: Definitely . But I think it is too fierce .
translation.zh: 确实是。但我觉得太残忍了。

translation.en: But I actually dislike another lady . She is more capable and seems to have ideas of her own . But the trouble is she is a backseat driver with some of us . She would tell you what to do and where to put things .
translation.zh: 但我真的不喜欢另一位女士。她更有能力，似乎有自己的想法。但问题是她老是对我们指手画脚。她告诉你该做什么，把东西放在哪里。

translation.en: Isn't it wonderful walking here ?
translation.zh: 在这里散步不是很好吗？

translation.en: I mean look at all these magnificent buildings around us .
translation.zh: 我是说看看我们周围这些宏伟的建筑。

translation.en: Yes , look over there . That's the Empire State Building . My book says it's 102 stories tall .
translation.zh: 是的，看那边。那是帝国大厦。我的书上说它有102层楼高。

translation.en: It's quite famous but don't you think it looks a bit old-fashioned ?
translation.zh: 它很有名，但你不觉得它看起来有点过时吗？

translation.en: You're right , but when it was built in 1930 it was a marvel of technology and engineering .
translation.zh: 你说得对，但当它建于1930年时，它是一个技术和工程的奇迹。

translation.en: What other important buildings are we going to see on Fifth Avenue ?
translation.zh: 在第五大道上我们还将看到哪些重要的建筑？

translation.en: Quite a number . Actually every skyscraper has a history . A few blocks ahead we'll see St.Patrick ' s Cathedral and just across the street will be the world-renowed Rockefeller Center . It's a landmark in the history of architecture .
translation.zh: 相当多。实际上，每座摩天大楼都有一段历史。再往前走几个街区，我们就能看到圣帕特里克大教堂，街对面就是举世闻名的洛克菲勒中心。它是建筑史上的里程碑。

translation.en: What's there after that ?
translation.zh: 那之后是什么？

translation.en: Well then , there's a Central Park . Facing the park on Fifth Avenue is probably some of the most expensive properties in the world .
translation.zh: 那之后，有一个中央公园。面对第五大道上的公园可能是世界上最昂贵的物业之一。

translation.en: What are they all for ?
translation.zh: 它们都是干什么用的？

translation.en: Most of them are office buildings , huge department stores , and hotels but some are just private homes . New York is one of the financial centers of the world . And there are lots of very expensive places .
translation.zh: 其中大部分是办公楼、大型百货公司和酒店，但有些只是私人住宅。纽约是世界金融中心之一。还有很多非常昂贵的地方。

translation.en: I often recalled the days when Tom and I were madly in love .
translation.zh: 我经常想起我和汤姆热恋的日子。

translation.en: Very romantic ?
translation.zh: 很浪漫吗？

translation.en: Yeah . He always tickled my finny bone with his college stories .
translation.zh: 是的。他总是用大学里好玩的事逗我发笑。

translation.en: You married him for that reason ?
translation.zh: 你嫁给他是因为这个？

translation.en: Definitely not . The most important thing was we loved each other .
translation.zh: 当然不是。最重要的是我们彼此相爱。

translation.en: It is too bad today .
translation.zh: 今天太糟了。

translation.en: My som was lost . I told him to stand rooted to the spot when I went shopping , but he ignored it .
translation.zh: 我的儿子走丢了。我去购物的时候，叫他站在原地，但他不听话。

translation.en: How did you find him at last ?
translation.zh: 你最后是怎么找到他的？

translation.en: It was the police wo helped me to do that .
translation.zh: 警察帮我找到的。

translation.en: It must have taught you a lesson this time .
translation.zh: 这次一定给你上了一课。

translation.en: Tim ’ s smiles are interesting .
translation.zh: 蒂姆的笑容很有趣。

translation.en: Yes , they are shy and gentle but very powerful .
translation.zh: 是的，害羞，温柔，但又非常强大。

translation.en: You are right . They sweep Nancy off her feet . And now she fell head over heels in love with him .
translation.zh: 对的。他的笑容迷倒了南希。现在她深深爱上了他。

translation.en: How wonderful it would be if I had such smiles !
translation.zh: 如果我有这样的笑容该多好啊！

translation.en: I don ’ t think so . I think the government should do everything it can to discourage people from smoking .
translation.zh: 我不这么认为。我认为政府应该尽一切努力阻止人们吸烟。

translation.en: Maybe so . But a law banning cigarettes will do no good .
translation.zh: 也许吧。但是颁布禁止吸烟的法规是行不通的。

translation.en: No , you can ’ t suddenly make smoking illegal , but government could prohibit smoking in public places like movies and theatres .
translation.zh: 对，你不能突然把吸烟定为非法，但政府可以禁止人们在电影和剧院等公共场所吸烟。

translation.en: Guess who I saw just now ?
translation.zh: 你猜我刚才看见谁了？

translation.en: John Smith , the escaped criminal .
translation.zh: 约翰·史密斯，那个逃犯。

translation.en: That bad egg , who took the low road since he was a boy .
translation.zh: 那个坏蛋，他从小就走不学好。

translation.en: I think I must report to the cops .
translation.zh: 我想我必须向警察报告。

translation.en: It's got to be almost a year now .
translation.zh: 快一年了。

translation.en: Yeah , I remember the neighborhood . Have you found a place yet ?
translation.zh: 是的，我记得那个社区。你找到地方了吗？

translation.en: Not yet . But I am still looking through the classifieds . Wish me luck .
translation.zh: 还没有。我还在看广告。祝我好运。

translation.en: Well , maybe I can help . Remember my neighbor ?
translation.zh: 嗯，也许我能帮上忙。还记得我的邻居吗？

translation.en: Yes , her daughter's having a baby , so she's moving in with her to help out . I think if you are interested , you can come over and have a look .
translation.zh: 是的，她女儿要生孩子了，所以她要搬去帮忙。我想如果你有兴趣，可以过来看看。

translation.en: Great . It's a lovely neighborhood . And it would be nice to be neighbors again . It would be just like the old days !
translation.zh: 太好了。那是一个很好的社区。再次和你成为邻居也很好。我们就能像过去一样！

translation.en: Every time when heroes came back from the battlefield , we took our hats off to them .
translation.zh: 每次英雄们从战场回来，我们都向他们脱帽致敬。

translation.en: You were showing respect and admiration for them .
translation.zh: 你对他们表示尊敬和钦佩。

translation.en: I wish I were a hero .
translation.zh: 我希望我也是个英雄。

translation.en: Cindy , how come nearly all the prime-time TV shows are comedies ?
translation.zh: 辛迪，为什么几乎所有黄金时段的电视节目都是喜剧？

translation.en: That's because Americans love sitcoms .
translation.zh: 那是因为美国人喜欢情景喜剧。

translation.en: Sitcoms ?
translation.zh: 情景喜剧？

translation.en: Situation comedies . A sitcom is half an hour long and it airs weekly . Sitcom shows tend to be about ordinary people . If there is one thing that all the shows have in common , it is teaching wholesome values .
translation.zh: 是的。情景喜剧有半小时长，每周播出一次。它往往关于普通人。如果所有节目都有一个共同点，那就是传递健康的价值观。

translation.en: In Taiwan , prime-time shows are an hour long and most of them aren't comedies .
translation.zh: 在台湾，黄金时段的节目长达一个小时，大多数都不是喜剧。

translation.en: I think Americans would rather laugh than cry or be scared in their free time .
translation.zh: 我认为美国人在空闲时间，更愿意笑，而不是哭或者害怕。

translation.en: I ’ m pretty sure that Jim will turn out to be a good lawyer .
translation.zh: 我肯定吉姆会成为一名好律师。

translation.en: He knows a lot about law and he ’ s eloquent , too .
translation.zh: 他很懂法律，而且口才也很好。

translation.en: How long have you been in England ?
translation.zh: 你在英国多久了？

translation.en: For almost two years .
translation.zh: 差不多两年了。

translation.en: Almost two years ? Your English is very good .
translation.zh: 快两年了？你的英语很好。

translation.en: Thank you . But there's still a lot for me to learn .
translation.zh: 非常感谢。但我还有很多东西要学。

translation.en: Sure , but let's get a pitcher this time We should be able to down it before they close .
translation.zh: 当然可以，不过这次我们一定要喝大壶的，我们应该能在他们打烊前喝完。

translation.en: Well , the bartender wouldn't give me the pitcher of beer . Anyway . He said it was too close to closing time .
translation.zh: 对了，酒保不肯卖给我们大壶啤酒。因为打烊时间就要到了。

translation.en: Yes , it is . We've been dating for over 7 years . We have decided to get married on a special day and we think August 8th , 2008 is a red-letter day .
translation.zh: 是的。我们已经交往7年多了。我们决定在一个特别的日子结婚，2008年8月8日在我们看来是个值得纪念的日子。

translation.en: Good for you ! It sounds like you've done a lot of planning in a very short time .
translation.zh: 真为你感到高兴！听起来你在很短的时间内已经做了很多计划。

translation.en: Yes , there is a lot of to be taken care of---wedding photos , wedding dress , catering , transport , hotel , etc ...
translation.zh: 是的，有很多事情要操心——婚纱照、婚纱、餐饮、交通、酒店等等...

translation.en: Is everything ready now ?
translation.zh: 一切都准备好了吗？

translation.en: Almost . The only thing that isn't ready is the hotel . As a lot of people have chosen that day to get married , it is hard to find a hotel that isn't too expensive .
translation.zh: 几乎都准备好了。唯一没准备好的就是酒店。很多人都选择了这一天结婚，所以很难找到一家不太贵的酒店。

translation.en: Have you tried The Peninsula Palace Beijing ? My wedding reception was held there and they did an excellent job .
translation.zh: 你试过预约北京半岛皇宫酒店吗？我的婚宴就是在那里举行的，他们做得很好。

translation.en: Yes , we called , but it is booked up . The only choice is the Regent Beijing but we haven't made up our minds yet .
translation.zh: 是的，我们打过电话，但已经订满了。唯一的选择是北京丽晶酒店，但我们还没有决定好。

translation.en: It's an excellent hotel . A friend of mine had her wedding reception there and said it was perfect , though very expensive .
translation.zh: 这是一家很好的酒店。我的一个朋友在那里办了婚宴，她说很完美，就是很贵。

translation.en: That's why we want to have a look at other hotels . We don ’ t want to spend too much on an extravagant wedding reception .
translation.zh: 这也是为什么我们想看看其他酒店。我们不想花太多钱来准备奢侈的婚宴。

translation.en: What happened , John ?
translation.zh: 怎么了，约翰？

translation.en: I wonder what he looks like . Oh , I can't wait to see him ! His email said he'd be wearing a white hat . ( looking around for him ) oh , there is .
translation.zh: 我想知道他长什么样。哦，我等不及要见他了！他的邮件说他将戴一顶白帽子（到处找他）哦，他在那里。
