translation.zh: 低层员工不必参加。这次休假的目的是培训，特别针对的是我们的管理人员。我们要把行政管理变成一个运转良好的机构。为了大家凝聚在一起,我们还要安排一些娱乐活动。这就是培训的目的。

translation.en: So tell me , what's the difference between the Board of Directors , the CEO , and the stockholders ? They all seems ot be the same group of people to me ...
translation.zh: 请问董事会,执行总裁和股东有什么区别?对我来说,他们好像就是一类人…

translation.en: No , there's a definite difference . You know , the stockholders are the people who own the company ... they're the financial control system . Then there's the CEO — the chief executive officer . He's the hot shot , the main guy who is the boss . If there is only one person with absolute power in the organization , everyone knows that the power will go to their head . It's too dangerous . That's the reason for a Board of Directors . The board is made up of people who are experts in the industry . They could be related to the organization , but more commonly , they are independent and non-biased .
translation.zh: 不是一类，区别大着呢。你知道,股东是公司的持有人……他们是财政控制系统.接下来是执行总裁，那大家都知道权利会冲昏他的头脑。这样做太危险。这就是为什么要设立董事会的原因。董事会由该企业的专家组成，他们参与组织管理，但更多时候他们是独立的，而且是不偏不倚的。

translation.en: How many people are on the board of directors ?
translation.zh: 董事会由多少人组成？

translation.en: Usually not more than 15 , not less than 10 . They meet monthly , quarterly , or biannually to oversee an organization or company . They provide long term planing and vision , and also act as moral watchdogs rto keep the company in line .
translation.zh: 一般不超过15个，不少于10个。他们每个月、每个季度、或每半年开一次会来监督组织机构或公司。他们提出长远的规划和设想，还充当道德的监督者以确保公司走上正轨。

translation.en: Could you do me a favor and proofread my resume before I send it out to the human resources department ?
translation.zh: 在我把简历发给人力资源部之前，你能帮我校对一下吗？

translation.en: Sure , let me take a look ... Personal Information , Education , Experience , Training ... I think you should add another section for language . You speak three languages , so you might as well put that on your resume .
translation.zh: 当然，让我看看……个人信息、教育、经历、培训……我认为你应该为增加一个语言能力部分。你会说三种语言，所以你最好把它写在简历上。

translation.en: But languages don't have anything to do with engineering . Shouldn't everything I put on my resume have something to do with my field ?
translation.zh: 但是语言和工程学没有任何关系。我在简历上写的每件事不都应该和我的专业有关吗？

translation.en: Not necessarily . I think people would be impressed by your language abilities . It says something about your level of intellect and experience . Also , I think human resources directors want to see more of a well-rounded person in a resume .
translation.zh: 不一定。我想人们会对你的语言能力印象深刻。它反映了你的智力和经验水平。此外，我认为人力资源总监更希望在简历中看到一个全面发展的人。

translation.en: It's just a piece of paper , you think that they can tell if I am a well-rounded person by looking at it ?
translation.zh: 只是一张纸，你觉得他们看了就能知道我是不是一个全面的人吗？

translation.en: Well , you're right , the resume is limited in how much it can tell someone about a person . That's why job interviews are important to let people know the real you that they can't see from a piece of paper . But resumes can be helpful in explaining things and giving a good impression to a potential employer .
translation.zh: 好了，你说的对，简历在说明一个人有多大能力方面确实是有限的。这也是为什么求职面试那么重要，它能让人们了解真实的你，这是他们从纸上无法看出来的。可是简历说明一些情况方面还是有帮助的，而且能给你未来的老板留下良好印象。

translation.en: It is 15 minutes ’ drive .
translation.zh: 开车15分钟。

translation.en: Yes , I am James Mason from Anderson and Associates . I would like to see Mr . Smith .
translation.zh: 我是安德森咨询公司的詹姆斯·梅森。我想见史密斯先生。

translation.en: I wonder if Mr . Smith forgot your meeting . I am afraid he left this office this morning and is not expected back until after 4 pm . Let me find out if he made arrangements for someone else to meet with you in his place . Will you please have a seat ?
translation.zh: 我想史密斯先生可能忘记了这场会议。他今天早上离开了办公室，恐怕下午4点之后才能回来。让我看看他有没有安排其他人代他见你。请坐好吗？

translation.en: Yes , Mr . Mason , I just checked with our office manager , Ms . Terry , she said Mr . Smith briefed her on your project . She is just finishing up a meeting now . She could be with your shortly . Would you like me to show you around while you are waiting ?
translation.zh: 好的，梅森先生，我刚和我们的办公室经理泰瑞女士谈过。她说，史密斯向她简要介绍了你的项目。她刚刚结束一个会议，很快就会过来见你。请稍等一下，要不要我带你四处看看？

translation.en: Right this way , Mr . Mason . We can start with our front office . When Ms . Terry is ready , you may take the elevator at the front to the 6th floor . There is a conference room already prepared
translation.zh: 这边请，梅森先生。我们可以从前厅开始看。泰瑞女士准备好了的时候，你就可以坐前面的电梯到6楼。会议室已经准备好了。

translation.en: Our toner cartridges are already out of ink ... Could you make an order for a new set ?
translation.zh: 我们的碳粉盒已经没有墨粉了...你能订一套新的吗？

translation.en: We will need new cartridges for all of the office printers ? That will be a large order , probably about two or three cases . The office supply store we usually go through might not have that many in stock .
translation.zh: 我们办公室所有打印机都需要新墨盒吗？那这会是一笔大订单，大概有两三箱。我们经常去的办公用品商店可能没有那么多存货。

translation.en: You can double check with the housekeeping department , but I am pretty sure all of the machines will need new cartridges . Last time when we made our order to the supplier , the quantity was also especially high . They are used to receiving such bulk orders from us . As long as we give them a heads up a couple days in advance , they can usually fill the order .
translation.zh: 你可以和客房部再核对一下，但我很肯定所有的机器都需要新的墨盒。上次我们向供应商订货时，数量也特别多。他们已经习惯我们的大订单了。只要我们提前几天通知他们，他们一般都能供应。

translation.en: OK , I will make a few calls and run our order by housekeeping first to make sure . Is there anything else we need to order while I am at it ?
translation.zh: 好的，我之后打电话，让客房部检查一下我们的订单。我们还要订什么吗？

translation.en: I think the only thing is toner . Try to see if they can deliver it before the end of business day tomorrow . We should really try to do better about waiting until the last minute to fill orders that are usually made on a monthly basis . Anyhow , see what you can do to expedite the order this time .
translation.zh: 只需要墨粉。看看他们能否在明天结束前交货。我们每个月都要填的订单最好不要等到最后一刻才做。无论如何，你这次一定要尽快处理好这个问题。

translation.en: OK , will do .
translation.zh: 好的，我会的。

translation.en: Hello , thank you for calling Bradford and Sons . This is Tracy speaking , How may I help you ?
translation.zh: 你好，谢谢你打电话给布拉德福德父子公司。我是特蕾西，有什么可以帮你的吗？

translation.en: Hello . I would like to speak to your director of human resources , Ms.Jenkins , Please .
translation.zh: 你好。我想和你们的人力资源总监詹金斯女士讲话。

translation.en: Just a moment . I'll check to see if she is at her desk.May I tell her who is calling ?
translation.zh: 请稍等。我去看看她是否在办公桌旁。我能告诉她是谁打来的吗？

translation.en: This is Bill Burton from Milford Insurance , I'm calling in regards to our meeting next Tuesday .
translation.zh: 我是米尔福德保险公司的比尔·伯顿，我打电话来是为了我们下周二的会议。

translation.en: Thank you , Mr.Burton.Can you please hold for a moment ? I'll check to see if she is available .
translation.zh: 谢谢你，伯顿先生。你能等一会儿吗？我去看看她是否有空。

translation.en: I'm sorry , Ms.Jenkins is away from her desk.She has already left for lunch.Would you like to leave a message for her ?
translation.zh: 对不起，詹金斯女士不在办公桌旁，她已经去吃午饭了，你要给她留个口信吗？

translation.en: They are keep the documents in chronological order , remove all the chips and pins , punch the documents evenly and place them in the folder .
translation.zh: 它们是：按时间先后顺序排好这些文件，去掉所有的碎片和大头针，将文件对齐订好，然后放进文件夹。

translation.en: You should always remember that one customer one file is the rule .
translation.zh: 你必须牢记每个客户都要存档。

translation.en: My name is Dunlin and I live in Beijing . I was born in 1980 . I will graduate from Peking University this July . I have majored in accounting .
translation.zh: 我叫邓林，住在北京。我出生于1980年。今年七月我将从北京大学毕业。我主修会计专业。

translation.en: Would you tell me something about your family ?
translation.zh: 你能告诉我一些你的家庭情况吗？

translation.en: There are three in my family , my parents and myself . My father is a teacher and my mother is a worker .
translation.zh: 我家有三口人，我父母和我。我爸爸是老师，妈妈是工人。

translation.en: I have worked as an executive secretary for 5 years , first for trading companies , and now I am working for a trust company . I interact well with peers , clients , administrators and bosses . I thrive on challenge and work well in high-stress environments .
translation.zh: 我已经做执行秘书五年了。开始是为一家贸易公司工作，现在是在一家信托公司。我和同事、客户、行政人员以及老板相处得非常好，我能应付挑战，而且在高压力环境中也能工作得很出色。。

translation.en: I can type 100 Chinese words a minute and take dictation in English at 150 words a minute .
translation.zh: 我一分钟能打100个中文单词，一分钟能听写150个单词。

translation.en: Can you operate computers skillfully ?
translation.zh: 你能熟练地操作电脑吗？

translation.en: Yes , I can . I have received some special training in computers . Besides I am good at operating common office machines , such as fax machines and duplicating machines .
translation.zh: 是的，我可以。我接受了一些计算机方面的特殊训练。此外，我擅长操作普通的办公设备，如传真机和复印机。

translation.en: Sometimes we are very busy and need to work overtime . How do you feel about that ?
translation.zh: 有时我们很忙，需要加班。你觉得怎么样？

translation.en: That's all right . But could you tell me how often and how many hours I should work overtime ?
translation.zh: 没关系。但是你能告诉我加班的频率和时间吗？

translation.en: It just depends . If we have important visiting delegations , you have to stay with us . It's not unusual .
translation.zh: 这要看情况。如果我们有重要的访问代表团，你必须留下来。这并不罕见。

translation.en: Mr . Smith , I's like to ask you a question .
translation.zh: 史密斯先生，我想问你一个问题。

translation.en: What specific duties would I perform if I am hired ?
translation.zh: 如果我被录用，我的具体工作职责是什么？

translation.en: Nothing different from a secretary's common responsibilities . However , you know , our company is an international trade-oriented company , can you handle English papers and write English correspondence ?
translation.zh: 和普通的秘书没什么区别。但我们公司是做国际贸易的，你能处理>英文文件和写英文信件吗？

translation.en: Yes . I specialized in English secretary studies at college and that's one of the main parts of my present job .
translation.zh: 可以，我大学时专门学过英语文秘的课程，而且这也是我当前工作中的主要内容之一。

translation.en: I really need more information about the job before we start to discuss salary . Maybe you could tell me what is budgeted for the position .
translation.zh: 在讨论薪水前，我需要更多了解这份工作，或者你可以告诉我这个职位的预算报酬是多少。

translation.en: The starting monthly salary would be ¥ 2,000 , with rises after the half year according to your competence .
translation.zh: 起薪为2000英镑一年，半年后会根据你的业绩增加薪水。

translation.en: I think it's acceptable and I really like the job . And when can I know the decision ?
translation.zh: 我觉得可以接受。我真的喜欢这份工作，我什么时候能得知结果呢？

translation.en: We'll inform you of our final decision by early July . Do you have any other questions ?
translation.zh: 我们会在7月初通知你我们的最终决定。你还有别的问题吗？

translation.en: No . Thank you for the time .
translation.zh: 没有了，谢谢你的宝贵时间。

translation.en: Excuse me . I have an appointment with Mr . Li at nine . May I come in ?
translation.zh: 打扰一下，我和李先生九点钟有个约会，我可以进来吗？

translation.en: Yes , come in please . I am Mr . Li . You must be My Liu , right ?
translation.zh: 请进，我就是李先生，你肯定是刘小姐吧？

translation.en: Yes , I am My Liu . Thanks .
translation.zh: 对，谢谢。

translation.en: I'd like to start this interview with some questions . Why do you think you are qualified for this position ?
translation.zh: 我们开始面试吧，首先问你几个问题。你为什么认为你能胜任这份工作？

translation.en: According to your advertisement , you want an experienced software engineer . I think my background meets the requirement of this position .
translation.zh: 从你们的广告上得知，你们需要一位有经验的软件工程师。我想我的背景符合这份工作的要求。

translation.en: Then tell me something about your background .
translation.zh: 那说说你的背景吧。

translation.en: My major was computer science when I was at college , and I am quite familiar with Visual C + + and Java language .
translation.zh: 大学时我的专业是计算机科学，我对Visual C++和Java语言非常熟悉。

translation.en: Well , what do you think about the development in computers ?
translation.zh: 嗯，你认为计算机行业的发展前景怎么样？

translation.en: The developments in software are going ahead very quickly and more and more problems are resolved by software . In some regions , the hardware is completely replaced by software . So I think the software industry has a great future .
translation.zh: 软件将会发展很快，而且越来越多的问题依靠软件解决。在某些领域，硬件会完全被软件所取代，所以我认为软件前景可观。

translation.en: Have you ever designed any programs concerning network ?
translation.zh: 你设计过有关网络方面的程序吗？

translation.en: Yes , I have designed some programs for the network with Visual C + + and I have passed the test for programmers - MUSE .
translation.zh: 是的，我用过VC++设计过一些网络程序，而且我还通过了程序员考试——MUSE

translation.en: Yes , can you tell me what's my responsibility in this position ?
translation.zh: 有，你能告诉我这份工作我的职责是什么吗？

translation.en: Yes , of course . You would be responsible for the development of software products .
translation.zh: 当然可以了，你将负责软件产品的开发。

translation.en: I see . This is my advantage .
translation.zh: 我明白了。这是我的优势。

translation.en: Good . Have you got any other questions ?
translation.zh: 很好。你还有其他问题吗？

translation.en: Ok , I will contact you in a week . See you .
translation.zh: 好的，我一周后联系你。再见。

translation.en: Thank you , bye-bye .
translation.zh: 谢谢，再见。

translation.en: Yes , good morning . This is Mr . Suzuki from Video TV . May I speak to Mr . Johnson ?
translation.zh: 是的，早上好。我是来自视频电视台的铃木先生。请问我可以和约翰逊先生通话吗？

translation.en: I'm sorry , but Mr . Johnson is out at the moment . Can I take a message ?
translation.zh: 对不起，约翰逊先生现在不在。我能替您留个口信吗？

translation.en: Uh , yes , okay . Tell him John Suzuki called . That's S-U-Z-U-K-I .
translation.zh: 呃，好的。请告诉他约翰·铃木打过电话。名字拼写是S-U-Z-U-K-I。

translation.en: From Video TV .
translation.zh: 我来自视频电视台。

translation.en: Yes , Video TV .
translation.zh: 好的，视频电视台。

translation.en: Tell him I telephoned . I'd like to see him about the videotapes . Can he call me this afternoon ?
translation.zh: 请告诉他我打过电话。我想和他谈谈录像带的事。请问他今天下午能给我打电话吗？

translation.en: Yes , Of course . What's your telephone number ?
translation.zh: 当然可以。您的电话号码是多少？

translation.en: It's , area code 413 , 447-9626 .
Oh , I'm sorry , 447-9626 .
Yes , that's right . Extension 162 .
translation.zh: 是的，没错。分机号是162。

translation.en: Extension 162 . Okay , Mr . Suzuki . I'll give him the message .
translation.zh: 分机号162。好的，铃木先生。我会转告他的。

translation.en: I want to find information on the American Civil War .
translation.zh: 我想找到关于美国内战的信息

translation.en: Yes , I want to know about the battle of Gettysburg .
translation.zh: 是的，我想知道葛底斯堡战役。

translation.en: O . K . Well , go to google.com , and type in “ Battle of Gettysburg . ”
translation.zh: 好的，（你可以）登陆google.com，输入“葛底斯堡战役”

translation.en: Oh wow , there are a lot of sites .
translation.zh: 哇，网站太多了。

translation.en: Here , try this one . It ’ s a good site about Gettysburg .
translation.zh: 来，试试这个。这是一个关于葛底斯堡的好网站。

translation.en: Thanks . If I ’ m interested , I ’ ll go to the library .
translation.zh: 谢谢。如果我感兴趣，我就去图书馆。

translation.en: Hi , Mr . Smith . This is Mary . Is Jenny there ?
translation.zh: 嗨，史密斯先生。我是玛丽。珍妮在吗？

translation.en: No , I ’ m afraid not , Mary . May I take a message for her ?
translation.zh: 恐怕不在，玛丽。我可以帮你给她捎个口信吗？

translation.en: Yes , please tell her that band practice has been moved to Tuesday night at eight thirty .
translation.zh: 好的，请告诉她乐队的练习时间已经改到周二晚上八点半。

translation.en: O . K . No problem . Anything else ?
translation.zh: 好的，没问题。别的还有吗？

translation.en: No , but if she has any questions , she can call me at 555-2345 .
translation.zh: 没了，但如果她有任何问题，可以打555-2345给我。

translation.en: All right , I ’ ll leave her the message , Mary . Thanks for calling .
translation.zh: 好吧，我会给她留言的，玛丽。谢谢你打电话来。

translation.en: Tell me about yourself .
translation.zh: 跟我说说你自己吧。

translation.en: I was born and raised in Beijing . I attended Peking University and received my bachelor's degree in Economics . I have worked for 2 years as a financial consultant in Beijing for China Pacific Insurance Co . Ltd .
translation.zh: 我在北京出生和长大。我就读于北京大学，已经获得了经济学学士学位。我在北京为中国太平洋保险有限公司做了两年的财务顾问。

translation.en: What type of position are you looking for ?
translation.zh: 你想要什么样的职位？

translation.en: I'm looking for a position in which I can utilize my experience .
translation.zh: 我正在寻找一份能充分利用我经验的工作。

translation.en: Are you interested in a full-time or part-time position ?
translation.zh: 你想做全职还是兼职？

translation.en: I am more interested in a full-time position . However , I would also consider a part-time position .
translation.zh: 我更想做全职工作。不过，我也会考虑兼职。

translation.en: Can you tell me about your responsibilities at your last job ?
translation.zh: 你能告诉我你上一份工作的职责吗？

translation.en: I advised customers on financial matters . After I consulted the customer , I completed a customer inquiry form and catalogued the information in our database . I then collaborated with colleagues to prepare the best possible package for the client . The clients were then presented with a summarized report on their financial activities that I formulated on a quarterly basis .
translation.zh: 我为客户提供财务方面的建议。在咨询客户后，我会填写一份客户咨询表，并将信息录入数据库。然后和我的同事们一起为客户准备最好的财务方案。之后我会按季度向客户提交一份关于其财务活动的总结报告。

translation.en: I am an excellent communicator . People trust me and come to me for advice . One afternoon , my colleague was involved with a troublesome customer who felt he was not being served well . I made the customer a cup of coffee and invited both my colleague and the client to my desk where we solved the problem together .
translation.zh: 我是一个擅长沟通的人。人们都很信任我，愿意向我寻求建议。一天下午，我的同事遇到了一位麻烦的顾客，他觉得自己没有得到很好的服务。我给客户冲了一杯咖啡，邀请我的同事和客户到我的办公桌前，我们一起解决了问题。

translation.en: I tend to spend too much time making sure the customer is satisfied . However , I began setting time-limits for myself .
translation.zh: 我倾向于花太多时间来确保客户满意。但是，现在我已经开始为自己设定时间限制了。

translation.en: Why do you want to work for our company ?
translation.zh: 你为什么想来我们公司工作？

translation.en: After following your firm's progress for the last 3 years , I am convinced that your company is becoming one of the market leaders and I would like to be a part of that team .
translation.zh: 在研究贵公司过去三年的发展之后，我确信贵公司正在成为市场领导者之一，我也愿意成为这个团队的一员。

translation.en: When can you begin ?
translation.zh: 你什么时候可以开始工作？

translation.en: Immediately .
translation.zh: 马上。

translation.en: Please tell me something about your insurance background .
translation.zh: 请告诉我你的保险专业背景。

translation.en: I majored in international banking at college so I took many insurance courses . And I worked at an insurance company for my graduation field work .
translation.zh: 我在大学主修国际银行专业，所以我学习了很多保险课程。毕业实习也是在一家保险公司。

translation.en: Why do you want to be an insurance agent ?
translation.zh: 你为什么想当保险代理人？

translation.en: I care about people and I know the importance of insurance .
translation.zh: 我关心他人，也知道保险的重要性。

translation.en: Do you have any work experience in promotion ?
translation.zh: 你有其他方面的工作经验吗？

translation.en: Yes , I do . I have worked as a salesman for P & G Company Ltd .
translation.zh: 是的，有。我曾在宝洁公司做过推销员。

translation.en: Do people respond well to you ?
translation.zh: 人们对你的评价好吗？

translation.en: Yes , I'm good with people .
translation.zh: 好，我对人很好。

translation.en: Good morning . My name is Mr . Brown . I ’ m from Australia . Here is my card .
translation.zh: 早上好。我是布朗先生。我来自澳大利亚。这是我的名片。

translation.en: Thank you . I ’ m pleased to meet you , Mr . Brown . My name is Kathy Pewless , the representative of Green Textile Import and Export Corporation .
translation.zh: 非常感谢。很高兴见到你，布朗先生。我叫凯西·皮尔斯，是格林纺织品进出口公司的代表。

translation.en: Pleased to meet you too , Ms . Pewless . I travel a lot every year on business , but this is my first visit to your country . I must say I have been much impressed by your friendly people .
translation.zh: 我也很高兴见到你，皮尔斯女士。我每年都出差，但这是我第一次来贵国。我必须说你们友好的人民给我留下了深刻的印象。

translation.en: Thank you for saying so . Have you seen the exhibition halls ? On display are most of our products , such as silk , woolen knitwear , cotton piece goods , and garments .
translation.zh: 谢谢你这么说。你看过展览馆吗？展出的是我们的大部分产品，如丝绸、毛织品、棉布和服装。

translation.en: Oh , yes . I had a look yesterday . I found some of the exhibits to be fine in quality and beautiful in design . The exhibition has successfully displayed to me what your corporation handles . I ’ Ve gone over the catalogue and the pamphlets enclosed in your last letter . I ’ Ve got some idea of your exports . I ’ m interested in your silk blouses .
translation.zh: 哦，是的。我昨天看了一眼。我发现有些展品质量很好，设计也很漂亮。展览会成功地向我展示了贵公司的业务。我已经看了你上封信所附的目录和小册子。我对你们的出口产品有了些了解。我对你们的丝绸衬衫也很感兴趣。

translation.en: Our silk is known for its good quality . It is one of our trade - trional exports . Silk blouses are brightly colored and beau - fully designed . They ’ Ve met with great favor overseas and are always in great demand .
translation.zh: 我们的丝绸以质量好而闻名。这是我们贸易出口的产品之一。丝绸衬衫色彩鲜艳，设计精美。他们在海外受到了很大的青睐，需求量一直很大。

translation.en: Hello , Mr . Black , how are you ?
translation.zh: 嗨，布莱克先生，你好吗？

translation.en: Fine , thank you , and how are you ?
translation.zh: 很好，谢谢，你好吗？

translation.en: Very well , thank you . It's nice to meet you again . I am awfully sorry for not being able to meet you at the airport , as I was busy yesterday . I do hope you had a very enjoyable trip from New York .
translation.zh: 很好，谢谢。很高兴再次见到你。昨天我很忙，很抱歉没能到机场接你。我真希望你从纽约来的旅途是愉快的。

translation.en: Yes , a very pleasant journey indeed . Thank you .
translation.zh: 是的，旅途真的很愉快。非常感谢。

translation.en: How are you getting along with your business ?
translation.zh: 你的生意怎么样？

translation.en: Not bad . The fur market is not very brisk lately , but the selling season is advancing near . I hope there will be more buyers in the market this year .
translation.zh: 不错。最近皮草市场不太火爆，但销售季节临近了。我希望今年市场上会有更多的买家。

translation.en: I hope we can do more business together . Though we are satisfied with our past trade record , there are still possibilities for more business . In the meantime , let's discuss other spheres of cooperation , such as investment , technology transfer and technical assistance .
translation.zh: 我希望我们能一起做更多的生意。虽然我们对过去的贸易记录感到满意，但仍有可能进行更多的交易。同时，我们可以讨论一下其他合作领域，比如投资、技术转让和技术援助。

translation.en: Hi , Dan . What's new ?
translation.zh: 嗨，丹。有什么新鲜事吗？

translation.en: Where have you been ? I've been trying to get in touch with you for two days .
translation.zh: 你去哪里了？我两天来一直想和你联系。

translation.en: I went to Salt Lake City on business . What's up ?
translation.zh: 我去盐湖城出差了。怎么了？

translation.en: I got fired .
translation.zh: 我被解雇了。

translation.en: How come ? Last time I saw you . You told me it was a good job , and you'd like to take it as a career . That was only one month ago . Why this sudden change ?
translation.zh: 怎么会？上次我见到你。你告诉我这是一份好工作，你想把它当作一份长期职业。这就在一个月前啊。为什么会发生这么突然的转变？

translation.en: It's a long story . In a word , I didn't do a good job of it . I messed up a business deal , a deal that would have made ten million dollars and I messed it up .
translation.zh: 说来话长。总之，我工作没做好。我搞砸了一笔生意，一笔能赚一千万美元的生意被我搞砸了。

translation.en: I am trying to find a job asap . Lily doesn't know yet . I didn't tell her . I spent the past three days at the coffee shop next to your office , and she thought I went to work as usual .
translation.zh: 我正在努力找工作。莉莉还不知道这事。我没有告诉她。过去三天我是在你办公室旁边的咖啡馆里度过的，她以为我像往常一样去上班了。

translation.en: That's not the way to solve the problem . Did you look in the classified advertisements column ?
translation.zh: 那不是解决问题的办法。你看过分类广告栏了吗？

translation.en: Yes , I did . But I wasn't qualified for most of the jobs that I was interested in .
translation.zh: 是的，我看了。但我没法胜任我感兴趣的大部分工作。

translation.en: Listen . I will see what I can do , ok ? You go home and tell Lily about this problem you have now . She is your wife and I am sure she will understand .
translation.zh: 听着。我看看我能做什么，好吗？你回家告诉莉莉你现在的问题。她是你的妻子，我相信她会理解的。

translation.en: I just don't know how to bring it up . Well , all right . She has the right to know anyways .
translation.zh: 我只是不知道怎么提出来。嗯，好吧。她无论如何都有权知道。

translation.en: What type of people do you work with most effectively ?
translation.zh: 你和哪类人合作最有效？

translation.en: I tend to work well with people who are confident and straightforward.It ' s more difficult for me to be around timid people , because I move quickly and I am decisive .
translation.zh: 我倾向于和自信直率的人一起工作，和胆小的人在一起对我来说更难，因为我行动迅速而且果断。

translation.en: What things impress you in your colleagues ?
translation.zh: 同事的哪一方面让你印象深刻？

translation.en: I admire and work best with people who are of good character and integrity . I also think confidence and enthusiasm is positive in any business environment .
translation.zh: 我很敬佩那些性格好、品行端正的人，和他们合作也感觉最好。我也认为自信和热情在任何商业环境中都会起到积极的作用。

translation.en: What are some of the things your supervisor did that you disliked ?
translation.zh: 你的上司做了哪些你不喜欢的事？

translation.en: The only thing I really don't like is to get feedback in front of others . I want to hear good and bad feedback in private , so that I have time to think and react to the issue without other distractions . I believe that's the fair way to improve learning or to change future behavior .
translation.zh: 我唯一不喜欢的就是在别人面前得到反馈。我想私下里听到好的和坏的反馈，这样我就有时间去思考和回应这个问题，而不必受到其他的干扰。我相信这是学习或改善未来行为最好的方法。

translation.en: How do you organize and plan for major projects ?
translation.zh: 你如何组织和规划重大项目？

translation.en: I love to brainstorm a best , worst , and most likely scenario.Then , I set a timetable that's realistic.What I usually find is that some combination of my schedule easily as these things unfold because I've already visualized what could happen and how I'd react .
translation.zh: 我喜欢头脑风暴，想出最好、最坏、最有可能的情况。然后，我会制定了一个切合实际的时间表。我通常会发现，随着这些事情的展开，我的一些计划很容易就串起来了，因为我已经想象到会发生什么，我会如何反应。

translation.en: Describe an experience when you had to work under great pressure .
translation.zh: 描述一下你在巨大压力下工作的经历。

translation.en: I had to complete an end of quarter report once while I was on the road for two consecutive weeks.The amount of telephoning back and forth was incredible , because I could't bring my office files with me.Luckily I had a great secretary and a logical filling system , so we located everything we needed .
translation.zh: 当我连续两周出差时，我不得不完成一次季度末报告。来回打电话的次数令人难以置信，因为我不能随身携带办公室文件。幸运的是，我有一个很棒的秘书和一个合理的填写系统，所以我们找到了所需的一切。

translation.en: How do you manage your time in a typical day ?
translation.zh: 平时你都是如何安排时间的？

translation.en: I've always given priority to work with established clients , because they offer a better risk / return value.The last thing I do is general correspondence , especially internal correspondence , which I take care of at the end of the day or week .
translation.zh: 我着重于和老客户合作，因为他们提供了更好的风险/回报价值。我每天最后处理的是一般通信，特别是内部通信，我在一天或一周结束时处理这些通信。

translation.en: Describe a time when you acted on someone's suggestion .
translation.zh: 请说出一个你听从别人的建议，改变了自己行为的例子。

translation.en: I changed my open office hours because several of my employees found it difficult to visit me except in the early mornings .
translation.zh: 我改了我的办工时间，因为我的几个员工发现除了清晨以外，很难在办公室找到我。

translation.en: Is this supply ?
translation.zh: 这是供货部吗？

translation.en: Yeah . This is supply . What can I do for you ?
translation.zh: 是啊。这是供货部。有什么事吗？

translation.en: This is Rachel in Human Resources . I need two boxes of company letterhead , one box of ball-point pens , and a box of envelopes .
translation.zh: 我是人力资源部的瑞秋。我需要两盒公司信笺，一盒圆珠笔和一盒信封。

translation.en: All right . No problem . What ’ s your extension ?
translation.zh: 好的。没问题。你的分机是多少？

translation.en: You still have not given me those files I ’ Ve asked you for .
translation.zh: 你还没有把我要的那些文件给我。

translation.en: I ’ m sorry , Mr . Myers . I ’ Ve just been so busy today .
translation.zh: 对不起，迈尔斯先生。我今天太忙了。

translation.en: I really don ’ t want to hear your excuses , Janet . We ’ re running a busy office here . You ’ re going to have to keep up .
translation.zh: 我真的不想听你的借口，珍妮特。办公室的人都很忙。你得跟上。

translation.en: You ’ re right , sir . I apologize . I ’ ll get those files for you now .
translation.zh: 你说得对，先生。对不起。我现在就给你拿那些文件。

translation.en: Mr . Crandall , I ’ m sorry , but I really don ’ t see the value in doing this entire project over from scratch . It would take a lot of work .
translation.zh: 科兰德尔先生，请原谅。可我的确看不出有什么必要把整个方案完全推倒重做。这太费事了。

translation.en: That ’ s certainly true . But , that ’ s what this job is all about , Maria . There's no doubt that this project is unacceptable .
translation.zh: 你说的没错，但是，这正是这个工作的重点所在，玛丽亚。毫无疑问地，这个方案是不可接受的。

translation.en: I agree . But I think that we can handle the problem by making a few major changes . I ’ d appreciate it if you would give me a chance .
translation.zh: 我承认。但是我想我们可以做几处大的改动来解决这个问题。若您给我个机会就太好了。

translation.en: All right , Maria . I ’ ll give you until tomorrow at 4:00 to produce a satisfactory piece of work , but otherwise , you ’ ll have to re-do it .
translation.zh: 好吧，玛丽亚。我等你到明天4点拿出份令人满意的方案，否则你得重做一遍。

translation.en: Ms . Montgomery ? This is Richard Thomas . I ’ m sorry to bother you at home , but I ’ Ve got a bit of a problem .
translation.zh: 蒙哥马利女士吗？我是理查德·托马斯。很抱歉打扰你，但我有点问题。

translation.en: Oh ? What ’ s wrong ?
translation.zh: 哦？怎么了？

translation.en: My daughter ’ s just banged up her knee pretty badly and I ’ m going to have to take her to the hospital . I ’ ll be about two hours late .
translation.zh: 我女儿的膝盖伤得很厉害，我得送她去医院。我要晚两个小时左右才能到。

translation.en: Office Supplies , Inc . Robert speaking , may I help you ?
translation.zh: 办公用品公司。我是罗伯特，有什么事吗？

translation.en: Hi , Robert . This is Janet Reese calling from American Advertising . We placed an order with you about a week ago .
translation.zh: 嗨，罗伯特。我是美国广告公司的珍妮特·里斯。大约一周前我们向你公司下了订单。

translation.en: Yes , Ms . Reese . I remember , you spoke with me . Is there a problem ?
translation.zh: 是的，里斯女士。我记得，你和我说过。有什么问题吗？

translation.en: Well , it still hasn ’ t gotten here , and my boss is pretty angry about it .
translation.zh: 货物还没到这儿，我老板很生气。

translation.en: the James ’ s file , Christine ?
translation.zh: 詹姆斯的档案，克莉丝汀？

translation.en: I had it right here a minute ago , Mr . Emory . Umm . Just a minute ...
translation.zh: 我一分钟前还放在这里，埃默里显示。嗯。等一下……

translation.en: Christine , I know you ’ re new here and there ’ s a lot to learn , but you are going to have to learn to keep your work in better order . We can ’ t afford to lose an important document .
translation.zh: 克莉丝汀，我知道你是新来的，有很多东西要学，但你得学会把工作安排得井井有条。我们不能失去一份重要的文件。

translation.en: Yes , sir . I apologize for that . Here ’ s the file you were looking for , Mr . Emory .
translation.zh: 是的，先生。我为此道歉。埃默里先生，这是你要找的档案。

translation.en: John ? It ’ s Susan Miller .
translation.zh: 约翰？我是苏珊·米勒。

translation.en: Hi , Susan . What ’ s up ?
translation.zh: 嗨，苏珊。怎么了？

translation.en: Do you know where that memo about office procedures is ? I want to give my secretary a copy .
translation.zh: 你知道关于办公程序的备忘录在哪里吗？我想给我的秘书一份复印件。

translation.en: I ’ m sorry . I have no idea . I haven ’ t seen that for ages .
translation.zh: 对不起。我不知道。我好久没看到那个了。

translation.en: Did you pack this bag yourself ? Has it been out of your possession at any time before checking-in ?
translation.zh: 这个包是你自己打包的吗？在办理入住手续之前，有没有人把它拿走过？

translation.en: Yes , I packed it myself , and it hasn ’ t been out of my possession .
translation.zh: 对，我自己打包的，还没拿出来过。

translation.en: Are you bringing in any plants or animal products ?
translation.zh: 你带了植物或动物产品吗？

translation.en: Our sniffer dog seems to disagree . Do you mind if we look in your suitcase ?
translation.zh: 我们的嗅探犬似乎不同意。我们可以看看你的手提箱吗？

translation.en: Not at all . Go right ahead .
translation.zh: 当然。请吧。

translation.en: What ’ s this sir ?
translation.zh: 先生，这是什么？

translation.en: It ’ s traditional Chinese Medicine . I mix it with hot water like tea . Sorry . I forgot about it .
translation.zh: 这是中药，要用热水泡，就像泡茶一样。很抱歉我忘了。

translation.en: What are these red things sir ?
translation.zh: 先生，这些红色的东西是什么？

translation.en: Oh no ! I forgot about those too ! Those are Chinese sausages for my Aunt Lily .
translation.zh: 哦，不！我也忘了！那些是给莉莉阿姨带的中国香肠。

translation.en: I ’ m sorry sir , but you can ’ t take any of this into the country . We will also have to check your carry-on . Please step this way . Don ’ t ’ be nervous ; we ’ ll just look through it briefly and then
translation.zh: 对不起，先生，你不能把这些带入境。我们还要检查你的随身行李。请这边走。不要紧张；我们先看一下。

translation.en: Hi . I ’ m here to catch flight 513 to New York .
translation.zh: 你好我是来赶去纽约的513航班

translation.en: May I see your ticket please ?
translation.zh: 我能看看你的票吗

translation.en: Here you are . Do you need to see my passport ?
translation.zh: 给你。你需要看我的护照吗？

translation.en: Any form of picture I . D . will do .
translation.zh: 任何形式的图片。证件照也行。

translation.en: Mmmm ... a photo I . D . I have my New Jersey driver ’ s license . Is that ok ?
translation.zh: 嗯。。。我有一张证件照。是新泽西州驾照上的照片。可以吗？

translation.en: That will do . What an interesting picture ! How old is it ?
translation.zh: 可以。真有趣！你照这张照片的时候多大了？

translation.en: Actually it wad taken just last year , but I had a shaved head and a beard . Can you still recognize me ?
translation.zh: 事实上，我是去年拍的，当时我剃了头，留着胡子。你能认出我吗？

translation.en: Barely . Will you be checking any luggage today ?
translation.zh: 几乎不能。你有要托运的行李吗？

translation.en: Yes , One suitcase . I also have a carry-on bag .
translation.zh: 有，一个行李箱。我还有一个手提包。

translation.en: Ok . Mr . Lee , you ’ re all set . Your flight leaves from gate 10 . Boarding begins at 10:30
translation.zh: 好的先生。李，一切准备就绪。您的航班从10号登机口起飞。10:30开始登机

translation.en: Hello , Parker . How ’ s everything ?
translation.zh: 你好，帕克。一切都好吗？

translation.en: Can ’ t complain . And you ?
translation.zh: 不算差。你呢？

translation.en: Business is booming . I understand you want to meet up with me next week . How ’ s your schedule looking ?
translation.zh: 生意兴隆。我知道你下周想见我。你的日程安排怎么样？

translation.en: Amelia , could you spare a few minutes ?
translation.zh: 阿米莉亚，你能抽出几分钟吗

translation.en: sure . What do you need ?
translation.zh: 当然可以。你需要什么？

translation.en: well , I wanted to let you know that I've put in my notice .
translation.zh: 嗯,我想告诉你我辞职了，

translation.en: it's complicated . But basically it boils down to one thing . This company is downsizing and I can't continue working for a company that may let me go .
translation.zh: 原因很复杂。不过简单来说这是迟早的事情。这家公司在缩减开支，我不能待在这里等到公司解雇我才走。

translation.en: but surely they won't fire you ! You're one of the most experienced managers here !
translation.zh: 可是，他们不可能解雇你的！你是这里最资深的经理之一啊！

translation.en: well , to be honest , there's another reason . I've got a better offer .
translation.zh: 嗯，坦白说，还有个原因。我有更好的选择了。

translation.en: well that's great news ! Congratulations ! Where will you be located ?
translation.zh: 这是个好消息！祝贺你，你要去哪儿？

translation.en: the head office is in New York , but I'll be dealing with overseas companies and flying to this side of the world from time to time .
translation.zh: 那家公司的总部设在纽约，不过我要打理和海外公司的买卖，会经常飞来飞去。

translation.en: it'll be sad to see you go , but it sounds like you're found yourself a great opportunity .
translation.zh: 你要走的话我会很难过，不过看来你找到了更好的机会。

translation.en: I have . I feel lucky . I look forward to dealing with overseas companies and at the same time having a chance to use English more .
translation.zh: 是的，我觉得很幸运。我一直希望能同海外公司做生意，并借机会多多锻炼英文。

translation.en: I'm sorry to bring this up , but would it be possible for you to write me a letter of recommendation before you go ?
translation.zh: 我很抱歉提起这件事，但你能在走之前给我写封推荐信吗？

translation.en: of course I can . In fact , if there are other job opportunities at this new company , I'll recommend you personally .
translation.zh: 我当然可以。事实上，如果这家新公司还有其他工作机会，我会亲自推荐你。

translation.en: thanks . I appreciate that .
translation.zh: 谢谢。我很感激。

translation.en: Yes that ’ s right . I ’ Ve always enjoyed studying . My friends say I ’ m a bit of a bookworm , but my father always pushed us to succeed academically .
translation.zh: 是的，没错。我一直很喜欢学习。我的朋友说我有点书呆子，但我父亲总是督促我们在学业上取得成功。

translation.en: Well I ’ Ve always been keen on writing , so I became the editor for the University student magazine , which I really loved . Also I volunteered for a group called Shelter , to help the homeless in York .
translation.zh: 我一直热衷于写作，所以我成为了大学生杂志的编辑，我很喜欢这份工作。我还志愿加入了一个叫做庇护所的组织，帮助纽约的流浪汉。

translation.en: I think that we should send one of our HR people to do that . I don ’ t think we should use an agency , because they won ’ t be familiar with the type of people we employ . Have we decide on the location of
translation.zh: 我们可以派人力资源部的人去做。我觉得不要使用代理，因为他们不清楚我们要雇用的员工类型。分公司的地点已经决定好了吗？

translation.en: Yes , it has . We ’ re going to target the business community through business magazines .
translation.zh: 准备好了。我们将通过商业杂志瞄准商界。

translation.en: Excuse me , Mr . Emory ? Mr . Macmillan , would like to know if you have the completed schedule for next week ?
translation.zh: 打扰一下，埃默里先生？麦克米伦先生想知道你是否有下周的日程安排？

translation.en: Yes , I do , Susan . Just a moment . Here it is .
translation.zh: 我有，苏珊。请稍等。给你。

translation.en: Thank you , sir . Sorry to trouble you .
translation.zh: 谢谢，先生。很抱歉打扰你。

translation.en: Not at all , Susan . Just tell him to leave it with my secretary when he ’ s finished with it
translation.zh: 没事，苏珊。告诉他做完后把它交给我的秘书就行了。

translation.en: Hey , could you help me try and figure out how to get ready for my job interview ?
translation.zh: 嘿，你能帮我想想我要如何为我的工作面试做准备吗？

translation.en: The most important thing to do is to make sure you know the company and what services or products it provides . Do you know all about them ?
translation.zh: 最重要的是确保你了解这所公司，以及它提供的服务或产品。你知道这家公司的一切吗？

translation.en: Yes , I pretty much understand the company .
translation.zh: 是的，我非常了解这家公司。

translation.en: Well , after you've done your research , you have to decide whether the company is casual or formal . Have you decided what they are yet ?
translation.zh: 嗯，在你完成调查之后，你必须知道公司的风格是非正式的还是正式的。你知道他们是什么风格了吗？

translation.en: Yes , I've been observing them .
translation.zh: 是的，我一直在观察他们。

translation.en: When you are choosing what to wear , keep all of that in mind . Have you chosen what to wear ?
translation.zh: 当你选择面试的穿着的时候，记住所有这些。你选好穿什么了吗？

translation.en: I already have something to wear .
translation.zh: 我已经决定好穿什么衣服了。

translation.en: I would always be ready to go shopping with you ! Should we talk about other basics ?
translation.zh: 我随时准备和你一起去购物！我们再谈谈其他基本问题吧？

translation.en: OK , I am ready to think of other things .
translation.zh: 好的，我准备好考虑其他事情了。

translation.en: You need to make sure you arrive on time , smile , be pleasant and friendly , look the person in the eye and answer all questions to the best of your ability . You'll do great !
translation.zh: 你需要确保你准时到达，面带微笑，和蔼可亲，直视对方的眼睛，尽你所能回答所有问题。你会做得很好的！

translation.en: Can you help me plan the office party ?
translation.zh: 你能帮我想想怎么办办公室聚会吗？

translation.en: Sure . What do you need the most help with , the food or entertainment ?
translation.zh: 我很乐意帮忙。你要我帮你哪方面，食物还是娱乐？

translation.en: I need help with food .
translation.zh: 我需要食物方面的帮助。

translation.en: OK , well , let's coordinate our efforts . Should this party be formal or casual ?
translation.zh: 好吧，让我们协调一下。这个聚会是正式的还是非正式的？

translation.en: I think it should be casual .
translation.zh: 我觉得应该是随便的。

translation.en: I agree . Next , we have to decide on food . We have a choice of Chinese or Continental Cuisine . Which one should we have ?
translation.zh: 我同意。接下来，我们得决定吃什么。我们有中国菜或大陆菜可供选择。我们应该选哪一个？

translation.en: I would prefer Chinese food for this party .
translation.zh: 这次聚会我更喜欢中国菜。

translation.en: Perfect choice . For music , should we have a live band or a DJ ?
translation.zh: 完美的选择。音乐方面，我们应该有现场乐队还是DJ？

translation.en: I think we should hire a live band .
translation.zh: 我想我们应该雇个现场乐队。

translation.en: OK then . Well , I will work on my part and get back to you with my progress on Friday .
translation.zh: 那好吧。好吧，我会努力的，星期五再给你回复我的进度。

translation.en: Why are you holding me in this jail cell ?
translation.zh: 你为什么把我关在这个牢房里？

translation.en: We'd like to hear your account of the events of last night .
translation.zh: 我们想听听你对昨晚事件的叙述。

translation.en: Hey man , you wanna buy some weed ?
translation.zh: 嘿，伙计，你想买些大麻吗

translation.en: Weed ! You know ? Pot , Ganja , Mary Jane some chronic !
translation.zh: 大麻！你知道吗？大麻, 一些慢性的毒品。

translation.en: Oh , umm , no thanks .
translation.zh: 哦，不，谢谢。

translation.en: I also have blow if you prefer to do a few lines .
translation.zh: 如果你喜欢注射类的毒品，我也有。

translation.en: No , I am ok , really .
translation.zh: 不，我很好，真的。

translation.en: Come on man ! I even got dope and acid ! Try some !
translation.zh: 来试试吧，我甚至有毒品和迷幻药。来点试试。

translation.en: Do you really have all of these drugs ? Where do you get them from ?
translation.zh: 你真的有这些毒品吗？你从哪里弄来的？

translation.en: I got my connections ! Just tell me what you want and I ’ ll even give you one ounce for free .
translation.zh: 我有自己的关系。告诉我你想要什么，我甚至会免费给你一盎司的毒品。

translation.en: Sounds good ! Let ’ s see , I want .
translation.zh: 听起来不错！让我想想，我想要。

translation.en: I want you to put your hands behind your head ! You are under arrest !
translation.zh: 我命令你把手放在脑袋后面，你被捕了。我要你把手放在脑后！你被捕了！

translation.en: I need help with the office party .
translation.zh: 你能帮我想想怎么办办公室聚会吗？

translation.en: Yes , of course . We could split it . What part would you like to do , the food or the entertainment ?
translation.zh: 我很乐意帮忙。你要我帮你哪方面，食物还是娱乐？

translation.en: I have no idea what the entertainment should be .
translation.zh: 我在这两方面都需要你的帮助。

translation.en: Let's make sure we are on the same page . Do we want a formal or informal gathering ?
translation.zh: 会办好的。为了确保一切顺利，你认为这个聚会应该是休闲的还是盛装的？

translation.en: Let's make it a formal affair .
translation.zh: 盛装的聚会一定很有趣！

translation.en: Yes , that would be best . Now , for food should we have Chinese or American food ?
translation.zh: 会的。你觉得中国菜好还是大陆菜好？

translation.en: American food would be the best choice .
translation.zh: 我们或许可以两者兼得。

translation.en: That would be great . What kind of music would you like , a band or recorded music ?
translation.zh: 是的，那很好。我们是雇个乐队还是请个DJ？

translation.en: We should bring in a really good DJ .
translation.zh: 也许两个都可以！

translation.en: That works for me . Let's see what we can each do about planning our part and meet again on Friday .
translation.zh: 一切听起来都很棒！星期五我们在这里碰头，讨论细节。

translation.en: I don't think that there is any easy way . The United Nations could send peacekeepers into the country . At least then the warring parties could be forced to negotiate .
translation.zh: 我认为没有什么简单的办法。联合国可以派遣维和人员进入该国。至少在那时，交战双方迫于压力会进行谈判。

translation.en: So , if the cause is poverty , there should be a program to make the country richer.If the problem is resources , share them .
translation.zh: 所以，如果战争的原因是贫困，就应该有一个计划，让国家变得更富裕，如果是资源，就分享资源。

translation.en: It sounds easy when you say it like that . In reality , it's harder to make peace between countries .
translation.zh: 你这样说听起来很容易。实际上，国家间实现和平更难。

translation.en: Yes , it is.One way to stop countries fighting is to cut off their financial support . Wars are very expensive .
translation.zh: 是的，阻止战争的一个方式就是切断财政支持。战争需要耗费大量金钱。

translation.en: I wish the politicians would quit digging up dirt about each other's past .
translation.zh: 我希望政客们不要再互相挖苦对方的过去了。

translation.en: I know . It really makes a mess of the whole election process .
translation.zh: 我知道。这真的把整个选举过程搞得一团糟。

translation.en: And it takes up all the news .
translation.zh: 而且所有的新闻都在报道。

translation.en: The problem is that there always a large number of people who eat that kind of stuff up .
translation.zh: 问题是，总是有很多人对这种东西津津乐道。

translation.en: It's so small . The fact that there is public interest , doesn't say much for us as the public .
translation.zh: 这其实是很微不足道的事。民众利益这种事情他们却没怎么提到。

translation.en: Have you ever listened to AM radio ? It's quite a different experience than the traditional news stations on TV and FM radio .
translation.zh: 你听过调幅收音机吗？它和传统的电视新闻和调频广播新闻很不同。

translation.en: I don't remember the last time I listened to AM radio .
translation.zh: 我不记得上次听调幅收音机是什么时候了。

translation.en: Another place you can get real insight is European papers . You can get them on-line .
translation.zh: 或者你能在欧洲报纸上得到深刻见解。在网上可以找到资源。

translation.en: Good morning . Thank you for the interview .
translation.zh: 早上好。谢谢你给我机会面试。

translation.en: No problem . Now , do you prefer working with others or flying solo ?
translation.zh: 不客气。请问你喜欢和别人一起工作还是自己单干呢？

translation.en: Actually , I enjoy both .
translation.zh: 实际上，我两者都喜欢。

translation.en: So , what is most important to you in a job ? Do you need job security or professional growth and a chance to advance ?
translation.zh: 那么，在工作中哪个方面对你来说是最重要的？你需要工作保障、职业成长和晋升机会吗？

translation.en: I need job security .
translation.zh: 我需要工作保障。

translation.en: Would you be able to relocate ?
translation.zh: 你能重新安置吗？

translation.en: I am open to relocating .
translation.zh: 我愿意搬迁。

translation.en: What are your annual salary requirements ?
translation.zh: 你的年薪要求是什么？

translation.en: I need at least 75,000 per year .
translation.zh: 我每年至少需要75000元的薪水。

translation.en: I ’ ll keep that in mind . Thank you for coming in today . We ’ ll be in touch .
translation.zh: 我会记住的。谢谢你今天来。我们会再联系你的。

translation.en: Great ! That ’ ll be ahead of schedule ! Good work .
translation.zh: 太棒了！比计划提前了！干得漂亮。

translation.en: I am calling to find out why I didn ’ t receive an unemployment check this week .
translation.zh: 我打电话是想知道为什么我这周没有收到失业支票。

translation.en: Did you send in your Continued Claim Form for the last period ?
translation.zh: 你寄了上一期的续期索赔单吗？

translation.en: I think I forgot to send it in !
translation.zh: 我忘记寄了！

translation.en: You need to be very careful to send that form in every two weeks if you want to get paid .
translation.zh: 你要想得到钱，必须每两周寄一次那张表格。

translation.en: Can I send it in now ?
translation.zh: 我能现在寄过去吗？

translation.en: You should look at your claim form and see if it has been more than fourteen days since it was due . If it hasn ’ t been , we will still accept it .
translation.zh: 你应该看看你的索赔单，看看它是否已经过期14天。如果还没有，我们会接受你的表单。

translation.en: Can I mail it in early next time so it isn ’ t late ?
translation.zh: 我下次能提前寄吗，这样就不会寄迟了。

translation.en: Actually , you cannot mail it in early , as it needs to reflect all of the information up to the due date .
translation.zh: 不能，因为它需要反映截止日期前的所有信息。

translation.en: Will my paycheck come right away now ?
translation.zh: 我的薪水能马上就到帐吗？

translation.en: Your check will arrive a little late .
translation.zh: 会晚点到。

translation.en: I didn ’ t receive an unemployment check this week and need to know why .
translation.zh: 本周我没有收到失业支票，我需要知道原因。

translation.en: Did you mail us your last Continued Claim Form ?
translation.zh: 您是否已将您最新的续索表格邮寄给我们呢？

translation.en: I am afraid that I forgot to send it in .
translation.zh: 恐怕我忘记寄了。

translation.en: We cannot pay you unless you turn that form in every two weeks .
translation.zh: 我们不能向您付款，除非您每两周交一次表格。

translation.en: Is it too late to mail the Continued Claim Form in now ?
translation.zh: 现在邮寄续索表是不是太迟了？

translation.en: It can ’ t be more than fourteen days late for us to accept it .
translation.zh: 不超过十四天我们都可以接收。

translation.en: I will mail it in a little early next time to avoid this problem .
translation.zh: 为了避免这个问题，我会在下次早些时候寄出去。

translation.en: You can ’ t possibly know in advance how much you will be working . If you mail it in too soon , we will reject it !
translation.zh: 您不可能事先知道您要做多少工作。如果您寄得太早，我们将拒收！

translation.en: Will my paycheck arrive late because I messed up on my form ?
translation.zh: 我的失业金会因为我晚寄表格而迟发吗？

translation.en: Your check will be arriving late , but the next one will come right on time .
translation.zh: 您的支票会迟发，但下一次的会准时发。

translation.en: I do want to meet with you and take a look at your catalogue . We ’ re redecorating and are going to add some things .
translation.zh: 我想见见你，看看产品目录。我们正在重新装修，准备添置一些东西。

translation.en: Well , I ’ ll be glad to help you out . I can come out anytime on Tuesday or Thursday of next week .
translation.zh: 好的，我很乐意帮你。我可以在下周二和周四都有空。

translation.en: Let ’ s put it down for 1:15 on Thursday . We ’ ll definitely need some new filing cabinets and at least one desk unit .
translation.zh: 我们定在周四1:15吧。我们需要一些新的文件柜和至少一个办公桌。

translation.en: Fine . I ’ ll bring both our office furniture and equipment catalogues on Thursday .
translation.zh: 好的。星期四我会带上办公家具和设备目录。

translation.en: Allan , I am really disappointed by your lack of effort on this project .
translation.zh: 艾伦，我真的很失望，你在这个项目上不够努力。

translation.en: Look , Sally . I ’ Ve put just as much work into this as anybody else .
translation.zh: 听着，莎莉。我在这项目上投入了和其他人一样的精力。

translation.en: No , I ’ m sorry . I disagree . I don ’ t think you ’ Ve been working at full speed at all .
translation.zh: 不，对不起。我不同意。我认为你根本没有全速工作。

translation.en: Well . I ’ m sorry you feel that way .
translation.zh: 好。很抱歉你这么想。

translation.en: 911 emergency . What is the problem ?
translation.zh: 911紧急救援。有什么问题吗？

translation.en: I would like to report a break-in .
translation.zh: 我想报告有人擅闯民居。

translation.en: When was this break-in ?
translation.zh: 什么时候？

translation.en: I believe it happened last night .
translation.zh: 我认为是昨晚。

translation.en: Where was the break-in ?
translation.zh: 地点是哪里？

translation.en: Was anything stolen ?
translation.zh: 有什么东西被偷了吗？

translation.en: I haven't checked yet .
translation.zh: 我还没检查过。

translation.en: Why do you think there was a break-in ?
translation.zh: 你为什么觉得有人闯入？

translation.en: My front window was broken .
translation.zh: 我的前窗坏了。

translation.en: We'll send a squad car shortly .
translation.zh: 我们马上派警车去。

translation.en: Welcome . What can I do for you , Madam ?
translation.zh: 欢迎，女士，有什么事吗？

translation.en: I hope you can give me some advice . I'm sick and tired of coming here or to the post office to pay my utility bills . It's such a long way from my home , but I checked and you are my nearest branch . Is there anyway I can do it from home ?
translation.zh: 我希望你能给我一些建议。我不想来这里或者去邮局交水电费，离我家太远了。我查过了，你这儿是离我家最近的分行。我能在家里交费吗？

translation.en: That's terrible . Unfortunately , we don't have that many branches outside the centre of town . What I'd advise you to do is set up a Direct Debit Service .
translation.zh: 真糟糕。但很抱歉，我们在市中心以外没有那么多分支机构。我建议你办理直接借记服务。

translation.en: A Direct Debit Service ? What's that exactly ?
translation.zh: 直接借记服务？那是什么？

translation.en: A Direct Debit means that every month we can arrange for all of your utility bills to come directly out of your account , no fuss , no hassle .
translation.zh: 直接借记就是，我们来安排好，把您的每个月所有的水电费直接从您的账户中扣除，既不忙乱，又不麻烦

translation.en: But how will you know how much I should pay ? I mean , I receive my bills , not you .
translation.zh: 但你怎么知道我该付多少钱？因为是我收到账单，不是你。

translation.en: We set up an agreement with the , say , phone company . They tell us how much to pay them every month and we pay directly from your account . Of course , we are able to do this with all of the utilities companies .
translation.zh: 我们和电话公司订了协议。他们告诉我们每个月要付多少钱，我们直接从你的账户上扣除。当然，我们可以和所有的水电公司都开展合作。

translation.en: I see . So , that would mean that every month it would just come from my account ? That does sound like a good idea , totally trouble free .
translation.zh: 我懂了。那么，每个月都会自动从我的账户上扣钱？听起来很棒，省去了不少麻烦。

translation.en: Can you tell that I ’ m excited ?
translation.zh: 你看得出我很兴奋吗？

translation.en: What are you excited about ?
translation.zh: 你兴奋什么？

translation.en: I voted today .
translation.zh: 我今天投票了。

translation.en: Was this your first time ?
translation.zh: 这是你第一次投票吗？

translation.en: I just turned 18 a month ago .
translation.zh: 我一个月前刚满18岁。

translation.en: You ’ re lucky .
translation.zh: 你真幸运。

translation.en: Because you turned 18 in an election year .
translation.zh: 因为你在选举年刚好就满18岁了。

translation.en: I didn ’ t even think of that .
translation.zh: 我都没想到。

translation.en: You didn ’ t ?
translation.zh: 你没有想到吗？

translation.en: I really didn ’ t , but I ’ m still excited .
translation.zh: 我真的没有，可我还是很兴奋。

translation.en: You should be , because you ’ re a part of history .
translation.zh: 你应该兴奋，因为你是历史的一部分。

translation.en: It ’ s nice meeting you .
translation.zh: 很高兴认识你。

translation.en: It ’ s nice to meet you , too .
translation.zh: 我也很高兴认识你。

translation.en: I am happy to be speaking to a presidential candidate .
translation.zh: 我很高兴能和一位总统候选人讲话。

translation.en: Would you like to ask me anything ?
translation.zh: 你想问我什么吗？

translation.en: What do you feel about gay marriage ?
translation.zh: 你觉得同性婚姻怎么样？

translation.en: I think everyone has the right to love who they want .
translation.zh: 我认为每个人都有权利爱自己想爱的人。

translation.en: Would you legalize gay marriage ?
translation.zh: 你会让同性婚姻合法化吗？

translation.en: Many people won ’ t like that .
translation.zh: 很多人不会喜欢的。

translation.en: I ’ m sure they won ’ t , but that ’ s my view on gay marriage .
translation.zh: 我肯定他们不会喜欢的，但这是我对同性婚姻的看法。

translation.en: I really like you .
translation.zh: 我真的很喜欢你。

translation.en: Who are you voting for ?
translation.zh: 您想投给谁？

translation.en: The person I ’ m voting for is the best .
translation.zh: 最好的那个。

translation.en: What do you like about him ?
translation.zh: 您喜欢他什么？

translation.en: He is very intelligent .
translation.zh: 他很聪明。

translation.en: That ’ s right . Plus , I agree with his policies .
translation.zh: 没错。另外，我很赞同他的政策。

translation.en: I ’ m glad to hear that you are so excited .
translation.zh: 我很高兴看到你这么激动。

translation.en: I ’ m voting for the next President .
translation.zh: 我投的人会是下一任总统。

translation.en: I ’ m sure he will be .
translation.zh: 我肯定他会的。

translation.en: I ’ m going to make sure and vote .
translation.zh: 我一定要去投票。

translation.en: Of course ! Are you ?
translation.zh: 当然！你呢？

translation.en: I plan to , but what day is the election ?
translation.zh: 我也打算去，但是选举是哪一天？

translation.en: You should know that .
translation.zh: 你应该知道的。

translation.en: Can you just tell me ?
translation.zh: 你能告诉我吗？

translation.en: The election is this Tuesday .
translation.zh: 选举在本周二举行。

translation.en: I ’ m not kidding .
translation.zh: 我不是在开玩笑。

translation.en: It ’ s a good thing I asked you .
translation.zh: 幸好我问你了。

translation.en: That should ’ Ve been something you knew already .
translation.zh: 你应该早就知道的。

translation.en: I couldn ’ t remember .
translation.zh: 我不记得了。

translation.en: Whatever . Just make sure you go vote .
translation.zh: 无论怎样。一定要去投票。

translation.en: Did you hear about the robbery ?
translation.zh: 你听说那场抢劫案了吗

translation.en: Did I hear about it ? I saw it happen .
translation.zh: 我听说了吗？我看到了！

translation.en: I was there .
translation.zh: 我当时在场。

translation.en: A man came into the bank with a gun .
translation.zh: 一个男人拿着枪走进银行。

translation.en: That's insane .
translation.zh: 真是疯了。

translation.en: I was so scared when I saw the gun .
translation.zh: 当我看到枪的时候，我非常害怕。

translation.en: Then what happened ?
translation.zh: 接着发生了什么事？

translation.en: He took the money and tried to get away .
translation.zh: 他拿了钱想逃走。

translation.en: Did the cops show up in time ?
translation.zh: 警察及时出现了吗？

translation.en: He didn't even make it out the door .
translation.zh: 他甚至都没来得及走出门。

translation.en: 911 . How may I help you ?
translation.zh: 这里是911，我能为您效劳吗？

translation.en: I need to report a break-in .
translation.zh: 我想报告有人擅闯民居。

translation.en: When did this break-in occur ?
translation.zh: 什么时候？

translation.en: Last night .
translation.zh: 我认为是昨晚。

translation.en: Where did the break-in happen ?
translation.zh: 地点是哪里？

translation.en: Was anything taken ?
translation.zh: 有什么东西被偷了吗？

translation.en: What makes you think there was a break-in ?
translation.zh: 你为什么觉得有人闯入？

translation.en: My front window was busted .
translation.zh: 我的前窗坏了。

translation.en: I'll send a squad car .
translation.zh: 我们马上派警车去。

translation.en: They don't really think you took it , do they ?
translation.zh: 他们不会真的认为是你拿走了吧？

translation.en: I don't know . I just know I've never been asked so many questions in my life .
translation.zh: 我不知道。我只知道我这辈子从没被问过这么多问题。

translation.en: How many of them were there ?
translation.zh: 他们有多少人？

translation.en: Three-but there was one of them who kept asking really stupid questions .
translation.zh: 三个，其中一个老是问一些愚蠢的问题。

translation.en: Oh , he wanted to know what time I got up this morning and if I bad a bath or a shower you know , things like that .
translation.zh: 哦，他想知道我今天早上几点起床，有没有洗澡或淋浴，诸如此类的事情。

translation.en: What on earth has that got to do with some money disappearing ?
translation.zh: 这到底和钱不见了有什么关系？

translation.en: I've no idea . Oh yes , and the most ridiculous thing . He asked me what I had for breakfast this morning .
translation.zh: 我不知道。哦，是的，最可笑的是，他问我今天早餐吃了什么。

translation.en: Oh well , that's it . They obviously think you're a desperate criminal and you have to steal to eat . I should think you'll get thirty years .
translation.zh: 哦，好吧，他们显然认为你是一个绝望的罪犯，你只能偷东西吃。我想你应该不是那种人。

translation.en: Hmm . Thank you very much .
translation.zh: 嗯，谢谢。

translation.en: hello ! What are you reading about in the newspaper ?
translation.zh: 你好，你在读什么报纸？

translation.en: hello ! I was exhausted form studying , so I decided to read the newspaper to relax . Unfortunately , the news is so depressing . There has been another murder in the city center . I ’ m shocked that the pole
translation.zh: 你好！我学习累了，所以我决定读报放松一下。不幸的是，这个消息太令人沮丧了。市中心又发生了一起谋杀案。我很震惊。

translation.en: people are starting to get frightened by it . Everyone will be relieved when they finally catch the murder .
translation.zh: 人们都被吓坏了。只有凶手被抓住了，每个人才会松一口气。

translation.en: you mean if they catch the murderer . I ’ m scared stiff about going into the city center at night .
translation.zh: 你是说如果他们抓住凶手？（意思是现在还没抓住？）那晚上进市中心我会吓得要死。

translation.en: there must have been some good news in the newspaper . I can ’ t believe that none of the news stories make you happy or excited .
translation.zh: 报纸上一定有好消息。我不相信所有的新闻故事都不会让你高兴或兴奋。

translation.en: well , there was one good piece of news . You remember the local girl who was dying of a rare blood disease ?
translation.zh: 嗯，有一个好消息。你还记得那个死于罕见血液病的本地女孩吗？

translation.en: yes . Her parents were raising money to have her treated in the united states .
translation.zh: 是的。她的父母正在筹款让她在美国接受治疗。

translation.en: well , they ’ Ve got the money and she ’ s going tomorrow for treatment .
translation.zh: 嗯，他们有钱了，她明天就要去治疗了。

translation.en: don ’ t be moody ! I hope you ’ re not tired , because we ’ Ve been invited to a party this evening . I know how excited you get about parties .
translation.zh: 别喜怒无常！我希望你不要太累了，因为我们今晚被邀请要去参加一个聚会。我知道你对聚会有多狂热。

translation.en: Good afternoon , welcome to IBA . How can I be of service ?
translation.zh: 下午好，欢迎来到IBA公司。我能为您效劳吗？

translation.en: I'd like to talk to somebody about the Group Account Deposit Service .
translation.zh: 我想和谁谈谈团体帐户存款服务。

translation.en: This refers to the deposit business offered to the level 1 account of group companies .
translation.zh: 这是向集团公司一级账户提供的存款业务。

translation.en: What is it used for ? I mean , why bother to get this special account ?
translation.zh: 它是用来做什么的？我是说，为什么要费心弄这个特别账户？

translation.en: Group companies can use this to make their arrangement of funds flexible , when dealing with their subsidiaries .
translation.zh: 集团公司在与子公司打交道时，可以利用这一点灵活安排资金。

translation.en: I see , so this can really cut down on time and centralise management . Interesting ...
translation.zh: 我明白了，所以这真的可以减少时间和集中管理。有趣……

translation.en: Let me tell you some more . The interest is settled on the 20th of the last month in each quarter , It's paid quarterly . Of course it also needs to be settled if you cancel the account .
translation.zh: 我再告诉你一些信息。利息每季度最后一个月的20日结算，按季度支付。当然，即使你销户了也要进行结算。

translation.en: Miao Ping , in your opinion , should we go for the Type A or Type B Account ?
translation.zh: 苗平，你认为我们应该申请A类还是B类帐户？

translation.en: Well , the Type B Account is very restricted . If your aim is to use the account the same way as your use your Settlement Account , I would recommend the Type A Account for you .
translation.zh: 嗯，B类帐户限制比较多。如果你用这个帐户进行结算，我建议你申请A类帐户。

translation.en: Thanks for your time . I'll go and discuss everything with my partner and I'll be back later .
translation.zh: 谢谢。我去和我的搭档讨论下，然后再回来。

translation.en: Unfortunately , according to our regulations I have to confiscate these counterfeit notes .
translation.zh: 很抱歉，根据规定，我必须没收这些假钞。

translation.en: So , this 500 RIB is worthless ?
translation.zh: 那么，这500元就一文不值了。

translation.en: I'm sorry but it is our regulation , so I must follow it . We will issue you with a receipt to show that the notes you presented us with are counterfeit and have been confiscated . Then , if you wish to pay in some more cash , you are free to do so .
translation.zh: 很抱歉，但是这是我们的规定，所以我必须遵守。我们将给您开一张收据，说明您给我们的是伪钞，已经被没收了。另外，如果您愿意的话，可以再补上些现金。

translation.en: Right , I see . Let me give you another 500 RIB .
translation.zh: 行，我明白了。我再给你500元吧。

translation.en: Here's your Passbook back and the receipt to say we confiscated the 500 RIB worth of counterfeit notes .
translation.zh: 您的存折还给您，还有我们没收的500元伪钞的收据。

translation.en: Thanks . Now can I make the full deposit ?
translation.zh: 谢谢。现在我可以全额存款了吗？

translation.en: Yes . Please fill in a new deposit slip and we can continue .
translation.zh: 是的。请您填写一张新的存款单，我们就可以继续办理了。

translation.en: Hello Mr Waterstone , what can I do for you today ?
translation.zh: 你好，沃特斯通先生，今天有什么事吗？

translation.en: Hello , Becky . Well , you see , I have this thing here , called a Fixed Deposit Certificate , and I've just noticed the date on it .
translation.zh: 你好，贝基。嗯，你看，我这儿有一张定期存单，我刚注意到上面的日期。

translation.en: Oh , I see . You have two choices here you can either redeem or renew .
translation.zh: 哦，我明白了。您有两个选择，您可以赎回或续订。

translation.en: I think I'll redeem , if that's not a problem .
translation.zh: 如果没问题的话，我想赎罪。

translation.en: No problem at all , Mr Waterstone . Any preference as to how you want the money ?
translation.zh: 没问题，沃特斯通先生。对您要取的钱有什么特殊的需要吗？

translation.en: Anything you like , but not too many large notes . It's useful to have smaller notes .
translation.zh: 怎样都行，但是别给我太多的大面额钞票。小面额的钞票更有用一些。

translation.en: Here we go , Mr Waterstone . Here's your money and your interest note .
translation.zh: 好了，沃特斯通先生。这是你的钱和利息单。

translation.en: Yes , yes . Everything's fine . Thank you very much , Becky .
translation.zh: 好。没问题。非常感谢你，贝基。

translation.en: Hello , Sir . So , you are back ?
translation.zh: 你好，先生。还有什么事情吗？

translation.en: Yes , hello again . I would like to know the exact difference between Dividend Deposit and Dividend Participated Deposit .
translation.zh: 是的，你好。我想知道股息存款和分红存款的区别。

translation.en: That's pretty easy to explain . With the Deposit , the interest is fixed , but the Dividend of each policy will be transferred automatically into your bank account by the end of each year . The longer the term , the higher the Dividend you earn . This is because it is calculated at the Compound Interest Rate .
translation.zh: 这很容易理解。存款的利息是固定的，每个保单的红利在每年年底都会自动转入你的银行账户。期限越长，你获得的股息就越高。这是因为它是按复利计算的。

translation.en: And I can purchase that here ?
translation.zh: 我可以在这里买吗？

translation.en: Yes . And if you already have a Current Account with us , the Insurance Premium can be paid through it , which saves all of us a lot of hassle .
translation.zh: 可以。如果你在我们这里已经有一个活期账户，保险费可以通过这个账户来扣除，这就省去了很多麻烦。

translation.en: Good afternoon . Can I be of service ?
translation.zh: 下午好。我能效劳吗？

translation.en: I don't know . Can I purchase Treasury Certificates here at this counter ?
translation.zh: 我不知道。我可以在这个柜台买国债吗？

translation.en: Yes , of course . We have Treasury Notes with two , three and five-year terms available .
translation.zh: 是的，当然。我们有两年期、三年期和五年期的国债。

translation.en: Two years is fine , with a value of 1,000 RIB .
translation.zh: 两年就可以了，1000元的。

translation.en: OK , could I take a look at some ID please , like a passport ?
translation.zh: 好的，我可以看一下你的证件吗，比如护照？

translation.en: Here you go . By the way , is it possible to cash them before the maturity comes up ?
translation.zh: 好的。顺便问一下，有没有可能在到期前兑现？

translation.en: No , I'm afraid that isn't possible . You must wait until maturity before you cash them .
translation.zh: 不，恐怕不行。你必须等到到期后才能兑现。

translation.en: Hello , Personal Banking . How may I help you ?
translation.zh: 你好，私人银行。我能为您效劳吗？

translation.en: Hi there . I'm calling about Personal Internet Banking , what details can you give me ?
translation.zh: 你好。我打电话是想问问个人网上银行业务的，你能告诉我一些细节吗？

translation.en: Personal Internet Banking is a self service financial service that is based on the Internet . It can be used by both businesses and individuals . We offer an online payment service , Personal Net Banking , which includes services such as account transfers , personal foreign exchange trading . You can also get account management services , online bill payment , for household bills like gas and electricity ...
translation.zh: 个人网上银行是一种基于互联网的自助金融服务。它可供企业和个人使用。我们提供在线支付服务、个人网络银行业务，其中包括请如转账、个人外汇买卖等服务。您还可以享受账户管理服务、家庭账单网上缴费，比如缴煤气费和电费……

translation.en: That sounds good . At the moment I spend ages queuing at the post office to pay my bills .
translation.zh: 听起来不错。现在，为了缴费我得在邮局排半天队。

translation.en: Is there anything else , apart from the Credit Rating and Debt to Asset Ratio ?
translation.zh: 除了信用评级和资产负债率之外，还有什么别的吗？

translation.en: There is the Balance of Net Liabilities . This must not exceed its net assets and no business loss can be shown during the past two years .
translation.zh: 存在的净负债余额不得超过净资产，并且在过去两年内未显示出任何业务损失。

translation.en: Right , OK . That , again , shouldn't be a problem .
translation.zh: 好的，好的。这也不是问题。

translation.en: And the total ratio of return on assets should not be lower than the average , for that particular industry , for the first two quarters of the year .
translation.zh: 总资产回报率不应低于该行业今年前两个季度的平均水平。

translation.en: Well , as far as I can tell , we qualify .
translation.zh: 嗯，据我所知，我们符合条件。

translation.en: Of course we will need proof , originals and duplicate of everything . As soon as you bring in the proof and we assess it , it should be very quick indeed .
translation.zh: 当然，我们需要所有这些证明、原件和复印件。一旦你把材料拿来，我们评估一下，应该会很快。

translation.en: Can you help me with Comprehensive Credit Granting ?
translation.zh: 你能帮我办理综合授信吗？

translation.en: Certainly , Madam . What would you like to know ?
translation.zh: 当然可以，夫人。你想知道什么？

translation.en: Well , everything really .
translation.zh: 嗯，所有。

translation.en: All right . We can grant a Financing Promise Quota , if you qualify . This means that we can deal with all of your needs in a speedy and efficient way . Firstly , your Credit Rating must be class A , and your Debt to Asset Ratio must be top notch , for the industry you are involved in .
translation.zh: 好的。如果您符合条件，我们可以给予您融资承诺额度。这意味着我们可以快速有效地处理您的所有需求。首先，您的信用等级必须是A级，而且您的资产负债率对于您的企业所在行业来说必须是一流的。

translation.en: Could I purchase Euro with RIB here ? I have to stay here for months .
translation.zh: 我可以用人民币换欧元吗？我得在这里呆上几个月。

translation.en: Yes , the rate for cash purchases is listed on the electronica screen , so you have seen the rate of exchange .
translation.zh: 可以，汇率在电子屏幕上，你应该已经看到了。

translation.en: Yes , I have known of it .
translation.zh: 是的，我知道。

translation.en: How much do you like to exchange ?
translation.zh: 你想换多少钱？

translation.en: In what denominations ?
translation.zh: 你想要什么面额的欧元？

translation.en: It doesn't matter , but leave me some small changes , that will be convenient in daily life .
translation.zh: 都可以，不过给我换点零钱，这样日常生活就方便多了。

translation.en: Right , I will exchange for you now . Please sign the exchange form giving the name and telephone .
translation.zh: 好的，我现在就给你换。请在兑换单上签字，注明姓名和电话。

translation.en: Well , could you change them too ? The dollars , I want to change them into Swiss francs .
translation.zh: 嗯，这个你们能换吗？我想把美元换成瑞士法郎。

translation.en: OK , wait for a moment . Well , I am sorry , but we are not authorized to exchange coins because it is low and we do not have enough foreign coins . In this case , you'd better change 2,000 $ to Swiss francs .
translation.zh: 好的，等一下。很抱歉，我们无权兑换硬币，因为面额很低，而且我们没有足够的外国硬币。你最好把2000美元换成瑞士法郎。

translation.en: Please sign the memo on the bottom and keep your money and memo .
translation.zh: 请在下面的备忘录上签字，并保管好您的钱和备忘录。

translation.en: Thanks a lot . Good-bye .
translation.zh: 谢谢。再见。

translation.en: Hello , Sir . How can we help you today ?
translation.zh: 你好，先生。我们今天能为您做些什么？

translation.en: I need to find out some more information for L / C . I would like an outline of responsibilities , both ours , yours and the beneficiary , please .
translation.zh: 我需要了解更多的关于信用证的信息。请给我大致介绍一下我们的、你们的以及受益人的责任吧。

translation.en: OK , to start , the conditions are specified by the buyer and may include Insurance Forms , Way Bills , Bills of Lading , Customs forms , various certificates .
translation.zh: 好的，首先，所有的条件都是由买方指定的，并且可以包括保险单、 货运单、提单、报关单以及各种证书。

translation.en: OK , got it . Is there anything else I need to know before we go ahead ?
translation.zh: 好的，明白了。在我们往下进行之前还有其他什么事情是我需要知道的？

translation.en: Just that in effect , a basic Letter of Credit is a financial contract between the bank , the bank's customer , and the beneficiary , and this contract involves the transfer of goods or services against funds .
translation.zh: 实际上就是这些，一个基本信用证是一种在银行、银行的客户以及受益人之间订立的金融契约，并且该合同涉及到凭商品或者服务换取资金。

translation.en: That sounds fine , thanks for that . Let's go ahead !
translation.zh: 听起来不错，谢谢你。我们开始办理吧！

translation.en: Hello , Madam . What can we do for you today ?
translation.zh: 您好，女士。我们能为您做些什么？

translation.en: Hi . I've been sent over from Turner Interiors . They said I need to collect some sort of L / C ? Do you have it ?
translation.zh: 你好。我是特纳内饰公司派来的。我来收信用证？你有吗？

translation.en: I certainly do . Here it is , an Export L / C from Tokyo .
translation.zh: 我当然有。给你，这是在东京开的出口信用证。

translation.en: It should be from Sayuri Beds . Is that right ?
translation.zh: 应该是小百合床上的。是这样吗？

translation.en: Yes , it is . Sayuri Beds , Tokyo , Japan .
translation.zh: 是的，是的。小百合床，东京，日本。

translation.en: That's what I want ! Do you need me to sign anything ? Or fill in some forms ?
translation.zh: 这就是我想要的！你需要我签什么吗？或者填一些表格？

translation.en: Just sign right here , please . That's everything you need to do .
translation.zh: 请在这里签名。这就是你需要做的一切。

translation.en: Perfect . Thank you , goodbye !
translation.zh: 完美谢谢，再见！

translation.en: Good day ! Welcome to Lincoln Bank , how may we assist you ?
translation.zh: 很好的一天！欢迎光临林肯银行，我们能为您提供什么帮助？

translation.en: Hello . I need to find out if a Receipt of Proceeds has arrived . I'm from Felix Wasserman Associates .
translation.zh: 你好。我要弄清楚收款收据是否已经到了。我是菲利克斯·瓦尔塞曼联合公司的。

translation.en: Thanks . Have you got the L / C number ?
translation.zh: 谢谢。你有信用证号码吗？

translation.en: Hang on a tick and I'll check for you . I'm sorry ; we have no record of that arriving .
translation.zh: 等一下，我帮你查一下。我很抱歉；我们没有收据收到的记录。

translation.en: OK , thanks for checking . Could you give me a ring when it arrives , please ?
translation.zh: 好的，谢谢。到了能给我打个电话吗？

translation.en: No problem . I'll be in touch as soon as it comes in .
translation.zh: 没问题。我一收到就联系您。

translation.en: Yes . Do you exchange foreign money here ?
translation.zh: 是的。你们这里可以兑换外币吗？

translation.en: Yes . Our bank is authorized to deal with foreign exchange .
translation.zh: 是的。我行被授权办理外汇业务。

translation.en: What kinds of currency do you change ?
translation.zh: 你们可以兑换哪种货币？

translation.en: We can change only three kinds of currency , USD , Japanese Yen and HK Dollar in our savings office .
translation.zh: 我们只能兑换三种货币，美元、日元和港币。

translation.en: Could you tell me what the exchange rate for USD is today ?
translation.zh: 你能告诉我今天美元的兑换率是多少吗？

translation.en: The buying rate is 826 . 44 yuan for 100 dollars .
translation.zh: 买入价是826。100美元兑换44元。

translation.en: I want to change some Us dollars to cover my expense here .
translation.zh: 我想兑换一些美元来支付我在这里的费用。

translation.en: Please go to Counter No . 2 , the foreign exchange counter . It's over there .
translation.zh: 请到2号外汇柜台。在那边。

translation.en: What's your main range ?
translation.zh: 你们的主要经营范围是什么？

translation.en: Generally speaking , we provide bikes for both gentlemen and ladies , size 19 , 21 , 23 , 25 and 27 inches . We can vary the colors according to the buyer's requirements . Here are the catalogues and the pattern books . They will give you a rough idea about our products .
translation.zh: 一般来说，我们为男女提供19、21、23、25和27英寸的自行车。我们可以根据买方的要求改变颜色。这是目录和式样书。你可以通过这些大致了解我们的产品。

translation.en: I am interested in your flying pigeon bicycles . I think some of these items will find a ready market in Canada . But what our customers appreciate most is a reliable product .
translation.zh: 我对你们的飞鸽自行车很感兴趣。我认为其中一些产品在加拿大会很畅销。但我们的客户最欣赏的是可靠的产品

translation.en: To be reliable is the strong point of our products . As a matter of fact , it's always our practice to supply high quality goods at reasonable prices . Flying pigeon is the best of its kind at the price .
translation.zh: 可靠就是我们产品的优点。事实上，我们一贯都以合理的价格供应高质量的商品。飞鸽在价格上是同类中最好的。

translation.en: Then I'd like to know your availability of the products and the terms of sales , such as mode of payment , delivery , discounts , etc .
translation.zh: 那么我想知道你们的产品供应情况和销售条件，如付款方式、交货、折扣等。

translation.en: I'd like to apply for a credit card . Can you help me with my application ?
translation.zh: 我想申请一张信用卡。你能帮我申请吗？

translation.en: I'm afraid that I don't have a credit history . I just came to this country .
translation.zh: 恐怕我没有信用记录。我刚来到这个国家。

translation.en: Do you have an account with this bank ?
translation.zh: 你在这家银行有帐户吗？

translation.en: In that case I highly recommend you apply for a savings and checking account also . That would help with your credit card application .
translation.zh: 这样的话，我极力推荐你申请一个即储蓄存款和支票存款于一身的账户。这对你的信用卡申请有帮助。

translation.en: What is the interest rate on your card ?
translation.zh: 你们信用卡的利率是多少？

translation.en: The annual charge rate is 9.5 % .
translation.zh: 年收费率为9.5%。

translation.en: That's very expensive !
translation.zh: 太贵了！

translation.en: Not really . The credit card is a revolving account . You only pay interest on what you owe .
translation.zh: 不完全是。这种信用卡是一个循环账户。你只需付你的利息就行了。

translation.en: How does the bank bill its customers for credit card charges ?
translation.zh: 银行如何把信用卡费用账单交给客户？

translation.en: You will receive a monthly statement with each expenditure itemized .
translation.zh: 你每个月将会收到一份结算单，上面列出了每项费用。

translation.en: Does the card provide any other benefits ?
translation.zh: 这种卡有什么福利吗？

translation.en: You can also get a cash advance up to 1,000 dollars on this card .
translation.zh: 使用这种卡你可以预支高达1000美元的现金。

translation.en: Really ? I didn ’ t think they were known for their luxury chocolate production
translation.zh: 真的吗？我认为他们的奢华巧克力并不出名。

translation.en: I have it on highest authority that this traditional secret recipe has been handed down in the Granger family for generations . I ’ m sure you can keep a secret . Buttermilk , cacao beans , sugar and Haggis .
translation.zh: 我敢保证这是格兰杰家族家族祖传的传统秘方。我知道你会保守秘密。成分有酪乳、可可豆、糖和巧克力。

translation.en: It ’ s a traditional Scottish delicacy , you take sheep ’ s liver , heart and lung and stuff it inside of the sheep ’ s stomach .
translation.zh: 是种传统的苏格兰做法：取下羊的肝脏，心和肺，然后将之填充在羊的胃里。

translation.en: Ah , get back to you .
translation.zh: 再见。

translation.en: Mr . Johnson ? Mr . Johnson ?
translation.zh: 约翰逊先生？约翰逊先生？

translation.en: Hey , son , are you insured ?
translation.zh: 嘿，儿子，你买保险了吗？

translation.en: Not yet , but I'm thinking of it . Have you bought one , Dad ?
translation.zh: 还没有，但我正在考虑。爸爸，你买了吗？

translation.en: I took out a life insurance policy and made your mother the beneficiary .
translation.zh: 我买了一份人寿保险，你妈妈是受益人。

translation.en: Can you tell me why you want to buy it ?
translation.zh: 能告诉我你为什么要买吗？

translation.en: I am a fireman and it is a dangerous job . I have to consider your mother's life .
translation.zh: 我是一名消防员，这项工作很危险。我得为你妈妈考虑考虑。

translation.en: Oh , I see . Do you advise me to buy one ?
translation.zh: 哦，我明白了。你建议我买一个吗？

translation.en: A $ 100 000 policy shouldn't be too expensive . Here , call my agent . He'll give you a good deal .
translation.zh: 10万美元的保单应该不是很贵。给，打电话给我的经纪人。他会给你一个好价钱。

translation.en: Can I see your passbook and the withdrawal slip , please ?
translation.zh: 我能看看你的存折和取款单吗？

translation.en: Let me just make sure . You want to withdraw one thousand dollars ?
translation.zh: 我需要确定一下，你想取一千美元吗？

translation.en: Yes , I need some traveler's checks .
translation.zh: 是的，我需要一些旅行支票。

translation.en: How much do you need ?
translation.zh: 你需要多少钱？

translation.en: Three thousand US dollars .
translation.zh: 三千美元。

translation.en: All right , can I have your passbook ?
translation.zh: 好的，能给我你的存折吗？

translation.en: What amounts do you want the checks in ?
translation.zh: 你需要哪个账户的支票？

translation.en: It's all the same to me .
translation.zh: 对我来说都一样。

translation.en: Could you change these for me , please ?
translation.zh: 你能帮我换一下钱吗？

translation.en: Twenties and some smaller bills , please .
translation.zh: 请给我20美元和一些面值更小的钞票。

translation.en: Yes . Could you tell many balance ? Here's account number .
translation.zh: 有。你能告诉我这个账户还有多少余额吗？这是账号。

translation.en: What What features do they offer ?
translation.zh: 这些账户提供什么功能？

translation.en: In that case , I ’ ll get you to fill out this paperwork . I ’ ll need your social insurance number , and two pieces of government ID . If you could just sign here , and here , and here . we ’ ll be all set . Would you like to make a deposit today ?
translation.zh: 好的，我需要你填写一下这份文件，还需要你的社会保险号码和两张政府身份证。你需要在这里签名，在这里。我们都准备好了。你今天想存款吗？

translation.en: What problem are you having ?
translation.zh: 有什么问题吗？

translation.en: There have been charges made on my debit card that I didn ’ t make .
translation.zh: 有人从我的借记卡扣款了。

translation.en: Do you have the statement for your card ?
translation.zh: 我需要看一下你的借记卡账单。

translation.en: What are the charges you ’ re referring to ?
translation.zh: 你能告诉我你指的是哪项扣款吗？

translation.en: The last four charges on the page .
translation.zh: 最后四项扣款。

translation.en: I ’ m afraid we ’ re going to have to investigate these charges .
translation.zh: 我们需要对此进行调查。

translation.en: How long will an investigation take ?
translation.zh: 需要多长时间？

translation.en: I honestly don ’ t know , but we will freeze payment on these charges .
translation.zh: 还不清楚，但我们会冻结这些费用。

translation.en: That sounds absolutely fantastic .
translation.zh: 听起来真是太棒了。

translation.en: I ’ m doing well .
translation.zh: 我很好。

translation.en: Could you cancel a check for me ?
translation.zh: 你能帮我取消一张支票吗？

translation.en: I wrote the check out for way too much .
translation.zh: 我开这张支票的时候，金额写多了。

translation.en: I wrote the check out for $ 150 .
What were you supposed to write it out for ?
translation.zh: 你本来要写多少？

translation.en: I was supposed to write the check out for $ 100 .
translation.zh: 我应该开100美元的支票。

translation.en: I ’ ll just cancel it for you right now .
translation.zh: 我现在就帮你取消。

translation.en: That ’ s great . You ’ re a lifesaver .
translation.zh: 太好了。你是我的救星。

translation.en: That's easy . It was your office ergonomics that decided me .
translation.zh: 很简单，办公室的工作环境。

translation.en: You're kidding ! Something as simple as that ?
translation.zh: 你开玩笑吧！因为这种事情？

translation.en: Yes . It is very important to me . My mother worked in offices for twenty years , and she finally had carpal tunnel syndrome . I have been reading about repetitive stress injuries , and I know that t
translation.zh: 对。这对我很重要。我母亲在办公室工作了20年，最后得了腕管综合征。我一直在读关于重复性压力伤害的书，我对此有所了解。

translation.en: Yes , there has been a lot of research into RSI's . Something so simple as proper chair height can prevent injuries . Tell me , did anything else influence your decision ?
translation.zh: 是的，有很多关于RSI的研究。一些简单的事情，比如适当的椅子高度可以防止受伤。告诉我，还有什么影响你的决定吗？

translation.en: Yes , I noticed that you have professional training and team-building days . I like the idea of working for a company that invests in its staff .
translation.zh: 是的，我还注意到公司有专业训练和团建。我喜欢为一家愿意投资员工的公司工作。

translation.en: Well , welcome to the team .
translation.zh: 好的，欢迎加入公司。

translation.en: I ’ d like to apply for a personal loan .
translation.zh: 我想申请个人贷款

translation.en: Let me check with a credit manager . A record show your credit reading is quite high . I don't think you have any problems .
translation.zh: 让我和信贷经理核实一下。根据记录，您的信用分相当高，可以贷款。

translation.en: What ’ s the current interest rate ?
translation.zh: 现在的利率是多少？

translation.en: Our monthly interest is 1.5 % of the outstanding balance . Would you please fill out the application the form ?
translation.zh: 我们的月利息是未清余额的1.5%。请填一下申请表好吗？
